article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Deaths Rise To 5,198, Cases To 10,668
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 3 November 2026, the DR Congo Ministry of Health reports 10,668 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,198 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.7%. The ministry published the figures on its website, noting ongoing transmission across the country. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that the virus poses a threat to neighbouring countries due to continued spread in the DRC. The report underscores persistent Ebola activity and regional risk, with public health authorities maintaining surveillance and response measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラによる死者5,198人に、症例数10,668人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.7%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、Africa CDCが近隣諸国への拡大リスクを警告していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが近隣国への拡大リスクを警告しているが、具体的な越境感染事例は記事内に記載なし。続報でDRC国外への拡大有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: O înțepătură de țânțar i-a fost fatală. Student francez, ucis de febra dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mosquito bite proved fatal. French student killed by dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old French student died of dengue fever in Vietnam on 27 October after traveling through Southeast Asia. Dengue, a viral illness transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes (A. aegypti and A. albopictus, the tiger mosquito), is common in tropical and subtropical regions. Symptoms typically appear days after infection and include high fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pains, nausea, vomiting, and rash. Most infections resolve, but some progress to severe dengue with hemorrhage, dangerous hypotension, and organ failure, which can be fatal without proper care. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management relies on hydration, symptom relief, and monitoring, with severe cases requiring hospitalization. The deceased was a Lyon-based business student on a sabbatical year; his rugby club in Quimper described him as a leader and planned a tribute before an upcoming French championship match.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊に刺されたことが致命的に。フランス人学生がデング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 東南アジア渡航後にベトナムでデング熱により死亡した個別の事例であり、デング熱自体は同地域で常在する疾患であるため、異常性や公衆衛生上の重大な脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 個人の死亡事例に関する報道であり、感染症の異常発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報ではない。デング熱はベトナムを含む東南アジアで常在的に流行している疾患である。

article.articleHeadline: 'Dịch sốt xuất huyết phá vỡ quy luật'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak defies the pattern
article.articleSummary: As of November 7, 2026, Vietnam reports 170,684 dengue cases and 21 deaths in the first 10 months, with the Southern region accounting for 66% of cases. In 2025 Vietnam had 184,903 cases, among the highest in Asia-Pacific. Dengue now circulates year-round across all provinces, breaking the rainfall-driven peak; outbreaks have appeared in previously low-incidence provinces such as Tuyên Quang and Sơn La. Experts note shifts in outbreak cycles: large outbreaks once every five years are shortening to 3–4 years; post-2022 cases remained high. All four dengue serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4) are circulating; serotype dominance varies; vector resistance to insecticides compounds control challenges. The Brazil experience from São Paulo shows a two-dose vaccine reducing symptomatic dengue by 73% and hospitalizations by 87%, with about 24 million doses across 2,752 locales (2024–2025). Vietnamese authorities advocate year-round proactive prevention: vaccination, surveillance, early case detection, vector control, larval/pupal elimination, and bite-avoidance to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の流行がパターンを崩す
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱が年間を通じて全省に拡大し、流行周期の短縮や血清型の変化、殺虫剤耐性など異常な動向が確認されており、症例数・死亡者数も多いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・サンパウロのワクチン事例は比較参考情報として言及されているのみで、当該イベントの発生国はベトナムのみと判断した。中国への言及は本文中に実質的な記述がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Más departamentos muestran incremento de casos sospechosos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More departments report an increase in suspected dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue notifications rose 29% across Paraguay, extending beyond Asunción and Villa Hayes to Central, Caaguazú, Cordillera, San Pedro, and Amambay. The virus remains largely non-circulating, with 235 weekly suspected cases and 293 positive dengue cases in 2026. In the last 21 days, no new dengue cases, outbreaks, or deaths, and no new chikungunya activity. Health authorities urge eliminating mosquito breeding sites after rains and routine vector-control, including removing standing water. El Niño-driven rains call for discarding containers, covering water storage, and using chlorine as needed. Paraguay remains malaria-free since 2011, certified by WHO in 2018; vigilance for imported malaria and strengthened border surveillance are emphasized to prevent reintroduction ahead of World Malaria Day.

triage.headline_ja: 複数県でデング熱疑い例の増加が報告される
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイ国内でのデング熱疑い例増加に関する定例的な報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国の発生事例ではない。重症度や国際的拡大の兆候も報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はパラグアイにおけるデング熱疑い例の増加とルーチンのベクターコントロール対策を報じたもの。発生地域にPhilippinesが含まれているが、記事本文の主題はパラグアイであり、フィリピンでの発生は確認されない。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のいずれにも該当する発生国がないため verified_locations は空。

article.articleHeadline: 65 வாா்டுகளிலும் டெங்கு கொசு ஒழிப்புப் பணி தீவிரம்: ஆணையா்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue mosquito control operations intensified in 65 wards: Commissioner.
article.articleSummary: On 7 November 2026, dengue control operations were intensified across 65 wards following monsoon-driven mosquito breeding. In a meeting attended by health officers, health inspectors, welfare inspectors, and mosquito control workers, Commissioner Ne. Ponmani announced reinforced surveillance across all zones and expanded anti-mosquito measures. To curb dengue mosquito larvae, authorities will identify water-bearing containers that support larval development and take prompt removal actions. Homes will be surveyed to locate rainwater stagnation points, with immediate clearance once rainfall ends. The drive focuses on eliminating breeding habitats during the rainy season to reduce dengue transmission within the city corporation's 65 wards.

triage.headline_ja: 65の行政区でデング熱蚊駆除活動を強化:コミッショナー
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的なデング蚊駆除活動の報告であり、異常事態や重症例・集団発生の情報はなく、ルーチンの公衆衛生対策に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な蚊媒介対策の実施報告であり、症例数や感染拡大に関する具体的情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Le pays réalise des progrès dans la lutte contre le paludisme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: The country is making progress in the fight against malaria.
article.articleSummary: From Luanda, Angola, Pinto de Sousa, Secretary of State for Public Health, announced that Angola is making progress against malaria, reporting a 20% reduction in malaria deaths and a 10% drop in malaria cases in 2026. He spoke at a high-level malaria-elimination meeting in Gaborone, Botswana, noting plans to create a national mosquito-net production factory, due to be commissioned next year. Since 2017, Angola has built 735 health facilities nationwide, about 80% of which are primary health-care units, aimed at strengthening the health system and improving access. The roundtable included representatives from Mozambique, Tanzania, Zambia, and Equatorial Guinea. Botswana’s ALMA president Duma Boko stressed the need for stronger political and institutional commitment, higher domestic funding, robust health systems, and strategic partnerships to accelerate malaria elimination across Africa.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ:同国がマラリア対策で進展
triage.triage_reason: マラリア死亡・症例数の減少という好転を報じる内容であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の新たな脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はアンゴラにおけるマラリア対策の進捗報告が主題で、ザンビアは会議参加国として言及されているのみ。対象国リストの中でザンビアのみ該当するが、実際の発生国はアンゴラ（対象国リスト外）であるため、イベントとしての発生地はほぼ関係ない。

article.articleHeadline: 兒科醫生關日華指今季兒童流感轉差快　料天氣轉冷再肆虐
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pediatrician Guan Rihua says this season's pediatric influenza is deteriorating rapidly; colder weather is expected to trigger another outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Hong Kong has recorded 29 severe pediatric influenza cases this season. The University of Hong Kong’s Department of Pediatrics and Adolescent Medicine, led by Honorary Clinical Associate Professor Guan Rihua, says many children deteriorate rapidly after infection, with sudden hypotension and multi-organ involvement, including the liver and heart. The illness persists into November, and with colder weather expected next week, respiratory viruses are poised to surge again. There is concern that seasonal influenza could merge with the winter strain, potentially prolonging a lengthy flu season. The report underscores the risk of rapid clinical decline in children and the possibility of co-circulation between non-pandemic seasonal flu and the winter influenza in Hong Kong.

triage.headline_ja: 小児科医の関日華氏、今季の小児インフルエンザは悪化が速いと指摘　寒波で再び猛威を振るう見込み
triage.triage_reason: 香港で29件の重症小児インフルエンザ症例が報告され、急速な多臓器不全進行と冬季株との重複流行への懸念があり、メディア注目も高いため。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区はChina(1814991)に統合。季節性インフルエンザの重症化事例が報告されており、冬季の流行拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: खुरपका-मुंहपका के नए स्ट्रेन SAT-1 को लेकर अलर्ट, पशुओं के लिए यह कितना खतरनाक?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert over the new SAT-1 strain of foot-and-mouth disease: how dangerous is it for animals?
article.articleSummary: FMD SAT-1 serotype triggers India alert, though no SAT-1 cases have been reported in India as of November 7, 2026. FMD comprises seven serotypes (O, A, C, SAT-1, SAT-2, SAT-3, Asia-1); immunity to one does not protect against others, and India’s current vaccine does not guard against SAT-1, raising outbreak risk if introduced. SAT-1 has been detected in China and Mongolia, prompting heightened vigilance. Symptoms in cattle, buffalo, goats, sheep, and pigs include high fever, mouth, tongue, gums, and hoof lesions, lameness, and reduced feed intake; mortality may occur in young animals. Transmission occurs via direct contact and via contaminated feed, water, utensils, vehicles, and footwear. Preparatory measures included Bengaluru’s two-day Vajra-SAT exercise with ICAR-NIVEDI, involving 83 representatives from 25 states and 3 Union Territories, focusing on rapid detection, lab confirmation, movement controls, and rapid response. Farmers are advised to isolate suspected animals and consult a veterinarian promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫の新系統SAT-1に関する警戒:家畜にとってどれほど危険か?
triage.triage_reason: インドではSAT-1株による実際の症例は報告されておらず、現時点では予防的な警戒・訓練段階に留まるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事象は家畜（動物）のみに影響する口蹄疫（FMD）の新血清型SAT-1に関する警戒情報であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響はない。インドでは実際の症例は未報告で、ベンガルールでの訓練（Vajra-SAT演習）など予防的対応が中心。SAT-1は中国・モンゴルで検出されているが、モンゴルは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 專家籲勿忽略幼童肚痛或持續嘔吐　有可能是流感併發心肌炎
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts urge not to ignore abdominal pain or persistent vomiting in young children, as it may be influenza-associated myocarditis.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong remains in its influenza season since late June, with over four months of sustained activity and several cases of severe pediatric influenza. Experts warn that abdominal pain or persistent vomiting in young children may signal influenza-associated myocarditis, and urge prompt medical evaluation. Guan Rihua, former president and executive committee member of the Asian Society of Pediatric Infectious Diseases and honorary clinical professor at HKU’s medical school, says current influenza activity is high due to waning antibodies after vaccination, possible viral evolution, and intense community transmission. Parents should practice hygiene, wear masks in crowded places, and seek care promptly if flu symptoms include breathing difficulty, prolonged fever, or seizures. Do not overlook abdominal pain or persistent vomiting, as early detection of myocarditis can reduce mortality risk in children.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、幼児の腹痛や持続する嘔吐を軽視しないよう呼びかけ　インフルエンザ併発性心筋炎の可能性も
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザが4か月以上続き重症小児例が報告されているが、季節性流行の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限等の明確な懸念は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 香港の季節性インフルエンザ流行に関する注意喚起記事。重症小児例（心筋炎合併）への警告が中心で、異常な病原体変異や国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dirawat Infulenza Tipe A, Kepastian Shin Tae-yong Dampingi Persija Terjawab!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Being Treated for Type A Influenza, Shin Tae-yong's Presence with Persija Confirmed!
article.articleSummary: Shin Tae-yong was treated for Influenza A virus infection and hospitalized in Medan, Indonesia, after a week of severe coughing and runny nose. He missed Persija Jakarta's I-League Cup group A match against PSMS Medan on 3 November 2026 at Stadion Utama Sumatera Utara, which ended 1-1 under interim coach Choi In-cheul. After intensive medical care, STY recovered and is declared fit to lead training and sit in the technical area at Jakarta International Stadium (JIS) ahead of El Clasico Indonesia Week 9 against Persebaya Surabaya on 7 November 2026 at 19:00 WIB. Persija, boasting a perfect home record in the Super League 2026/2027 with four consecutive home wins against Persib Bandung, Java United FC, Arema FC, and Persik Kediri, aims to secure three points and climb the standings with STY back in action.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型で入院治療、シン・テヨンがペルシヤに復帰することが確定！
triage.triage_reason: 著名サッカー監督個人のインフルエンザA罹患に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 個人の罹患事例であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての集団発生やアウトブレイクの記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: 台南第17例登革熱境外移入　越南旅遊返國發病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan's 17th imported dengue fever case; ill after returning from travel to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Tainan City Health Bureau reports the year’s 17th imported dengue fever case. A woman in her 40s from Yongkang District traveled to Vietnam from October 28 to November 1, returned to Taiwan and initially had no symptoms while working in Kaohsiung. On November 4 she developed fever, headache and body aches; a rapid test on November 5 was positive and laboratory confirmation followed. The case is classified as imported. The dengue prevention center in Tainan notified Kaohsiung City Health Bureau and mobilized emergency fogging, elimination of breeding sources, and indoor/outdoor chemical control to reduce the Aedes mosquito density and the risk of community transmission. Vector surveillance is underway to prevent local transmission, reflecting ongoing dengue vigilance for travelers returning from endemic areas such as Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 台南第17例登革熱境外移入　ベトナム旅行から帰国後発症
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入性デング熱の単発例であり、既存のサーベイランス・媒介蚊対策で対応されている通常の輸入症例として扱われるため、重大な公衆衛生上の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 主な発生は台湾（対象国リスト外）での輸入症例。ベトナムは感染源地として言及されているが、ベトナム国内での発生事例ではないため参考情報として記載。現地当局により迅速な媒介蚊対策が実施されており、地域内感染拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: أعمال عنف في شرق جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية تُزهق الأرواح وتعرقل جهود مكافحة الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: United Nations: Acts of violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo claim lives and hinder efforts to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo undermines the Ebola response, according to UN OCHA updates as of 7 November 2026. In Kantine-Aloiya, Beni, North Kivu, at least 30 civilians were killed as homes were burned and a health center destroyed; among the dead were patients. Attacks forced people in contact with Ebola patients to flee monitoring posts, and response teams suspended operations, hindering contact tracing and outbreak containment. Authorities report more than 10,700 confirmed Ebola cases and over 5,200 deaths, with the vast majority in eastern DRC. The UN agency called on all parties to protect civilians, respect international humanitarian law, and guarantee safe, unobstructed access for humanitarian and health workers to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴ民主共和国東部での暴力により人命が失われ、エボラ対策が妨げられている
triage.triage_reason: DRCで1万人超の感染者・5200人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、武力衝突により接触者追跡や対応活動が妨げられており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は暴力によるエボラ対応への支障を報じているが、背景にある大規模な流行（1万件超の確定症例、5200人超の死亡）自体が重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、既存のRRA対象として継続監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Un student francez a fost ucis de febra dengue în Asia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A French student was killed by dengue fever in Asia.
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old French student died in Vietnam from dengue fever, a viral illness transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes (Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus) common in tropical and subtropical Southeast Asia. The student, who studied at a business school in Lyon and had taken a sabbatical year to travel Southeast Asia, fell ill during his Vietnam trip; death occurred on October 27 and was announced by his former rugby club. Dengue fever typically presents after a few days with high fever, severe headaches, muscle and joint pains, nausea, vomiting, and rash. While most infections recover, severe forms can cause hemorrhage, dangerous drops in blood pressure, and organ failure without proper care. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive, including hydration and monitoring. The rugby club in Quimper will honor him with a moment of silence before Sunday’s home match in Brittany.

triage.headline_ja: フランス人学生、アジアでデング熱により死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムは既知のデング熱流行地域であり、本件は個別の渡航者死亡事例に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス人学生個人の死亡を報じるローカルニュースであり、デング熱自体はベトナムで既知の風土病。流行状況の変化や集団発生を示す情報はない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: British Doctor With Ebola Admitted to Royal Free Hospital London
article.articleSummary: An imported Ebola case in the United Kingdom: a British doctor who contracted Ebola while assisting an outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive and was evacuated to the UK. On 5 November 2026 the patient was admitted to the Royal Free Hospital in London, treated in the High Level Isolation Unit. The UK Health Security Agency says the risk to the public remains low and that infection prevention measures are robust; no additional precautions are needed for the public. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of a symptomatic person and is not airborne. Symptoms include fever, severe headaches, muscle pain, vomiting and diarrhoea; bleeding may occur in severe cases. The Royal Free’s isolation facilities feature restricted access, specialized PPE, controlled ventilation, and strict containment. The patient’s identity and current clinical condition have not been disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: 英国人医師、コンゴでエボラ出血熱に感染しロンドンのロイヤル・フリー病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症の国際的な患者移送事例であり、IHR基準の複数（重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は英国への輸入症例が主題だが、感染源はDRCでのエボラ対応活動中の感染であるため、発生国としてDRCを採用。英国（対象国リスト外）は除外。

article.articleHeadline: तेजी से बढ़ रहा इन्फ्लूएंजा और वायरल निमोनिया का खतरा, अलर्ट पर भोपाल, ये लक्षण नजरअंदाज न करें | Influenza Viral Pneumonia Risk Aiims Bhopal Health Alert Symptoms Prevention
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of influenza and viral pneumonia is rising rapidly; Bhopal on alert; do not ignore these symptoms.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, AIIMS Bhopal warns of rapidly spreading influenza activity and other respiratory viruses in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, risking pneumonia and serious breathing difficulties. Key symptoms include sudden high fever, chills, headache, body pains, sore throat, cough, and extreme fatigue. Elderly individuals, young children, pregnant women, and smokers, along with those with asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, diabetes, heart disease, or weakened immunity, face higher risk of severe illness. Prevention stresses annual influenza vaccination and, where appropriate, pneumonia vaccination; wear masks in crowded, poorly ventilated spaces; perform hand hygiene; cover coughs/sneezes; maintain good indoor ventilation; avoid smoking and indoor pollution. Seek urgent medical care for persistent high fever, shortness of breath, chest pain, confusion, or blue lips. Antibiotics are ineffective against viral infections and should be used only under physician guidance.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザとウイルス性肺炎のリスクが急速に高まる、ボーパールで警戒、これらの症状を見逃さないで
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発・注意喚起記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: AIIMSボーパールによる季節性インフルエンザ・ウイルス性肺炎に対する予防啓発記事。感染拡大の異常性や緊急性を示す具体的データ（患者数・死亡数等）は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sebanyak 9 Kasus Influenza A Ditemukan di Bali, Wamenkes: Warga Flu Wajib Pakai Masker
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine Cases of Influenza A Found in Bali, Deputy Health Minister: Flu Patients Must Wear Masks
article.articleSummary: As of November 7, 2026, Bali reported 113 influenza cases, with nine laboratory-confirmed as influenza A. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus urged residents with flu symptoms to wear masks and rest at home to curb transmission ahead of the Natal 2026 and New Year 2027 holidays. He explained that influenza viruses periodically change form, so immunity to previous strains may not protect against new infections, and transmission rises during seasonal transitions and the rainy period. Management cannot rely solely on medications since influenza is caused by a virus. Maintaining good physical condition is crucial. The minister also promoted influenza vaccination, especially for the elderly and immunocompromised, noting that vaccines are increasingly available to bolster protection against infection.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島でインフルエンザA型9例確認、保健副大臣「インフルエンザ患者はマスク着用を」
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常範囲内の流行であり、重症例や死亡者の報告もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Violencia en Congo cobra vidas y afecta respuesta a ébola: ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Violence in Congo costs lives and hampers the Ebola response: UN
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo hampers the Ebola response. As of 2026-11-07, at least 30 civilians were killed, homes burned, and a health facility destroyed in Cantine-Aloya, Beni Territory, North Kivu. The attack caused people who had contact with Ebola patients to flee the observation center, forcing humanitarian health teams to suspend operations and hindering contact tracing and outbreak containment. The UN OCHA notes the outbreak remains ongoing in eastern DRC, with authorities reporting more than 10,700 confirmed Ebola cases and over 5,200 deaths to date. The UN urges protection of civilians, respect for international humanitarian law, and safe, unobstructed access for aid workers. No infection source or cross-border/import-export details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの暴力により死者、エボラ対応に支障:国連
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で進行中のエボラ流行（確定症例10,700件超、死者5,200人超）に加え、武装勢力による暴力が接触者追跡や対応活動を妨げており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 暴力により観察センターからの逃亡や保健施設破壊が発生し、接触者追跡・アウトブレイク制御が困難化。国連は人道支援要員への安全なアクセス確保を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: เปิดผลการศึกษา ผู้ป่วยฝีดาษวานร เผยน่าตกใจ คนไข้มีผื่นที่ทวารหนัก-อวัยวะเพศ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study results reveal: Monkeypox patient has rashes in the perianal and genital regions.
article.articleSummary: 154 laboratory-confirmed mpox (monkeypox) cases were enrolled from 14 clinics in Thailand, in a study by Chulalongkorn Hospital and the Center for Emerging Infectious Diseases in Clinical Medicine, published in the Journal of Infectious Diseases (October 2026). The cohort was predominantly male (152/154, 98.7%), with a median age of 35 (IQR 28–41); 86.4% identified as men who have sex with men, 5.6% bisexual, and 1.3% heterosexual. Most cases were mild; hospitalizations were limited. Common nonspecific symptoms included fever (37.7%), myalgia (19.6%), cough (8.4%), sore throat (15.6%), and lymphadenopathy (10.4%). Skin/mucosal lesions occurred in 71.4%, notably perianal/genital rashes in 94 cases (61.0%). Some exhibited conjunctivitis, rhinorrhea, oral ulcers, dysphagia, vomiting, or diarrhea (42.6%). Genomic data show initial imports with subsequent domestic transmission and ongoing import/export, with viral adaptation via immune-modulator and replication mutations. Tecovirimat for mpox clade IIb appeared ineffective in the STOMP study.

triage.headline_ja: 研究結果が明らかに：サル痘患者に肛門周囲・性器の発疹が見られ、衝撃的な結果に
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内のMpox（Clade IIb）に関する後ろ向き研究で、既知のMSM中心の国内伝播と免疫調節・複製変異によるウイルス適応が報告されているが、新規の急性アウトブレイクを示すものではなく、重症度も概ね軽症。継続的な国内外への拡大傾向は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はチュラロンコン大学病院等による学術研究（Journal of Infectious Diseases掲載）の紹介であり、新規アウトブレイクの速報ではない。ただし国内輸入・輸出を伴う継続的な伝播とウイルス変異の報告があり、今後の動向を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : des violences meurtrières dans l'est du pays perturbent la lutte contre Ebola (ONU)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: deadly violence in the eastern part of the country disrupts the fight against Ebola (UN).
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, violence in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo disrupted Ebola response operations. In Cantine-Aloya, Beni Territory, North Kivu Province, at least 30 civilians were killed overnight, with homes burned and a health center destroyed; several victims were patients. People who had contact with Ebola patients reportedly fled an observation center, and response teams suspended activities, complicating infection surveillance and containment. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) cited authorities reporting over 10,700 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 5,200 deaths, predominantly in eastern DRC. The humanitarian agency urged all parties to protect civilians, uphold international humanitarian law, and ensure safe, unobstructed access for health workers and aid operations.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：東部での致死的な暴力がエボラ対策を妨害（国連）
triage.triage_reason: エボラの大規模流行（1万人超の症例、5千人超の死亡）が継続中で、暴力により対応活動が中断し封じ込めが困難になっており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 観察対象者が観察センターから逃走したことで感染追跡が困難になっており、暴力によるアクセス制限が流行制御の重大な障害となっている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases rise to 10,668, death toll nears 5,200
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 10,668 cases and about 5,200 deaths, a case fatality rate of 48.7 percent, according to the latest ministry data released on Friday covering up to November 3. The figures are a snapshot as of that date, and underscore continued transmission in DR Congo, with Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya warning that spread poses a threat to neighboring countries. The updated data reflect the ongoing challenge of containing a high-fatality disease in the region. Separately, Qazinform reported that a UK citizen tested positive for Ebola, highlighting potential imported cases amid the outbreak. The ministry update reinforces the scale of the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Mathis Blondeau, étudiant de 23 ans, meurt de la dengue en Asie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mathis Blondeau, a 23-year-old student, dies of dengue fever in Asia.
article.articleSummary: Mathis Blondeau, a 23-year-old student from Finistère, France, died on Tuesday, October 27, from dengue fever while traveling in Asia, notably Bali, Indonesia. The Rugby Club Quimpérois announced the death on Facebook on November 6. Blondeau studied at INSEEC in Lyon and had begun a year-long sabbatical after five years of study, with plans to return to France for work. He previously played as a scrum-half for Brittany; his father is a member of the club's board. A minute of silence and applause is scheduled for Sunday, November 8 at 15:00 before the Fédérale 3 derby against Concarneau, with the family in attendance at the stadium.

article.articleHeadline: छत्तीसगढ़ के सूरजपुर में कुत्ते के काटने से बच्ची की मौत, एक हफ्ते में यह दूसरी घटना
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Girl dies from a dog bite in Surajpur, Chhattisgarh; this is the second such incident in a week.
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old Neerja died at Medical College Hospital, Surajpur district, Chhattisgarh, 10 days after a stray dog bite in Kalyaanpur Gehlapara (Jaynagar area); initial treatment and anti-rabies vaccination were given, but she deteriorated and died, the hospital’s second dog-bite fatality in a week. Earlier, a woman from Navadhakki village in the Pratappur area died after a dog bite, developing rabies symptoms days later. The spate of deaths highlights risks from stray dogs and concerns over rabies vaccine availability and child safety across Surguja division. Expert Dr. CK Mishra advises: immediately wash the wound with running water and soap for at least 15 minutes, avoid home remedies, and seek immediate care for anti-rabies vaccination with a full course; deeper wounds may require anti-rabies serum around the wound, and interrupting vaccination is dangerous as rabies can be fatal if untreated.

triage.triage_reason: インドでは狂犬病は風土病であり、本事例は散発的な個別死亡例の報道であって、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はインドで風土病化しており、本記事は地域の野良犬による個別の咬傷死亡事例を報じたローカルニュース。ヒト-ヒト感染がなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 關日華：流感發病率處於高水平　料本月仍會有大量流感個案 (10:53) - 20261107
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guan Rihua: The influenza incidence rate is at a high level; it is expected that there will still be a large number of influenza cases this month (10:53) - 20261107.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s influenza season has recorded 29 pediatric severe influenza cases. Dr. Guan Rihua, former president of the Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases and an HKU expert, says influenza activity remains high, likely due to waning antibodies since vaccination, transmission. He expects November to bring many cases as cooler weather could boost spread; season may merge with winter peak. Severe pediatric influenza can deteriorate, with hypotension and multi‑organ involvement, possibly from a cytokine storm; abdominal pain with persistent vomiting may signal myocarditis. The 2026/27 flu vaccination program began in September, with schools vaccinating despite administrative delays. He warns of the XFG SARS‑CoV‑2 variant; updated vaccines may be needed if more than 6 months have passed since last infection or vaccination. RSV is active year‑round in Hong Kong; hygiene and masking are advised, and pregnant women/infants may pursue vaccination or monoclonal antibodies. AI tools may aid diagnosis under supervision.

triage.headline_ja: 關日華：流感發病率處於高水平　料本月仍會有大量流感個案

triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザとRSVに関する公衆衛生専門家のコメント記事。小児重症化例29件や合併症（心筋炎、サイトカインストーム等）への言及があり重症度は懸念されるが、季節性の通常範囲内の事象とみられる。新規変異株XFGへの言及もあるが詳細情報は不足。

article.articleHeadline: 首届中非公共卫生论坛成功举办 -- -- 共筑中非传染病防控新防线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The First China–Africa Public Health Forum Successfully Held — Building a New Line of Defense for Sino-African Infectious Disease Prevention and Control
article.articleSummary: China CDC and Africa CDC jointly hosted the first China–Africa Public Health Forum in Guangzhou, November 6–7, 2026, drawing 700 participants from more than 20 African countries, plus UNICEF, WHO, UNAIDS, UNFPA, the African Medicines Agency, PATH, CHAI, ASLM, and Africa Laboratory Professionals Association, as well as domestic institutions. The forum theme was Building a new line of defense for Sino-African infectious disease prevention and control and advancing the China–Africa Health Partnership Action. Topics covered global infectious disease challenges, surveillance, diagnostics and vaccine innovation; improving access to public health products, local production, tropical diseases, tuberculosis, and sexually transmitted infections. China CDC, Africa CDC, and UNICEF launched the Public Health Technical Assistance Project and a South-South Cooperation Program, and issued the China–Africa Initiative to strengthen pathogen detection, surveillance, emergency response, and public health workforce development, with local diagnostic validation. The event strengthens Sino-African health cooperation and Africa's public health resilience.

triage.headline_ja: 第1回中国・アフリカ公衆衛生フォーラムが成功裏に開催 ― 中国とアフリカの感染症予防管理の新たな防衛線を共に構築

article.articleHeadline: Brasil pode registrar 860 mil casos prováveis de dengue em 2027, aponta estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil could record 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027, study says.
article.articleSummary: Brazil could record 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027, according to a study by more than 130 specialists from eight countries submitted to the Ministry of Health. For the first time, projections also cover chikungunya, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, with more than 90,000 probable chikungunya cases expected in Brazil. Control efforts should focus on eliminating mosquito breeding sites and preventing standing water. The forecast comes despite a summer anticipated to be influenced by a super El Niño. The study underscores ongoing risk from Aedes aegypti–transmitted diseases in Brazil and highlights the need for vector-control measures to curb potential outbreaks. Authorities should prepare contingency plans and strengthen surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2027年にデング熱の推定症例数が86万件に達する可能性があると研究が指摘

triage.notes: この記事は2027年を見据えた将来予測研究の報道であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。保健省への提出研究であり政府の関心は示されているが、実際の症例データや重症度情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 79% người bệnh mạn tính bị xáo trộn sinh hoạt khi nhiễm RSV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 79% of patients with chronic conditions have their daily activities disrupted when infected with RSV.
article.articleSummary: RSV awareness week (Nov 2–8, 2026) highlights a global GSK survey of 6,041 adults (18+) with chronic conditions across 10 countries, showing RSV infection can markedly disrupt daily life. Among respondents with asthma (52%), COPD (45%), chronic kidney disease (CKD, 35%), cardiovascular disease (29%), and diabetes (27%), symptoms during respiratory infections are reported as more severe. Overall, 36% recover longer than expected, 25% seek primary care, and 18% visit emergency services. For those with prior RSV, 40% describe effects lasting a month or more, and 9% persist beyond a year. Severity remains high: 55% rate symptoms moderate to severe; 68% CKD/COPD, 64% cardiovascular, 63% asthma. In Vietnam, forecasts suggest 4.6 million RSV-related acute respiratory illnesses in adults 60+, with 200,000 hospitalizations and 18,000 related deaths. Yet 79% worry about RSV hindering chronic disease control; 46% haven’t discussed RSV with clinicians in 2 years.

triage.headline_ja: 慢性疾患患者の79%がRSV感染により日常生活に支障をきたす
triage.triage_reason: これは啓発週間に伴う国際調査結果の紹介記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はGSKによる国際的な意識調査結果の報告であり、ベトナムの将来予測値（推計）は言及されているが、実際の発生・流行報告ではない。RSVは既知の呼吸器感染症であり、新規性や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: deux nouveaux vaccins contre la souche Bundibugyo vont être prochainement testés en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: two new vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain will soon be tested in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri and North Kivu (including Beni), have killed more than 5,300 people since May; no vaccine currently targets the Bundibugyo strain. Two candidate vaccines will enter field trials in the coming weeks: one from the University of Oxford with an Indian pharmaceutical partner, and another from Moderna. WHO has endorsed these trials, alongside ongoing work with Ervebo against the Zaire strain, with initial results expected early next year. Separately, a British doctor who contracted Ebola while assisting response efforts in Beni has been repatriated to the United Kingdom and is being treated at London’s Royal Free Hospital in stable condition.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブンディブギョ株に対する2つの新ワクチンが近くコンゴ民主共和国で試験される

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A có lây qua sữa mẹ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can Influenza A be transmitted through breast milk?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A infection in Hanoi: A mother tests positive for influenza A (A(H1N1), A(H3N2)); symptoms include fever and cough. Influenza A is an acute respiratory illness spread by droplets; contagious from one day before symptoms to 5–7 days after onset, peaking days 1–3. There is no evidence that seasonal influenza transmits via breast milk; mothers can continue breastfeeding. Breast milk provides antibodies, though the infant remains exposed to droplets or contaminated surfaces. A 4-month-old is high risk for pneumonia, bronchiolitis, otitis media, dehydration, or respiratory failure. Precautions: wear a mask, wash hands for at least 20 seconds before handling the baby or feeding, cover coughs, clean surfaces, ventilate rooms, limit visitors, and avoid face-to-face contact while symptomatic. If needed, expressed milk can be given by a caregiver; antiviral therapy may be started within 48 hours of onset. Seek care for fever, worsening breathing, or dehydration in mother or baby.

article.articleHeadline: 兒科醫生關日華指今季兒童流感轉差快　呼籲家長提高警覺(陳佩彤報道)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pediatrician Guan Rihua says this season's flu in children is deteriorating rapidly; urges parents to be more vigilant (Reported by Chen Peitong).
article.articleSummary: As of November 7, 2026, Hong Kong records 29 pediatric influenza severe cases and 2 deaths, including a previously healthy 7-year-old girl who deteriorated and required ICU care. Guan Rihua, honorary clinical associate professor of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine at The University of Hong Kong, says community cross-infection is severe; often one sick person triggers illness in the whole household, fueling rampant respiratory infections in Hong Kong. Many children deteriorate rapidly after influenza, with sudden hypotension and multi-organ involvement, including liver and heart. Although it is November, influenza cases remain high and the season's duration is unpredictable, with concern that winter influenza could merge with the ongoing season, extending the outbreak and increasing severe outcomes if incidence remains high. He urges parents to receive influenza vaccination. Dry winter air may heighten transmission of COVID-19, influenza, and RSV—the 'three-virus strike'.

triage.headline_ja: 小児科医の関日華医師、今季の小児インフルエンザは急速に悪化していると指摘し、保護者に警戒を呼びかけ（陳佩彤報道）
triage.triage_reason: 香港で小児インフルエンザ重症例・死亡例が増加しており注視が必要だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等IHR基準には該当せず、現時点では地域内の季節性流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例であり、対象国リストに従いChinaに分類。季節性インフルエンザの重症化・死亡例増加が報告されているが、新規病原体や国際的拡大の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية تحذر من انتشار الحمى الصفراء في 9 دول أفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization Warns of the Spread of Yellow Fever in Nine African Countries
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever continues to threaten Africa, with 67 confirmed cases across nine countries: Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Guinea, Liberia, Togo, and Nigeria. The World Health Organization warns that cross-border movement, transmission by the mosquito vector, and uneven vaccination coverage are key factors driving transmission and expansion of the outbreak. The current health risk is assessed as regional medium and global low. The briefing notes vaccination gaps alongside vector-borne transmission as central drivers of the outbreak’s trajectory; fatalities, if any, are not reported in the summary. Ongoing cross-border spread is highlighted as a challenge for neighboring countries. Publication date: 2026-11-07.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、アフリカ9カ国で黄熱病が拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがアフリカ9カ国（うち対象国はガーナ）での黄熱病の国境を越えた拡大を警告しており、IHR基準2項目（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事では9カ国（ブルキナファソ、カメルーン、中央アフリカ共和国、コートジボワール、ガーナ、ギニア、リベリア、トーゴ、ナイジェリア）で黄熱病67例が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはガーナのみ。死亡者数や重症度の詳細は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Two more children of a school test positive for shigellosis in Keralam's Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis outbreak in Kozhikode, Keralam, linked to Meppayil Senior Basic School. Two more children from Meppayil Senior Basic School have been diagnosed; the three admitted to Government District Hospital are aged 7, 8 and 10, with initial tests negative and all three now testing positive by blood assays. Affected children presented with vomiting, fever and diarrhoea; onset began last Friday, with 104 people reporting similar symptoms over Saturday to Monday. Those affected had eaten egg curry and curd as part of school lunch. Public health teams from health and education departments, led by the District Medical Officer, inspected the school. Health workers visited 950 homes to distribute oral rehydration salts (ORS); wells at 290 properties were chlorinated as a precaution. The outbreak response emphasizes food handling and water sanitation in the school community.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州コーリコードの学校で児童2名が追加で赤痢菌（シゲラ症）陽性
triage.triage_reason: 学校内の集団食中毒（シゲラ症）で104名が症状を呈し入院例もあるが、地域保健当局が既に対応中で国際的拡大の兆候はない。水源汚染の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 学校給食（卵カレー・カード）が原因と疑われる集団食中毒。井戸水の塩素処理など水系感染対策も実施されており、地域内の衛生状態の継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bantul Tertinggi, Ini Sebaran 576 Kasus Leptospirosis di DIY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bantul Has the Highest Number of Leptospirosis Cases in DIY: Here Is the Distribution of 576 Cases
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in Indonesia’s Special Administrative Region of Yogyakarta (DIY) recorded 576 cases and 23 deaths in 2026, with Bantul highest at 250 cases and 9 deaths (data through July 2026). Sleman followed with 196 cases (2 deaths; through Oct 2026), Kulon Progo 61 cases (7 deaths; through Oct 2026), Kota Yogyakarta 34 cases (2 deaths; through Aug 2026), and Gunungkidul 35 cases (3 deaths; through July 2026). The disease is caused by Leptospira bacteria, transmitted from animals—primarily rats—via urine that contaminates water, mud, and soil. Incubation is 2–14 days, occasionally up to 30 days. The most affected age group is 46–64 years. High-risk factors include geography and farming/labor near rivers and irrigation channels; delayed health-seeking worsens outcomes. Prevention: PHBS, handwashing, PPE (boots, gloves), wound care, rodent control, environmental sanitation. Seek medical care promptly if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: バントゥル県が最多、DIY州におけるレプトスピラ症576症例の分布
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ジョグジャカルタ特別州で576症例・23名の死亡が報告されており、重症度と環境曝露の継続性からフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症はインドネシアで季節性・地域流行性の疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし死亡率と環境曝露の継続性から国内公衆衛生上の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: 5198 وفاة بفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: 5,198 deaths from the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: the Ministry of Health reports 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths as of 3 November 2026, a case fatality rate of 48.7%, according to the ministry’s website. The ongoing transmission continues across the DRC, underscoring a persistent, high-mortality outbreak. Jean Kasia, director-general of Africa CDC, warned that the virus poses a threat to neighboring countries as it spreads regionally from within the DRC. The updated totals highlight the severity of the outbreak and the need for sustained surveillance and cross-border readiness to prevent spillover. This situation continues to be monitored by regional health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスにより5,198人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.7%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中で、Africa CDCが近隣国への拡大リスクを警告しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDCが近隣国への拡大懸念を表明しているが、具体的な越境感染事例は記事内に記載なし。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 台南第17例境外移入登革熱 跨南高工作、返國4天發病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan’s 17th imported dengue fever case; worked in southern Taiwan and Kaohsiung, onset four days after returning to Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Tainan City reports its 17th imported dengue case. A woman from Yongkang District who travelled to Vietnam for a trip Oct 28–Nov 1, then returned to Kaohsiung for work and developed fever, headache, and myalgia four days later. NS1 rapid test was positive and PCR confirmed dengue fever; onset was Nov 4, and she sought care Nov 5 at Annan Hospital. Authorities conducted emergency fogging, environmental cleanup, and planned indoor/outdoor chemical control around her residence. As of Nov 6, Taiwan had 238 dengue cases: 17 locally transmitted, 221 imported; Vietnam accounted for the majority of imported cases, followed by the Philippines and Indonesia. Mayor Huang Wei-che urged preventive measures and prompt medical care for febrile travelers. Dengue Prevention Center Director Li Cui-feng said winter does not erase risk, noting 1,419 positive containers Jan–Oct, mainly barrels/urns/buckets, and emphasized the four-step approach: inspect, drain, clean, scrub to eliminate breeding sources.

triage.headline_ja: 台南市で17例目の輸入性デング熱症例、南部・高雄での勤務後に帰国4日目で発症
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入性デング熱の個別症例報告であり、対象国（ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシア）はあくまで渡航先・感染源として言及されているに過ぎず、これら対象国自体でのアウトブレイクを示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（対象国外）における輸入性デング熱サーベイランスに関するルーチン報告。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは感染推定地として言及されているのみで、これら対象国内での流行事象を報じるものではないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño y la "tormenta perfecta" para el dengue: por qué la prevención debe empezar antes del verano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño and the "perfect storm" for dengue: why prevention must begin before summer.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk in Argentina, Uruguay, and southern Brazil could rise as El Niño reshapes temperature, rainfall, and humidity, accelerating Aedes aegypti development. The World Meteorological Organization expects El Niño to persist through February 2027 and intensify toward late 2026, with regional effects including heavy rainfall and heat. Mosquito breeding thrives in water-filled containers (tires, pots, buckets, troughs, gutters, and other objects); drought-driven water storage also creates stagnant sites. Eggs can survive months on dry surfaces and resume development after rain, while higher temperatures speed virus maturation within the mosquito. Surveillance via ovitraps provides early vector signals to guide actions such as junk-removal campaigns, targeted fumigation, and medical on-call readiness. Regions to monitor include northeast and center Argentina, northern Argentina, Uruguay, and southern Brazil, focusing on rainfall, soil moisture, humidity, cloudiness, and post-storm temperatures.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョとデング熱の「パーフェクトストーム」：なぜ予防は夏前に始めるべきか
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、エルニーニョ現象によるデング熱リスク上昇の予測・予防啓発記事であるため、現時点でのピックアップ基準は満たさないが、季節的リスク拡大の可能性があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチン・ウルグアイ・ブラジル南部を対象にした気候要因によるデング熱リスク予測であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイク発生の報告はない。対象国の中ではブラジル（南部）のみが言及されているため、ウルグアイ・アルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: الصحةُ العالميّة تحذّر من انتشار الحمى الصّفراء في 9 دول أفريقيّة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of the spread of yellow fever in nine African countries.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever continues to spread across nine African countries, with 67 cases reported in Burkina Faso, Cameroon, the Central African Republic, Ivory Coast, Ghana, Guinea, Liberia, Togo, and Nigeria as of 7 November 2026, per the World Health Organization. Key risk factors include cross-border movement, mosquito vectors, and uneven vaccination coverage, with regional risk deemed moderate and global risk low. Separately, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ministry of Health reports 10,668 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 5,198 deaths (case fatality rate 48.7%) as of 3 November, indicating an ongoing outbreak. The Africa CDC Director-General warned the Ebola threat could affect neighboring countries while the outbreak persists within the DRC. These dual health events highlight persistent vectors-driven outbreaks in West and Central Africa and the need for cross-border surveillance and vaccination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、アフリカ9カ国での黄熱病の拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクの2つに該当し、DRCのエボラ（致死率48.7%）とアフリカ9カ国での黄熱病拡大という複数の重大イベントが同時進行しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は黄熱病（9カ国、ブルキナファソ・カメルーン・中央アフリカ共和国・コートジボワール・ガーナ・ギニア・リベリア・トーゴ・ナイジェリア）とDRCのエボラ出血熱の2つの異なる公衆衛生事象を扱う複合記事。対象国リストに該当するのはGhanaとDRCのみで、他の黄熱病発生国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外した。エボラはDRCで進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（致死率48.7%）であり、Africa CDCが近隣国への拡大リスクを警告している点が特に重要。

article.articleHeadline: 台南女赴越南返台確診登革熱 工作地在高雄 兩市啟動緊急防治
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan woman diagnosed with dengue fever after returning from Vietnam; workplace in Kaohsiung; both cities launch emergency prevention and control measures.
article.articleSummary: One new imported dengue fever case in Tainan City: a woman in her 40s from Yongkang District, who joined a Vietnam staff trip Oct 28–Nov 1, returned home asymptomatic, then developed fever, headache and myalgia on Nov 4, confirmed by NS1 rapid test and PCR at Annan Hospital on Nov 5. This is Tainan's 17th imported dengue case this year; Kaohsiung City assisted with emergency prevention, including fogging, breeding-site cleanup, and density surveys around the residence. As of Nov 6, Taiwan totals 238 dengue cases for the year (17 local, 221 imported); Vietnam is the top source for imported cases, followed by the Philippines and Indonesia. Public health guidance emphasizes protective measures (light clothing, DEET-based repellent) for travelers and prompt medical care if fever/flu-like symptoms, with travel history disclosed. Dengue Control Center Director Li Cui-feng notes vigilance remains; in Jan–Oct this year, 1,419 positive breeding-source containers were found in Tainan, mainly barrels, jars, urns, and pots (64.48%).

triage.headline_ja: 台南女性がベトナムから帰国後にデング熱と確診、勤務地は高雄、両市が緊急防疫を開始
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入性デング熱の単発症例であり、既存の監視・防疫体制内で対応されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、社会的関心も高くない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（対象国リスト外）で発生した輸入デング熱症例。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは感染経路（渡航先）として言及されているのみで、各国内での発生事例ではないため、verified_locationsへの計上は参考情報として付記。地元自治体（台南・高雄）による通常の防疫対応であり、既に238例中221例が輸入例という既知のパターン内。

article.articleHeadline: 'โรคแอนแทรกซ์' คืออะไร? โรคติดต่อร้ายแรงจากสัตว์สู่คน เผยอาการเริ่มต้น
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is 'Anthrax'? A serious zoonotic disease transmitted from animals to humans. Initial symptoms revealed.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax (Bacillus anthracis) is a serious zoonotic disease reported in Thailand with sporadic occurrences in Don Tan, Mukdahan; Tak; Kanchanaburi; Phitsanulok; Chiang Mai; and Phichit, though not widespread. It persists via durable soil spores and can contaminate livestock and pets. Animals susceptible include cattle, buffalo, goats, and sheep; pigs, horses, dogs, and cats can also be infected, often after consuming raw carcasses. In humans, three forms are described: cutaneous—initial pain, swelling, and a black central eschar from handling contaminated meat; ingestion—abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, fever, anorexia, sometimes bloody stool; inhalational—respiratory symptoms with fever, sore throat, dry cough, progressing to breathing difficulty and rapid death. Prevention stresses avoiding contact with infected animals or carcasses, PPE when exposure risk exists, thorough hand and tool cleaning, and ensuring safe, well-cooked meat. Notify veterinary authorities if unusual animal deaths occur.

triage.headline_ja: 「炭疽菌」とは何か？動物からヒトへ感染する重篤な人獣共通感染症。初期症状を公開
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内における炭疽の一般的な解説記事であり、新規の大規模発生や急増を示す情報はないが、人獣共通感染症として継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は炭疽の一般的な解説・啓発記事で、散発的な発生地域（ムクダハン、ターク、カンチャナブリ、ピッサヌローク、チェンマイ、ピチット）の説明が中心。具体的な新規症例数や急増の報告はなく、教育的内容が主体。

article.articleHeadline: ไขข้อสงสัย นั่งชักโครกสาธารณะ เสี่ยงติดฝีดาษลิงหรือไม่ ดร.อนันต์ มีคำตอบ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clearing up the doubts: Does sitting on a public toilet put you at risk of monkeypox? Dr. Anant has the answer.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) transmission via public toilet seats is described as very unlikely but theoretically possible. A Thai health expert notes that Mpox, an Orthopoxvirus, can survive on dry surfaces at room temperature for hours to days, with live virus detected on toilet-seat surfaces in patient bathrooms. However, intact skin provides a strong barrier, making direct sitting transmission unlikely. WHO data indicate mpox infections almost always arise from close physical contact with lesions or with items that retain crusts and moisture (e.g., towels, bed linens). Transmission through hard surfaces like toilet seats has few confirmed reports as a main route. To minimize residual risk, clean the seat with 70% alcohol or disinfectant wipes before use and wash hands with soap after bathroom use; these measures can destroy the viral envelope and prevent infection.

triage.headline_ja: 疑問を解消:公衆トイレの便座に座るとサル痘に感染するリスクはあるのか?アナン博士が回答
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染事例や流行を報じるものではなく、専門家による一般的な感染経路に関する解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: タイ発だが、特定の症例報告やアウトブレイクではなく、Mpoxの感染経路に関する一般的なQ&A解説記事。

article.articleHeadline: Dua dari 29 Pramusaji Warung Pangku di Gresik Terindikasi HIV dan Sifilis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two of the 29 waiters at Warung Pangku in Gresik are suspected of having HIV and syphilis.
article.articleSummary: Two of 29 staff at Warung Pangku stalls in Gresik Regency, East Java, tested positive for sexually transmitted infections during a joint operation health screening conducted from 6 November 2026 night to 7 November 2026 dawn. One waiter was HIV-positive and another tested positive for syphilis; both were referred to the Gresik Health Office for follow-up care. The remaining individuals were counseled and released after the screening. The five-location sweep targeted Desa Karang Kiring (Kebomas District), Kelurahan Sidorukun (Gresik District), Jalan Siti Fatimah Binti Maimun area near Telaga Ngipik, Duduksampeyan District, and Dusun Betiring, Desa Banjarsari, Cerme District. The screening serves as early detection to identify health risks and support preventive and social welfare efforts, with the two HIV/syphilis cases handed to health authorities for treatment.

triage.headline_ja: グレシックの「ワルン・パングク」の従業員29人中2人がHIVおよび梅毒の疑いと判明
triage.triage_reason: ローカルな性感染症スクリーニングの結果報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域保健当局による通常の性感染症検査活動の一環であり、感染症アウトブレイクの兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu Poultry Crisis: Nearly 50,000 Chickens Die in Six Days, Farmers Face Heavy Losses Ahead of Diwali
article.articleSummary: Nearly 50,000 chickens died within six days across several villages in Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district amid a suspected outbreak, just ahead of Diwali. While farmers say 40,000-50,000 birds perished, district administration puts the toll at about 26,000. Unusual symptoms—legs stretched backwards and wings spread—raise alarm as the mass die-off continues. Preliminary laboratory tests have ruled out avian influenza, though the exact cause remains unidentified; authorities have dispatched additional samples, including feed and water, to specialized labs (including in Bhopal) for confirmation and containment guidance. Economically, farmers face heavy losses given upfront investments in chicks and feed; costs cited include a chick price of Rs 47-48, feed Rs 2,500-2,600 per 50-kg, and electricity bills of Rs 10,000-20,000. One farmer, Mohan, estimates a Rs 40-50 lakh investment, seeking relief as the outbreak unfolds.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州の養鶏危機：6日間で約5万羽のニワトリが死亡、ディワリ前に農家が大きな損失に直面
triage.triage_reason: 大量死の原因は鳥インフルエンザが予備検査で否定されており、原因不明の状態が続いているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 鳥インフルエンザは予備検査で否定されており、原因病原体は未特定。ヒトへの感染報告はなく、家禽の経済的被害が主な懸念事項。追加検査結果の続報待ち。

article.articleHeadline: Violencia en este de República Democrática del Congo cobra vidas y afecta respuesta a ébola, dice ONU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Violence in this part of the Democratic Republic of the Congo claims lives and hampers the Ebola response, says the UN.
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed civilian lives and disrupted the Ebola response, according to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA). In Cantine-Aloya, Beni Territory, North Kivu, at least 30 civilians were killed, homes burned, and a health center destroyed, with several patients among the dead. People who had been in contact with Ebola patients fled the observation center, and response teams suspended operations in the area, hampering contact tracing and outbreak containment. Authorities have reported more than 10,700 confirmed Ebola cases and over 5,200 deaths to date, largely in eastern DRC. OCHA urged all parties to protect civilians, respect international humanitarian law, and ensure safe, unimpeded access for humanitarian and health workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部での暴力により人命が失われ、エボラ対応に支障、国連が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで10,700例超・死者5,200人超という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、暴力により接触者追跡や封じ込め対応が妨げられ感染拡大リスクが高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 観察対象者が接触者追跡センターから逃亡したことで、感染拡大のリスクがさらに高まっている点に留意。国連人道問題調整事務所(OCHA)が人道支援者・医療従事者への安全なアクセス確保を要請。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Gets Shs 102bn Grant for Epidemic Responses
article.articleSummary: Uganda will mobilise US$25 million (about UShs 102.2 billion) from the Pandemic Fund to strengthen epidemic prevention, detection and response. Africa CDC Director‑General Dr Jean Kaseya announced the initiative after meetings with Vice President Jessica Alupo and Health Minister Dr Chris Baryomunsi in Kampala on 6 November 2026, aiming to bolster Uganda's epidemic preparedness following its Ebola outbreaks earlier this year and cross-border Ebola response with the Democratic Republic of Congo. Uganda has joined the Africa CDC Governing Board, and Dr Col Henry Kyobe Bosa was appointed Africa CDC Country Director for Uganda. Africa CDC cited early intervention, transparent reporting and regional cooperation as key to stopping outbreaks before escalation. The financing would be mobilised through the Pandemic Fund, but timing and programme allocations remain unspecified, signaling closer cooperation to strengthen surveillance, laboratory capacity and emergency response.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、感染症対応のため102億ウガンダシリング(約2500万米ドル)の助成金を獲得
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はウガンダの過去のエボラ流行対応を踏まえた資金調達・体制強化に関する報道であり、新規の感染症発生や症例情報を伝えるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はAfrica CDCとウガンダ政府によるPandemic Fundを通じた資金調達の発表であり、過去のエボラ流行やDRCとの国境を越えた対応歴に言及しているが、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、DRCも記事の主題ではないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Center for Disease Control Announces State of Alert: No Ebola Cases in Libya, Warnings Issued for Travelers as Outbreak Spreads
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May 2026 and is the largest for this strain and the second-largest Ebola outbreak overall. WHO reports 9,668 confirmed cases and 4,649 deaths; case fatality about 48% (4,646 of 9,637). The disease has crossed borders to Kenya (9 cases) and Nigeria (1); past spillovers to Uganda and France have ended. The outbreak is expanding and not yet controlled. Over 31,000 contacts are under monitoring; 66 health zones across eight provinces are affected, with Ituri hardest hit. Healthcare workers account for 301 infections and 48 deaths. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists; transmission occurs via direct contact with infected fluids, contaminated surfaces, close contact with travelers, unsafe burials, and handling infected animals. Diagnosis is by PCR. Libya reports no confirmed or suspected cases; authorities maintain heightened surveillance and issue traveler warnings; 21-day exposure monitoring for contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病予防管理センターが警戒態勢を発表：リビアにエボラ症例なし、感染拡大に伴い渡航者への警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは過去最大規模で、致死率約48%、未制御のまま拡大しており、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例も確認されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はリビアにおける警戒態勢発表だが、実際の発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州など8州66保健区）であり、リビアは症例なし・監視強化のみ。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境例もあるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS recommande des essais de deux vaccins contre Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO recommends trials of two Ebola vaccines in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in the eastern region after the Bundibugyo strain was declared in May 2026. The outbreak has killed more than 5,300 people; no vaccine specific to Bundibugyo is yet available. On November 4, the World Health Organization recommended adding two candidate vaccines to ongoing clinical trials in the DRC, joining Ervebo, a vaccine approved against the Zaire (Zaïre) strain. Early results are described as very positive, with the candidates inducing an immune response. Trials in the DRC are expected to start within three to four weeks, with initial results early next year. Vaccinations will be offered to high-risk contacts of cases. A parallel trial is evaluating potential treatments, with results anticipated in coming months.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱に対する2種類のワクチン試験を推奨
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続し、5,300人以上の死者が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響と国際的対応（WHO主導のワクチン試験）が確認されるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に特化したワクチンは未承認であり、WHOが新規候補ワクチン2種の臨床試験追加を推奨。既存のErvebo（Zaire株用）と並行して高リスク接触者への接種が予定されている。死者数5,300人超という点から既に深刻な公衆衛生危機であり、continued transmissionの可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 一旦发病，致死率近100%！两男子接连确诊，医生提醒："小狗不会带毒"，是最危险的错觉
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Once symptoms appear, the fatality rate is nearly 100%! Two men diagnosed in quick succession; doctors warn: "A puppy can't carry rabies"—the most dangerous misconception.
article.articleSummary: Two men in Wuhan, China, diagnosed with rabies and in ICU, illustrate the danger from newborn puppies. The first developed hydrophobia, throat tightness, and difficulty swallowing after a hand bite by a puppy more than two months earlier; the puppy was unvaccinated and no wound care was given. The second, exposed in July to a puppy under one month old that licked a minor wound, also delayed care. Rabies is nearly always fatal after symptoms appear. The report stresses that a puppy’s age or apparent health does not indicate risk; even tiny or healing wounds can transmit rabies. Post-exposure prophylaxis should start promptly after any exposure. Steps: immediate wound washing with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, then iodine; seek care to assess exposure and vaccinate; for high-risk exposure, administer rabies immunoglobulin plus vaccine. Preventative measures: vaccinate pets and avoid unknown or unvaccinated animals, especially for children.

triage.headline_ja: 一旦発症すれば致死率はほぼ100%！男性2人が相次いで確診、医師が警告「子犬は毒を持たない」は最も危険な誤解
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は既知の風土病的疾患であり、個別事例の啓発記事であって、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限のいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は中国国内で散発的に発生する既知の疾患であり、本記事は予防啓発目的の個別症例報告。公衆衛生上の新たな脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Équateur : lancement d'une campagne de vaccination contre le choléra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ecuador: Launch of a vaccination campaign against cholera.
article.articleSummary: Cholera vaccination campaign launched in Mbandaka, Equateur Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to curb the outbreak. From 6 to 12 November 2026, teams will cover nine health zones, vaccinating about 1.5 million people aged one year and older. As of 7 November 2026, the province reports 142 cholera cases and 18 deaths since the epidemic began. The launch occurred at Mbandaka Market 2, with Body Robert Ilonga Bompoko presiding; interim Governor Thomas Boyenge Ifaso urged local authorities, community leaders, and health partners to support field teams and extend vaccination to additional affected zones in future phases. The effort is led by the Ministry of Health, with support from the National Cholera Elimination Program and the Congo River without Cholera project, funded by Gavi, WHO, and UNICEF.

triage.headline_ja: エクアトゥール州：コレラワクチン接種キャンペーンの開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国エクアトゥール州で致死率の高いコレラ流行が継続しており、大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーン（150万人対象）が実施されるなど、国際機関の支援を要する公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域に『Republic of Ecuador』が含まれているが、これはフランス語『Équateur（エクアトゥール州）』の誤認識によるものであり、実際の発生地はDRCのエクアトゥール州（ムバンダカ）である。142症例・18死亡（致死率約12.7%）とコレラとしては高い致死率であり、Gavi・WHO・UNICEFの支援を受けた大規模ワクチン接種が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ghi nhận hơn 170.000 ca sốt xuất huyết, cảnh báo biến chứng nặng ở người lớn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 170,000 dengue fever cases recorded, warning of severe complications in adults.
article.articleSummary: From January to October 2026, Vietnam recorded over 170,000 dengue cases, up 26% from 2025, with 21 deaths. Southern Vietnam accounted for 66.8% of cases; Central Highlands 17.5%; Central Vietnam 9.8%; Northern Vietnam 5.9%. All four dengue serotypes circulate; DENV-1 and DENV-2 predominate (~90% of typed samples), with DENV-3 reemerging since late 2024. In Đồng Nai, two women aged 38 and 59 died of dengue shock (one with diabetes). A 23-year-old man in Ho Chi Minh City without comorbidity developed dengue shock and respiratory failure, requiring dialysis and ECMO. The dangerous phase often occurs days 3–7; warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, altered consciousness, bleeding, or oliguria. Takeda Qdenga vaccine (VNVC) has been used since Sept 2024 for ages 4+, with a two-dose schedule; over 32 million doses distributed by July 2026; efficacy >80% against symptomatic dengue and >90% against severe disease. Adults, especially with comorbidities or obesity, should consider vaccination; continue vector control.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例が17万件を超え、成人の重症合併症に警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 2026年にベトナムでデング熱症例が17万件超（前年比26%増）、死亡21例、健康な成人でもショック・呼吸不全に至る重症例が報告されており、WPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ）を複数満たし、政府・メディアの注目も高いためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり季節的増加は例年見られるが、今年は症例数増加・DENV-3の再出現・基礎疾患のない若年成人の重症化例が報告されており、ワクチン接種推進を含む公的対応が行われている。国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、重症化動向の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : James Swan réaffirme le soutien de la Monusco dans la lutte contre l'épidémie d'Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: James Swan reaffirms MONUSCO's support in the fight against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: James Swan, the UN Secretary-General's Special Representative in the DRC and head of MONUSCO, reaffirmed on Nov 6 in Bunia MONUSCO's support to the Congolese government in battling the Ebola outbreak in Ituri. Ituri faces two key challenges: ongoing armed-group insecurity and Ebola affecting multiple communities. Swan underscored that civilian protection remains MONUSCO's priority, with intensified blue-helmet presence in Bamande, Irumu, and in certain areas of Djugu. Beyond security, MONUSCO aids the Ebola response by logistics support and by facilitating access for humanitarian and health teams, while securing health facilities and operations in Rwampara and Mongwalu (Djugu), as well as Marabo, Nyakunde, and Niania. He reaffirmed continued collaboration with authorities, humanitarian actors, and communities to protect civilians and strengthen the outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ：ジェームズ・スワン氏、エボラ出血熱との闘いにおけるMONUSCOの支援を再確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、国連(MONUSCO)が支援を継続している。複数のコミュニティに影響し、治安不安も絡む複雑な公衆衛生危機でありフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには赤道ギニア、ルワンダ、マリ等が含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCイツリ州（Djugu, Irumu, Bunia等）のエボラ流行のみを扱っており、他国は無関係なジオタグノイズと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Surabaya Raih Adinkes Award 2026 Atas Keberhasilan Kendalikan HIV/AIDS, TBC, dan Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surabaya City Government Wins the Adinkes Award 2026 for Successful Control of HIV/AIDS, TB, and Malaria.
article.articleSummary: Surabaya, Indonesia, receives the AIDS-TB-Malaria Award 2026 from the Association of Indonesian Health Offices (Adinkes) for strengthening prevention and control of HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis (TB), and malaria. The award recognizes cross-sector collaboration and funded programs, with budgets flowing from the city health office (Dinkes), non-health agencies, corporate social responsibility (CSR), Baznas, philanthropy, and village-level allocations. HIV/AIDS efforts include expanded risk-group education, screening, PMTCT, widespread HIV testing through community health centers (puskesmas), hospitals and clinics, ARV access, counseling, and nutrition support for people living with HIV (PLHIV). TB control emphasizes active screening, contact tracing, preventive therapy, and patient support; 63 puskesmas conduct case finding, reaching 78.98% of targets as of October 2026. Malaria remains locally eliminated, backed by ongoing surveillance, early diagnosis, vector/environment control, and standard treatment. Surabaya targets elimination of all three diseases by 2030, with intensified screening, treatment, and stigma reduction.

triage.headline_ja: スラバヤ市、HIV/AIDS・結核・マラリアの制御成功でアディンケス・アワード2026を受賞
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の制御成功を称える行政表彰に関する記事であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は既存疾患（HIV/AIDS、結核、マラリア）対策の成功事例・表彰に関する内容であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية: أكثر من 10 آلاف إصابة بايبولا و5 آلاف وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 10,000 Ebola cases and 5,000 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached more than 10,000 confirmed cases and 5,000 deaths, according to official data up to November 1, 2026. The outbreak has spread across eight provinces, complicating response efforts and presenting substantial logistical challenges for frontline public health teams in the field. Early detection of cases, provision of appropriate medical care, and thorough contact tracing remain the cornerstones of containment and reducing transmission in affected communities. Health teams are continuing to reach affected areas and to strengthen community awareness about the importance of promptly reporting symptoms and adhering to preventive measures to support containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ感染者1万人超、死者5千人超
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が8州に拡大し、1万人超の感染・5千人超の死亡という極めて深刻な規模に達しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率約50%の大規模アウトブレイクで8州に拡大。国際的な支援と封じ込め強化が急務とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: 67 yellow fever cases reported in nine African countries
article.articleSummary: From January to October 2026, 67 confirmed yellow fever cases and 18 deaths were reported across nine African countries: Côte d'Ivoire (30 cases, 10 deaths), Burkina Faso (15 cases, 3 deaths), Cameroon (9 cases, 1 death), Nigeria (4 cases, 1 death), Ghana (4 cases, 3 deaths), Liberia (1 laboratory-confirmed case), Central African Republic (2 cases, no deaths), Guinea (1 case, no deaths), and Togo (1 case, no deaths). Data are as of October 12. Transmission continues in the African Region, with recent outbreaks concentrated mainly in West Africa near borders. On October 27, WHO assessed the regional public health risk as moderate and global risk as low. Factors driving spread include cross-border movement, uneven vaccination coverage, gaps in surveillance and laboratory testing, resource shortages, and limited access to some communities. Vaccination—one dose providing lifelong protection—remains the primary prevention strategy.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ9カ国で黄熱病67例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大リスク」の2つが該当し、複数国にまたがる継続的な黄熱病流行でWHOがリスク評価を行っている点からフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は西アフリカ・中央アフリカの9カ国（コートジボワール、ブルキナファソ、カメルーン、ナイジェリア、ガーナ、リベリア、中央アフリカ共和国、ギニア、トーゴ）における黄熱病流行を報告。対象国リストに該当するのはガーナのみ。WHOは地域リスクをmoderate、グローバルリスクをlowと評価済み。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kota dan Kabupaten Sukabumi Bersinergi Tanggulangi Tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sukabumi City and Regency Health Offices Synergize to Tackle Tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Sukabumi City and Sukabumi Regency Health Offices held a cross-border coordination meeting on 6 November 2026 at Hotel Balcony to tackle Tuberculosis amid high cross-border movement. Leaders stressed integrated TB control across both administrations to boost case detection, ensure continuous treatment, and reduce transmission. The collaboration targets residents who commute between areas, aiming to raise case detection rates and prevent interruptions in therapy. Planned actions include stronger border-area communication, regular data exchange on health issues, enhanced surveillance and early warning for infectious diseases and potential Extraordinary Health Events (KLB), synchronized programs, improved referral and service delivery for cross-border populations, and joint monitoring and evaluation. The goal is a strengthened early-detection system to break TB transmission across Sukabumi Raya. Keywords: TB, cross-border coordination, surveillance, outbreak readiness, Sukabumi City, Sukabumi Regency.

triage.headline_ja: スカブミ市・県保健局、結核対策で連携強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策に関する行政間連携会議の報道であり、異常な発生や急増を示す情報はなく、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地方流行病であり、本記事は平時の行政対策強化に関する報道。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: होशियारपुर में डेंगू का प्रकोप जारी, मरीजों का आंकड़ा 65 तक पहुंचा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue outbreak continues in Hoshiarpur; patient count has reached 65.
article.articleSummary: As of November 7, 2026, dengue outbreaks in Hoshiarpur district have reached 65 cases, with 5 chikungunya cases reported. Health authorities intensified prevention through awareness campaigns and door-to-door checks under Civil Surgeon Dr. Mandeep Kamal and District Epidemiologist Dr. Jagdeep Singh. Surveillance teams canvassed colleges, universities, and dengue hotspots, inspecting 1,623 houses and identifying 37 mosquito larval sites. Larvae were destroyed on site, and larvicidal spray was applied where needed. Nine teams are conducting daily house-to-house surveys in Hoshiarpur city, focusing on water-collecting vessels and other potential breeding sites. Officials urged residents to eliminate standing water and cooperate with the campaign to curb transmission of dengue, chikungunya, and other mosquito-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: ホシャルプルでデング熱の流行続く、患者数65人に達する
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱の流行で、当局による対策が実施されているが、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生インパクトを示す情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 地方自治体レベルでの蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）の季節的流行であり、地方当局が独自に対応中。重症度や死亡者数の情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns of yellow fever spread across nine African countries
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreaks persist across nine African countries, with 67 confirmed cases reported in Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Guinea, Liberia, Togo and Nigeria. As of 7 November 2026, cross-border population movement, the presence of mosquitoes capable of transmitting the disease, and varying vaccination coverage are cited as key drivers of continued transmission and potential geographic spread. The World Health Organization assesses the regional public health risk as moderate and the global risk as low, indicating concern for spread within the region but not heightened global threat at this time.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカ9カ国で黄熱病が拡大していると警告
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病がアフリカ9カ国（ブルキナファソ、カメルーン、中央アフリカ共和国、コートジボワール、ガーナ、ギニア、リベリア、トーゴ、ナイジェリア）で67例確認され、越境移動や媒介蚊の存在、ワクチン接種率のばらつきにより地域的拡大のリスクが指摘されており、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに含まれるのはガーナのみ。他の発生国（コートジボワール、トーゴ、中央アフリカ共和国、カメルーン、ブルキナファソ、リベリア、ギニア、ナイジェリア）は対象国リスト外のため除外。WHOはすでに地域リスクを「中程度」、世界リスクを「低」と評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Wie der Entdecker des Virus die Lage im Kongo einschätzt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: How the discoverer of the virus assesses the situation in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 10,000 confirmed infections and 5,000 deaths, with figures likely undercounted due to limited lab access in the east. It began in Ituri province, likely Mongbwalu, and has now reached nine provinces, with the epicenter shifting toward North Kivu. Rambunya shows declining new infections, but risk remains higher in distant regions and cities like Kisangani. Goma has reported cases; a Bunia-born woman who attended a funeral there was infected, but she and her contacts were isolated, with no secondary spread. Uganda reported Kampala cases but no large outbreak. More than half of deaths occur outside treatment centers, signaling undetected transmission clusters. Kinshasa's INRB, led by Jean-Jacques Muyembe, has sequenced viruses, finding no mutations. Nigeria and Kenya reported imported cases on a flight; both were isolated with no transmission. Africa CDC and RKI stress preparedness; Ebola is as much political as medical.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：発見者がコンゴの状況をどう評価しているか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で確定感染者1万人超、死者5000人超に達し9州に拡大、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアでも輸入症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治療施設外での死亡が半数以上を占めることから、未検出の感染クラスター存在の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Film Zona Merah Rilis Teaser Poster, Usung Wabah Zombie Terbesar di Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Red Zone film releases teaser poster, boasting the largest zombie outbreak in Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Zona Merah teaser poster reveals Indonesia's largest zombie outbreak, centered in Kota Rimbalaya. Screenplay Films confirms Zona Merah will premiere in Indonesian cinemas on 14 January 2027, following a teaser trailer shown at Synchronize Fest on 16 October. The poster depicts a low-flying plane amid a sea of the undead, a ruined runway, and smoke, signaling civilization collapse under an unstoppable virus. Directed by Sidharta Tata and co-directed by Fajar Martha Santosa, the survival-thriller follows Maya (Aghniny Haque) and her brother Adi (Devano) as they shelter in an emergency camp while the outbreak spreads. With political turmoil and government misinformation, survivors confront both the undead and distrust about who is infected. Executive producer Luna Maya leads the project, aiming to push Indonesian horror-action cinema. Release 14 January 2027.

triage.headline_ja: 映画『ゾーン・メラ』のティザーポスター公開、インドネシア最大のゾンビ大発生を描く
triage.triage_reason: これは実際の感染症イベントではなく、映画作品に関するエンターテインメント記事であるため公衆衛生上の意味を持たない。
triage.notes: 記事はフィクション映画の宣伝であり、実在の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Razia Satpol PP Gresik di Lima Lokasi, 29 Orang Diamankan, Dua Positif HIV dan Sifilis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gresik Satpol PP raids five locations, 29 people detained, two test positive for HIV and syphilis.
article.articleSummary: Five locations in Gresik Regency, Indonesia, were raided on 6 November 2026, from 21:00 to 23:58 WIB, with 29 people detained for health checks and narcotics testing. A joint operation by Satpol PP, Polres Gresik, Subdenpom V/4-2 Gresik, BNNK Gresik, the Health Office, and MUI Gresik targeted Desa Karang Kiring (Kebomas), Kelurahan Sidorukun (Gresik), Jalan Siti Fatimah Binti Maimun/Telaga Ngipik (Duduksampeyan), and Dusun Betiring, Desa Banjarsari (Cerme). Sexual health screening for sexually transmitted infections (STIs) and narcotics use found one HIV-positive individual and one syphilis-positive individual; BNNK screening was negative. The Health Office will pursue follow-up including contact tracing. The operation, described as a cipta kondisi effort to monitor venues and public order, was led by Satpol PP head Agustin Halomoan Sinaga with BNNK head AKBP Suharsi, and involved multiple agencies and local religious leadership.

triage.headline_ja: グレシック市民保安隊(Satpol PP)が5カ所で一斉取り締まり、29人を拘束、うち2人がHIVと梅毒陽性
triage.triage_reason: 単発の摘発活動における個別症例（HIV1名、梅毒1名）の報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による風紀・麻薬取締りの一環としての性感染症スクリーニング結果報告であり、公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nuevo plan de OPS busca acelerar eliminación de la malaria en las Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New PAHO plan aims to accelerate malaria elimination in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: PAHO (Pan American Health Organization) unveils the Malaria Elimination Action Plan for the Americas 2026–2030, aiming to cut malaria incidence by 50% by 2030 from the 2024 baseline of about 537,000 cases, and to reduce Plasmodium falciparum–related malaria by 70%.
