The four-year plan emphasizes delivering diagnosis and treatment closer to communities where transmission persists, including indigenous communities, mining areas, and hard‑to‑reach locations. It calls for expanded rapid diagnostic tests, strengthened community-based diagnostic and treatment networks under health teams, and broader use of digital tools to facilitate care. Despite challenges to timely access, the Americas have shown progress, with five countries declared malaria-free since 2018: Argentina, Paraguay, El Salvador, Belize, and Suriname. The plan coincides with the Regional Malaria Elimination meeting in Brasilia, 4–6 November 2026, involving health authorities, program managers, experts, and partners.

triage.headline_ja: 新PAHO計画、米州でのマラリア撲滅加速を目指す
triage.triage_reason: PAHOによる地域戦略計画の発表であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHOの地域マラリア撲滅計画（2026-2030）の発表と、ブラジリアでの地域会議開催を報じるもので、対象国リスト中ではブラジルが会議開催国として言及されている。アルゼンチン・パラグアイ・エルサルバドル・ベリーズ・スリナムは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Nears End of Ebola Outbreak After Swift Containment Measures
article.articleSummary: Kenya is nearing the end of an Ebola outbreak, reporting no new cases for 18 days as of 6 November, with six recoveries and one patient under care, and a 42‑day clearance countdown to begin after the last discharge virus‑free. The outbreak began with one imported case on 6 October in a Kenyan resident returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Kampala and Nairobi; nine cases and two deaths were recorded from 669 tests (positivity 1.35%). By 6 November, 66 contacts had completed 21‑day monitoring, and 52 more were due to finish quarantine by 11 November. Surveillance at 26 entry points screened over 760,000 travellers. The response hinges on early detection, isolation, treatment, and rigorous contact tracing, with operation centers and rapid response teams on alert. KRCS led door-to-door awareness and border screening at Busia and Malaba, supported by UNOCHA, IFRC, Norwegian and Danish Red Cross, and EU ECHO.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、迅速な封じ込め対策によりエボラ流行の終息に近づく
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の輸入例に端を発する流行で死亡例もあり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。ただし現時点では封じ込めが進み新規感染なし。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニアにおけるDRC由来の輸入エボラ症例であり、発生地域にDRC・ウガンダ・ケニアが含まれるが、記事の主題はケニア国内での発生・対応であるため、対象国リスト（DRC等）には該当しない。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : un autre infirmier emporté par Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: another nurse carried away by Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Ebola virus disease continues to claim health workers in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. Justin Kataliko, a nurse at Les Bernadins clinic in Beni (North Kivu), died on 5 November 2026. A week earlier, two Congolese doctors died: Safari Samuel on 29 October in Lwemba (Ituri) and Marie-France Shogogo on 28 October at the Ebola Treatment Center in Beni. Samuel, recently graduated, worked in Lwemba and reportedly contracted the illness; about fifteen other people at his facility were ill and had not yet received care. Shogogo, a University of Goma graduate, died after treatment at Beni’s CTE. Earlier, on 10 August 2026, neurosurgeon Charles Mbusa Munyumu died of Ebola at Katwa’s treatment center. Persistent response challenges include shortages of equipment and personal protective gear for health workers.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:別の看護師がエボラにより死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱によりコンゴ民主共和国東部で医療従事者の死亡が相次いでおり、感染制御・防護具不足等の対応課題が継続しているため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 複数の医療従事者（看護師・医師・外科医）がエボラで死亡し、防護具不足など対応上の課題が継続している。感染拡大が北キブ州・イトゥリ州の複数地域にまたがっており、ヒト-ヒト感染（院内感染含む）のリスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Madagascar supprime la quarantaine aux passagers venant du Nigéria et du Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Madagascar lifts the quarantine for passengers arriving from Nigeria and Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Madagascar lifts quarantine and entry bans for travelers arriving from Kenya and Nigeria as part of revised border health controls amid evolving international Ebola risk. A joint interministerial note, cited by Midi Madagasikara, states that the Ebola import risk from these countries no longer justifies the measures. On arrival, affected passengers must sign a commitment letter issued by air and maritime carriers. A remote telephone follow-up remains for travelers who have stayed or transited in these countries to quickly detect any suspicious symptoms. Travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo continue under strict border restrictions. Other sanitary controls at all entry points remain in force; non-compliance or misrepresentation can lead to regulatory penalties. Published 7 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：マダガスカルがナイジェリアとケニアからの渡航者に対する検疫を解除
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関連する渡航制限措置（DRCへの継続的な厳格な国境規制）がIHR基準の複数（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討すべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はマダガスカルの渡航規制政策に関する内容で、ナイジェリア・ケニアからの検疫は解除されたが、DRCからの渡航者には依然として厳格な規制が続いている。マダガスカル・ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外し、実際にエボラ発生国として言及されるDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。具体的な症例数・重症度データは記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Cerita Bahlil Pernah Merasa Sakit Malaria, Ternyata Busung Lapar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahlil's Story: He Once Felt Sick with Malaria, It Turned Out to Be Kwashiorkor
article.articleSummary: Golkar chairman Bahlil Lahadalia recounted a youth illness in Jayapura: in his third semester he developed severe abdominal swelling (kwashiorkor, locally 'busung lapar'), surviving on unripe mangoes after not receiving funds. He initially suspected malaria because of alternating fever, but a doctor in the emergency room diagnosed kwashiorkor, clarifying that the symptoms had resembled malaria. He cites this experience to praise the Free Nutritious Food program (MBG) launched by President Prabowo Subianto, while acknowledging gaps and urging Golkar to propose improvements. During the same event, he noted the party's National Congress decisions: to increase Golkar's parliamentary seats and to support the current government under Prabowo Subianto, emphasizing active, total backing for its programs.

triage.headline_ja: バヒリル氏の体験談：マラリアだと思っていたが、実はクワシオルコルだった
triage.triage_reason: 政治家の過去の個人的な逸話であり、現在の公衆衛生上の感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は政治家の過去の体験談（栄養失調症を誤ってマラリアと思っていた話）であり、実際のマラリア発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : des présumés Wazalendo tentent d'incendier un centre de traitement Ebola de MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Presumed Wazalendo attempt to set fire to MSF Ebola treatment center.
article.articleSummary: On 6 November 2026, around 22:00, gunshots were heard near MSF's Ebola Treatment Center in the Byautu neighborhood of Beu commune, Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Congolese National Police say armed men aligned with the Wazalendo movement attempted to set fire to the facility. The attack is linked to the death of a young woman who had tested positive for Ebola and was the wife of a suspected Wazalendo fighter; police say her husband’s companions sought to retrieve her body around the time of the attack. No fatalities were reported. Police found bottles filled with gasoline at the scene, which were recovered for investigation. Investigations continue to identify those responsible. Authorities condemn the assault on a health facility, urge respect for healthcare workers, and call for adherence to Ebola prevention measures to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：ワザレンド派とみられる武装集団がMSFのエボラ治療センターへの放火を試みる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療センターへの武力攻撃という異常事態であり、対応活動の妨害によりアウトブレイク制御に支障をきたすリスクがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事案自体は治療施設への攻撃事件だが、これはDRC北キブ州ベニで現在もエボラ患者治療が行われていること（アクティブなアウトブレイクの存在）を示唆する。治療活動の妨害は感染拡大防止策の実施を阻害するリスクがあり、現地のエボラ流行状況についての続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết tăng mạnh, bác sĩ cảnh báo thời điểm dễ nguy kịch nhất
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever surges, doctors warn of the most dangerous period.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam recorded over 170,000 dengue cases and 21 deaths in the first 10 months of 2026, higher than the ~106,000 in the same period of 2025. In Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC), Week 44 (Oct 26–Nov 1) reported 1,959 cases, up 16.2% from the prior four weeks; year-to-date through Week 44 totals 44,549. A 17‑day‑old boy in HCMC developed dengue shock with multi‑system involvement; NS1 antigen was positive, and his mother had dengue. He required aggressive resuscitation, blood products, platelets, albumin, and organ support; after 72 hours circulation and liver injury improved. Dengue typically progresses through fever, a dangerous phase when fever breaks (days 3–7), and recovery; the end of fever can herald plasma leakage and shock. Adults now account for more than two-thirds of cases. Advice: maintain hydration, avoid NSAIDs, and eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Dengue Summit 2026 was held Nov 5–6.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が急増、医師が最も危険な時期を警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで前年同期比約60%増のデング熱流行があり、死亡例・重症例（新生児のデングショック症候群）も報告されている。WPRO基準の複数該当とSummit開催など社会的関心の高まりが見られる。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病だが、2026年は前年比約60%増加し死亡21人、重症例（新生児のデングショック症候群）が報告されている。Dengue Summit 2026が開催されるなど社会的関心も高い。ただし国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められず、IHR基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Un jeune Français de 23 ans meurt de la dengue lors d'un voyage en Aise
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 23-year-old Frenchman dies of dengue fever during a trip to Asia.
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old Frenchman Mathis Blondeau died of dengue fever on October 27 during a trip to Asia, with the death occurring in Vietnam, according to Ouest-France and a Facebook post by Rugby Club de Quimper. Dengue is a virus transmitted to humans by the tiger mosquito. Blondeau, a student at INSEEC in Lyon, had been on a rest-and-travel break after five years of study and had recently been admitted to a Master 2 program. He was affiliated with the Rugby Club de Quimper in Brittany, which announced his death on Facebook, noting his status as a young player. The report attributes the fatal dengue infection to his travel in Asia, highlighting a travel-associated case among French nationals.

triage.headline_ja: 23歳のフランス人男性、アジア旅行中にデング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一のフランス人渡航者がベトナムでデング熱により死亡した個別事例であり、デング熱はベトナムで流行性疾患として既知であるため、異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事はフランス人渡航者1名の個別死亡事例の報道であり、ベトナムにおけるデング熱の集団発生や異常増加を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Spread Prompts Call for Coordinated African Response
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) since May 15 have caused over 4,600 deaths and 9,552 confirmed infections, with Uganda reporting 20 infections and two deaths and France recording one imported case in June; four African countries are affected. New Kenya and Nigeria cases heighten calls for pan-African coordination. Kenya reports its ninth Ebola case; eight in isolation and 120 in quarantine; the index patient, infected in the DRC and traveling via Entebbe to Nairobi, died two days after treatment; 14 negative samples in the prior 24 hours; Kenya has requested 10,000 vaccine doses for health workers. Nigeria confirms one case; 53 contacts identified with no positives yet; genomic analysis links the Nigerian case to the Kenyan case, suggesting possible cross-border exposure via Uganda. WHO and Africa CDC urge coordinated preparedness; TUMAINI vaccine trial began in Bunia; Ervebo used in DRC; Africa CDC providing 500 PCR tests and access to 10,000 vaccine doses.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大、アフリカ諸国の協調対応を求める声が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起点とするエボラ出血熱がウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスへ国際的に拡大し、死者4600人超・感染者9552人超と深刻な公衆衛生被害が発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCを起点とした多国間拡大を主題としているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスは対象外）。渡航・貿易制限の明示的記述はないため不明と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 立冬遇上厄尔尼诺 南宁天气湿冷多变四类疾病高发
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lidong Meets El Niño: Nanning's Damp, Cold, and Changeable Weather Leads to High Incidence of Four Types of Diseases
article.articleSummary: In Nanning, during Lidong, El Niño-driven temperature swings and damp-cold conditions raise risks across four disease groups. Cardiovascular: hypertension and coronary heart disease risk increases with rapid temperature changes; patients should monitor blood pressure and avoid stopping medications without a clinician. Respiratory: humid, cold weather favors colds, influenza, and COPD flares. Gastrointestinal: norovirus season brings stomach pain and diarrhea linked to cold exposure and heavy, spicy meals. Musculoskeletal: old rheumatic pain may recur. Prevention emphasizes warming up before cold air, layering clothing to protect the neck, abdomen, and feet, and limiting outdoor activity in cold, damp spells; midday or afternoon exercise is preferred to avoid excessive sweating. Chronic patients should maintain medications and seek care for chest tightness or persistent cough. Traditional Chinese medicine advises nourishing the spleen and removing dampness; consult a clinician before herbal remedies. Increase sunlight exposure to boost mood.

triage.headline_ja: 立冬とエルニーニョが重なり、南寧の湿冷で変わりやすい天候で四種類の疾病が多発
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す具体的な症例報告はない。
triage.notes: 季節の変わり目における一般的な健康注意喚起記事であり、具体的な感染者数や異常な流行の報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: المرضى يفرون من المستشفيات.. الإيبولا وداعش يطوقان سكان الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients flee from hospitals... Ebola and ISIS encircle the people of Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to challenge the Democratic Republic of Congo as ISIS-linked militants in the eastern region mount deadly attacks. In North Kivu's Kantin Alowiath village, a Friday assault killed at least 33 civilians, burned homes and a health center, and forced dozens of patients, contacts, and suspected cases to flee from treatment facilities. Authorities evacuated 180 patients from the Kelikeli health center, raising fears of wider transmission and disrupted case finding, isolation, and contact tracing. About half of new infections are currently in Kivu, while CDC data report 10,741 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,230 deaths in DRC. Misinformation and distrust complicate response measures, including surveillance and safe burial. According to Catherine Sowalwood of WHO/DRC, roughly 60% of deaths occur in communities, underscoring access and trust challenges in reaching the infected.

triage.headline_ja: 患者らが病院から逃走…エボラとISISがコンゴの住民を包囲
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱が継続する中、武装勢力の攻撃により患者が治療施設から逃走し、接触者追跡や隔離が困難になっている。大規模な死者数（5,230人）と感染拡大リスクの高さからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際支援の必要性も示唆されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力の攻撃によりエボラ対応（症例探知、隔離、接触者追跡、安全な埋葬）が著しく妨げられており、感染拡大リスクが高い。WHO関係者のコメントからも国際的な懸念が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع حصيلة وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 5372 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to 5,372.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by the Bundibugyo virus have reached 5,372 deaths among 10,414 confirmed infections, a case fatality rate of 51.6%, according to the National Institute of Biomedical Research as of Oct 30. A daily update added 63 new cases and 32 deaths, with the outbreak now spanning 67 health zones across eight provinces, though transmission remains concentrated in Ituri and North Kivu. About 2,803 people have recovered. The figures include retrospective adjustments to Ituri death records, and the outbreak—declared mid-May—is described as the largest in DRC history and the second-deadliest globally. Cross-border transmission has been reported in Kenya and Uganda, while many deaths occur outside treatment centers. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment; care is supportive. WHO has recommended adding two experimental vaccines to the Tumaini trial in the DRC to bolster response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱による死者数が5,372人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大規模のエボラ流行で、高い致死率（51.6%）と周辺国（ケニア・ウガンダ）への越境感染が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。WHOはTumaini試験に2種の実験的ワクチン追加を推奨しており、国際支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Limited Environmental Links Found to Drug-Resistant Tuberculosis in Eastern
article.articleSummary: Drug-resistant tuberculosis incidence in Pudong New Area, Shanghai, China, from January 2019 through December 2023 (60 monthly observations) averaged 0.053 cases per 100,000 population per month. The ecological time-series study assessed 13 ambient environmental exposures (air pollutants and meteorological factors) for lagged and interactive associations using quasi-Poisson models with single-lag (0–3 months) and distributed-lag (0–6 months) frameworks, time spline and annual sine/cosine terms; heteroskedasticity-robust covariance estimates and Benjamini-Hochberg correction were applied. Lagged associations were heterogeneous and largely non-significant after correction. Relative-humidity showed model-dependent effects, with a cumulative RR of 0.894 (95% CI 0.362–2.209) for 90th vs 50th percentile, not significant post-correction. Bootstrap random forests identified PM10, relative humidity, precipitation, ozone, and sulfur dioxide as top predictors, explaining 52.2% of total importance; joint/interactions were non-significant after correction. The study calls for longer-term, individual-level exposure data to clarify potential environmental influences on DR-TB.

triage.headline_ja: 中国東部における薬剤耐性結核と環境要因の関連は限定的
triage.triage_reason: 学術的な生態学的時系列研究であり、環境要因と薬剤耐性結核の関連は統計的に有意でないとの結論。公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な増加を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は上海市浦東新区における薬剤耐性結核の発生率と環境曝露因子の関連を検証した学術研究で、発生率自体も月平均0.053件/10万人と低く、感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: 流感｜錄29宗兒童嚴重個案 關日華籲留意肚痛、持續嘔吐 或為心肌炎先兆 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza | 29 recorded cases of severe illness in children; Guan Rihua urges attention to abdominal pain and persistent vomiting, which may be an early sign of myocarditis - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Hong Kong shows 29 pediatric cases of severe illness this season. Guan Rihua, former president of the Asian Society for Pediatric Infectious Diseases and HKU clinician, says influenza activity remains high, likely due to waning vaccine protection, host factors, and possible viral mutations amid heavy transmission; vaccination is urged. The peak includes rapid deterioration with sudden hypotension and multiorgan involvement (heart, liver) linked to a cytokine storm. Parents should seek care promptly and note abdominal pain or persistent vomiting as potential myocarditis signs. As of November 7, cases stay high, duration unclear, with overlap possible with winter peaks. SARS-CoV-2 lineage XFG is circulating; immunity wanes after about six months, so boosters are advised. RSV is year-round in Hong Kong, with severe asthma symptoms typically 5–7 days after infection; preventive measures include maternal vaccination and long-acting antibodies for newborns.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ｜小児重症例29件を記録 關日華医師が腹痛・持続嘔吐に注意を呼びかけ、心筋炎の前兆の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 香港で季節性インフルエンザによる小児重症例（心筋炎・サイトカインストーム疑い）が29件報告され、感染持続・流行継続のリスクがあり、公衆衛生上の関心も高まっているため。
triage.notes: 香港での季節性インフルエンザ流行に伴う小児重症例（心筋炎兆候・多臓器障害）報告。RSVおよびSARS-CoV-2(XFG系統)の同時流行にも言及あり。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Islamist militants force Ebola patients to flee in deadly DRC raid
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC caused by Bundibugyo virus; ADF militants raided Cantine-Aloya in North Kivu, forcing hospital patients to flee. At least 33 civilians killed; three high-risk contacts and one confirmed Ebola case plus five suspected infections fled the facility. North Kivu accounts for about half of the DRC’s new infections; the country has logged over 10,000 confirmed cases and around 5,000 deaths. Insecurity hampers Ebola response and healthcare delivery. The Allied Democratic Forces, linked to Islamic State, are blamed for the attack. The report notes ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the region; it does not specify additional laboratory confirmations or imported/exported case details.

triage.headline_ja: イスラム系武装勢力の襲撃によりエボラ患者がDRCで逃走、死者多数
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者・濃厚接触者が武装勢力の襲撃により医療施設から逃走し、感染拡大リスクが高まっている。既に1万例超・死者約5000人の深刻な流行であり、治安悪化で対応が困難になっている点からIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 武装勢力ADF（イスラム国関連）の襲撃により、確認症例・疑い症例・濃厚接触者が逃走し追跡不能となっている点が感染拡大リスクを増大させている。治安悪化により保健当局の対応能力が著しく制限されている。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'nin doğusunda şiddette en az 30 sivil öldü, Ebola müdahalesi aksadı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 30 civilians were killed in violence in eastern DRC; Ebola response hampered.
article.articleSummary: Violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically North Kivu's Beni Cantine-Aloya area, has killed at least 30 civilians, with homes burned and a health facility destroyed, according to UN OCHA. Ebola surveillance is being disrupted as contacts flee and response teams suspend activities, hindering monitoring and outbreak control. As of 7 November 2026, authorities report over 10,700 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 5,200 deaths, predominantly in the eastern provinces. The violence compounds the public health response by reducing access for humanitarian aid and health workers. The UN urges all parties to protect civilians, uphold international humanitarian law, and ensure safe, unhindered access for aid and health personnel.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部での暴力により少なくとも30人の民間人が死亡、エボラ対応に支障
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ流行（1万人超の症例、5千人超の死者）が継続する中、治安悪化によりサーベイランス・対応活動が妨げられており、国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 既存の大規模エボラ流行に加え、治安悪化による対応中断が新たなリスク要因として報告されている。続報でのケース増加・地域拡大の有無を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค ชวนเด็กไทยฉีดวัคซีน PCV ป้องกันโรคนิวโมค็อกคัสรุนแรง เริ่มตั้งแต่อายุ 2 เดือน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control urges Thai children to receive the PCV vaccine to prevent severe pneumococcal disease, starting at 2 months of age.
article.articleSummary: Pneumococcal disease, caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae, affects Thai children and has over 100 serotypes. It colonizes the nasopharynx and spreads via droplets and close contact, causing non-severe illnesses such as pneumonia, otitis media, and sinusitis, or severe disease including pneumonia, meningitis, and bacteremia. For 0–5-year-olds, 5,217 cases of severe pneumococcal disease were reported during 2023–2025, with annual incidence around 47.35, 60.98, and 61.24 per 100,000. To prevent, Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health will add the PCV vaccine to the National Immunization Program, using a 2p+1 schedule: two primary doses at 2 and 4 months, and a booster at 12 months. Parents should vaccinate at participating health facilities, bring health/vaccine records, and maintain hygiene while watching for fever, fast breathing, or poor feeding and seeking prompt medical care. Hotline 1422 for details.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理局、タイの子どもたちに重症肺炎球菌感染症予防のためPCVワクチン接種を呼びかけ、生後2ヶ月から開始
triage.triage_reason: 肺炎球菌感染症に対する定期予防接種プログラム導入に関する公衆衛生広報であり、異常な発生や急増を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は国家予防接種プログラムへのPCVワクチン追加に関する啓発情報であり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : des violences meurtrières dans l'Est du pays perturbent la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: deadly violence in the eastern part of the country disrupts the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Deadly violence in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo disrupts Ebola response. On the night of 5–6 November, Cantine-Aloya in Beni territory, North Kivu province, saw at least 30 civilians killed, homes burned, and a health center destroyed, with some victims among patients. The attack by Allied Democratic Forces rebels compounds Ebola surveillance and containment in a outbreak that has surpassed 10,700 confirmed cases and over 5,200 deaths, mainly in eastern DRC. UN OCHA notes this violence hampers access for health workers and heightens community risk. Authorities urge protection of civilians, respect for international humanitarian law, and unimpeded humanitarian access to responders and health personnel.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：東部における致死的暴力がエボラ対策を妨害
triage.triage_reason: 10,700例超・5,200人超の死者を伴う大規模エボラ流行において、武装勢力による攻撃で医療施設が破壊され対応が妨害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ADF（民主同盟軍）による攻撃で保健施設が破壊され、患者も犠牲者に含まれるなど、紛争がエボラ対応能力を著しく低下させている。UN OCHAが人道アクセスの確保を要請しており、国際的な注視・支援が必要な状況。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Evacúan a Reino Unido a un médico contagiado de ébola en el Congo: permanece aislado en un hospital de Londres - España Directo Televisión
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They evacuate to the United Kingdom a doctor infected with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: he remains isolated in a London hospital - España Directo Televisión.
article.articleSummary: British doctor who worked in the Ebola outbreak response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been evacuated to the United Kingdom after testing positive for Ebola. He is hospitalized in a high-security isolation unit at London’s Royal Free Hospital, receiving specialized care. UK Health Security Agency officials say the risk to the general population remains low. The evacuation on 5 November was coordinated by the UK and Congolese governments with international health partners, and the patient’s identity and health details have not been released. The Congo outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; authorities report more than 10,000 confirmed cases and over 5,000 deaths, with ongoing surveillance, contact tracing, and outbreak control. Ebola is not airborne and spreads through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of symptomatic patients. The patient was part of international responders to the epidemic; authorities continue monitoring contacts and protecting healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラに感染した英国人医師、英国に避難：ロンドンの病院で隔離継続
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが大規模（1万例超・死者5千人超）であり、国際医療従事者の感染・越境搬送事例が発生していることから、国際拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性が認められる。
triage.notes: 英国・ロンドンは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCでの大規模アウトブレイクが主題であり、国際的な医療従事者感染・搬送事例としてフルRRAでの評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Islamic State-linked militants set health post ablaze, kill 33 in Ebola-hit DR Congo village
article.articleSummary: Islamic State-linked militants killed at least 33 civilians in a night raid on Cantine-Aloya village, about 50 km west of Beni in North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, around 11 p.m. on Thursday, torching a health post and several houses. Authorities say one confirmed Ebola patient and five suspected cases fled a nearby hospital; three suspected cases were high-risk contacts. The attack compounds Congo's Ebola crisis, with North Kivu accounting for about half of the more than 10,000 Ebola cases and over 5,000 deaths nationwide. Separately, the WHO says Congo's cholera outbreak this year has claimed about 1,800 lives among roughly 60,000 cases, the worst in decades, spreading mainly in North and South Kivu and threatening Kinshasa as rainy season raises transmission risk. WHO chief Tedros urged widespread Ebola vaccination in conflict-affected eastern Congo as response is hampered by violence and remoteness.

triage.headline_ja: イスラム国系武装勢力が保健所を焼き払い、エボラ流行下のコンゴ民主共和国の村で33人を殺害
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が武装勢力の襲撃により対応が妨げられ、感染者が逃亡するなど拡大リスクが高まっている上、同時進行中のコレラ流行も近年最悪規模でキンシャサへの拡大が懸念されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力の攻撃によりエボラ患者・濃厚接触者が病院から逃走し地域社会に拡散するリスクがある。同時にコレラ流行（約6万症例、1800人死亡）が過去数十年で最悪規模となっており、雨季による感染拡大とキンシャサへの波及が懸念される。WHO事務局長が東部での紛争による対応阻害とワクチン接種拡大の必要性を訴えている。

article.articleHeadline: Riposte contre Ebola en Ituri : l'armée sensibilise et appelle les militaires à Bunia à ne pas baisser la garde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Response to Ebola in Ituri: the army raises awareness and calls on the soldiers in Bunia not to lower their guard.
article.articleSummary: Despite persistence of Ebola virus disease in Ituri, the Democratic Republic of Congo, the army in Bunia is intensifying prevention efforts. Colonel Emmanuel Libandi, CREC focal point within the FARDC, urged soldiers to maintain strict adherence to barrier measures, stressing that the health of troops sustains operational effectiveness. The briefing notes that military personnel's daily contact with civilians places them at heightened contamination risk, making them a critical link in stopping transmission. Through CREC-led outreach, the objective is to consolidate security forces' involvement in the Ebola response, prevent any relaxation of existing measures, and ensure health protection for both soldiers and nearby communities in the Ituri region. The campaign targets multiple population segments and underscores vigilant public health behavior as essential to national protection.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州でのエボラ対応：軍が注意喚起し、ブニア駐留兵士に警戒を緩めないよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続していることが示唆されるが、新規症例数や死亡者数など具体的な疫学情報がなく、現状は既存の対応活動に関する報道にとどまるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: エボラは既知の継続流行であり新規性は低いが、軍を巻き込んだ対応強化が報じられている点から感染拡大リスクの持続が示唆される。具体的な症例数・死亡者数の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы во Вьетнаме жалуются на неизвестный вирус, пишут СМИ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists in Vietnam complain about an unknown virus, the media report.
article.articleSummary: Unknown virus sickens Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam, as of 7 November 2026. Patients report high fever and severe cough; several cases involve children. Local doctors have difficulty establishing a definite diagnosis, and antivirals have been prescribed without laboratory confirmation. A Moscow tourist described a three-week persistent cough, and a father recounted his daughter rapidly developing from runny nose to high fever and severe headache. The issue is reported in Vietnam’s major resort town, with influenza-like symptoms after arrival. No laboratory-confirmed etiological agent or official outbreak statement is provided. The cause remains speculative, with some tourists suggesting air-conditioning–related microbes as a trigger, though no environmental or microbiological evidence is presented.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客がベトナムで未知のウイルスに感染したと訴えている、とメディアが報道
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンで原因不明のウイルス感染が外国人観光客に広がり、診断が確定していない点が異常・予想外であり、帰国者を通じた国際的拡大のリスクも想定されるため、IHR基準が2項目該当しフルリスク評価への移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未特定で、重症度・入院状況・公式発表の有無など多くの情報が不明。続報でラボ確認結果や患者数の推移を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: العالم من حولنا - الكونغو: 5198 وفاة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Around Us - Congo: 5,198 Ebola virus deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports an Ebola virus disease outbreak with 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths as of November 3, according to the Ministry of Health on its website. The figures underscore the ongoing crisis, showing a high fatality toll among confirmed infections. The update provides no additional details on symptoms, transmission, laboratory confirmation, regional distribution, or any imported/exported cases. Released via the ministry’s official site, the data highlight the persistent public health challenge posed by Ebola virus disease in the DRC as of early November 2026. The numbers indicate continued transmission and mortality within the DRC, as authorities monitor the situation through early November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 私たちを取り巻く世界 - コンゴ：エボラウイルスによる死者5,198人
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（確定例10,668件、死亡5,198人）で致死率が高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるため。
triage.notes: 死者数・感染者数ともに非常に多く、継続的な伝播が示唆される。症状・感染経路・地域分布等の詳細情報は不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Вместо пляжа -- больница: Российских туристов во Вьетнаме настигла неизвестная болезнь
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Instead of the beach, a hospital: Russian tourists in Vietnam were struck by an unknown illness.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam report a mysterious illness causing high fever, severe cough, and headache. Local doctors often cannot confirm a precise pathogen, treating with antiviral medications; several patients, including children, fall ill shortly after arrival, symptoms resembling influenza but without a defined cause. A 39-year-old Moscow woman with a three-week cough underwent a CT scan costing about 12,000 rubles, but doctors remained unable to identify the reason. Some travelers speculate hotel air conditioners as a possible source, but there is no confirmation. Earlier, Life.ru reported Coxsackie virus infections among Russian tourists in Vietnam, noting several families with children at a Cam Ranh hotel; an 8-month-old from Tula had fever up to 40°C, rash, and painful mouth ulcers, with the mother later affected. As of 2026-11-07, no causative agent or outbreak pattern has been confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ビーチの代わりに病院へ――ベトナムでロシア人観光客が謎の病気に襲われる
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明の発熱・咳の症例が報告されているが、病原体が特定されておらず規模や重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性など情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にロシア(Tula, Moscow)が含まれるが、これは患者の出身地であり発生地ではない。実際の発生地はベトナム・ニャチャン/カムラン地域。原因病原体未特定、以前のコクサッキーウイルス感染報告との関連も不明。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil pode registrar até 860 mil casos prováveis de dengue em 2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil could record up to 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027.
article.articleSummary: Brazil could record about 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027, per a joint projection by Fiocruz, FGV, Mosqlimate, and InfoDengue, based on 22 models from 130 experts across eight countries. The forecast mirrors 2025–2026 patterns with a dengue peak expected in April 2027. While not indicating a novel surge like 2024, the authors warn the numbers keep dengue at a national alert level, underscoring preparation for El Niño–driven impacts. The report also provides chikungunya projections of over 90,000 cases in 2027, with concentration in the Northeast, South, and in Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, and São Paulo. Emphasis is on vector-control of breeding sites and ongoing municipal epidemiological surveillance to mitigate potential health-system strain.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2027年にデング熱の推定症例数が最大86万件に達する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 将来予測に基づく統計的プロジェクション記事であり、現時点での異常な流行や急増は確認されていないが、デング熱・チクングニア熱は国家警戒レベルにあり継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は2027年の将来予測（モデリング研究）に基づくものであり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの報告ではない。デング熱・チクングニア熱は例年のパターンを踏襲すると予測され、新規の急増は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы во Вьетнаме страдают от неизвестного недуга
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists in Vietnam suffer from an unknown illness.
article.articleSummary: In Nha Trang, Vietnam, Russian tourists are affected by an outbreak of an unknown illness. Patients report flu-like symptoms, including high fever and severe cough; many cases involve children. A girl hospitalized shows rapid onset of runny nose followed by high fever and intense headache; doctors note a circulating influenza virus but have not specified the type and have not established a definitive diagnosis, prescribing antivirals. A 39-year-old Moscow resident has suffered a persistent cough for three weeks; CT imaging failed to yield a diagnosis, and no explanatory pathology was offered. Tourists speculate that microorganisms thriving in air conditioning may be involved. No laboratory-confirmed pathogen, case count, or official infection source is stated. Information comes from the Telegram channel SHOT; the report highlights diagnostic uncertainty among vacationers at a popular resort.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでロシア人観光客が原因不明の疾患に苦しむ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの観光地ニャチャンで原因不明のインフルエンザ様疾患が報告されているが、病原体未特定・症例数不明など情報が乏しく、現時点ではフルRRAに進める根拠が不十分。
triage.notes: 情報源はTelegramチャンネル（SHOT）であり公式発表ではない。病原体未確定、症例数不明、ロシア人観光客に限定された報告であり地元住民への影響や公式対応について追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : des tirs d'armes entendus lors d'une tentative d'incendie d'un centre de traitement d'Ebola à Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Gunfire heard during an attempted arson at an Ebola treatment center in Beni.
article.articleSummary: Gunfire interrupted an arson attempt at the MSF-run Ebola Treatment Centre (CTE) in Beni, the provisional capital of North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, overnight 7 November 2026. Security forces deterred attackers who aimed to set fire to the facility as detonations rang out and residents panicked. Police say the assailants’ identities are unknown and investigations continue; officials say the incident appears linked to the death of a woman, wife of an alleged Muzalendo, who tested positive for Ebola and died earlier that Friday. Preliminary findings recovered gasoline-filled bottles at the scene that did not explode. MSF and authorities condemn attacks on healthcare workers and facilities and urge respect for barrier measures. Since Ebola’s resurgence in Beni, more than 800 cases have been reported, with over half resulting in death.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ベニのエボラ治療センターで放火未遂、銃撃音
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニで進行中のエボラ流行（800例超、致死率50%超）に関連し、治療施設への放火未遂・銃撃という治安インシデントが発生しており、公衆衛生対応の継続性に深刻な影響を及ぼし得るためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は治安インシデント（放火未遂・銃撃）が主題だが、背景にあるエボラ流行（ベニ、800例超・致死率50%超）自体が継続中の重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、医療従事者・施設への攻撃がアウトブレイク対応を阻害するリスクが高い。感染拡大の国際的リスクや渡航制限の有無については記事に記載なく不明。

article.articleHeadline: " Il était la joie de vivre pure " : à 23 ans, Mathis meurt de la dengue au Viêt Nam alors qu'il était en voyage pendant son année de césure
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "He was the pure joy of life": at 23, Mathis dies of dengue fever in Vietnam while he was traveling during his gap year.
article.articleSummary: Mathis Blondeau, 23-year-old student at INSEEC Lyon, died of dengue fever in Vietnam on October 27 during a Southeast Asia gap year. A Brittany native, he had just begun a year off after five years of study; his travels included Indonesia (Bali) before arriving in Vietnam. He had studied in Brittany, Romania, and Lyon, and played rugby as a scrum-half for RC Quimper (RCQ) and Rhône Sporting Club. The RC Quimpérois announced his death on November 6, highlighting his kindness and joie de vivre. A minute of reflection and applause was held before Sunday’s RCQ match against Concarneau. The piece focuses on his life and generosity, noting the travel-associated dengue infection and not reporting additional cases or laboratory details or ongoing outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼はまさに生きる喜びそのものだった」：23歳のマティスさん、休学中の旅行先ベトナムでデング熱により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個人の渡航関連死亡事例の人間的関心記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常発生やアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個人の訃報を伝える人間ドラマ記事であり、ベトナムやインドネシアにおけるデング熱の流行状況・症例数増加等の公衆衛生情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Shot: российские туристы во Вьетнаме заболели неизвестной инфекцией
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shot: Russian tourists in Vietnam fell ill with an unknown infection.
article.articleSummary: Unknown infection causing flu-like illness among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam. The outbreak, reported in Khanh Hoa, affects many children. A 39-year-old Moscow woman has had a strong cough for three weeks, and CT imaging failed to identify a cause. Local doctors mentioned a circulating influenza virus without specifying the subtype, while travelers speculate that airborne microorganisms from air-conditioning systems may be involved. Tourists report antivirals and antibiotics being prescribed without a confirmed diagnosis. No laboratory confirmation or official etiologic diagnosis is provided in the report. The information originates from Telegram channel Shot and highlights uncertainty about the illness and its source amid ongoing symptoms and care, without details on case counts or outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: Shot：ベトナムでロシア人観光客が未知の感染症に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 未確認の感染症でベトナム・ニャチャンにて流行性の症状が報告されているが、病原体の特定や検査確定がなく情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Telegramチャンネル発の未検証情報であり、公式な病原体診断や症例数の報告がない。モスクワはロシア人観光客の出身地であり発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Россияне стали жертвами неизвестного вируса во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians fell victim to an unknown virus in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists in Vietnam's resort city of Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa Province, have fallen ill with an unknown, flu-like virus. Many cases involve children. In one instance, a girl developed a runny nose in the evening, then high fever and severe headache by the next morning; doctors described a circulating flu-like virus but did not specify the subtype. No definitive diagnosis was established for the girl, who was prescribed antiviral medications. A 39-year-old Moscow woman reported a three-week bout of severe coughing, with CT scans failing to yield a diagnosis. Tourists suspect microbes from air-conditioners as a possible source. Most patients receive antivirals and antibiotics without a precise diagnosis. Previously, Russian climbers attempting Everest contracted an unknown virus, with one evacuated from the mountain.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客がベトナムで未知のウイルスの犠牲に
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンで複数のロシア人観光客がインフルエンザ様症状を呈しているが、病原体は特定されておらず、公式な集団発生の確認も重症例・死亡例の報告もないため、現時点では情報不足として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 原因病原体が特定されておらず、既存のインフルエンザ株か新規病原体かも不明。ロシア人登山者のエベレストでの類似症例も言及されているが、これはネパール関連で対象国外。続報で検査結果や公式発表があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: العالم من حولنا - منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذر من انتشار الحمى الصفراء في 9 دول أفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Around Us - WHO Warns of the Spread of Yellow Fever in Nine African Countries
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, the World Health Organization warns of ongoing yellow fever transmission across nine African countries, with 67 cases recorded in Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Guinea, Liberia, Togo, and Nigeria. The WHO notes cross-border movement of people, spread of the Aedes mosquito vectors, and uneven vaccination coverage as major drivers of transmission and expansion. The alert underscores the need for intensified vaccination campaigns, vector-control measures, and strengthened cross-border collaboration to curb further spread in West and Central Africa, where vaccination uptake varies across countries. This situation presents a risk of spillover to neighboring nations and emphasizes sustained immunization programs and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関(WHO)、9つのアフリカ諸国で黄熱病の流行拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: 西アフリカ・中央アフリカ9カ国にまたがる黄熱病の国境を越えた拡大がWHOにより警告されており、IHR基準のうち重大性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの3項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事では9カ国（ブルキナファソ、カメルーン、中央アフリカ共和国、コートジボワール、ガーナ、ギニア、リベリア、トーゴ、ナイジェリア）が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはガーナのみ。他国は対象外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya says 6 Ebola patients recover, 1 under treatment
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports six Ebola patients recovered after testing negative and one patient remains under treatment; total confirmed cases stand at nine with two deaths. No new Ebola case or community transmission has been recorded in the last 18 days (since Oct 19). Of 66 contacts, all completed 21 days of monitoring; a further 52 are expected to finish by next week. The first Bundibugyo virus disease case was confirmed Oct 6 in an individual who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and later died during treatment in Nairobi. Kenya will launch a 42-day countdown after the last patient leaves the treatment center; if no new case emerges within that period, the outbreak will be declared over. Kenya continues screening at 26 entry points, having screened more than 760,000 travelers. Emergency operations centers and response teams have been reactivated nationwide to avert transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ患者6人回復、1人治療中と発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウウイルス）確定9例・死亡2例の稀少な人獣共通感染症アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常/予想外」の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生国はケニアであり、対象国リストに含まれていないためverified_locationsは空。最初の患者はDRCに居住歴があったがDRC国内での発生ではないため除外。18日間新規症例なく収束傾向にあるが、エボラ属ウイルスの性質上フルRRAでの継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: 男子被幼犬舔伤口患狂犬病进ICU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Man in ICU after contracting rabies from a puppy licking his wound.
article.articleSummary: Rabies cases in Wuhan, China, with two men admitted to ICU at Wuhan Jin Yin Tan Hospital as of 2026-11-07. One man sustained a finger injury from an unvaccinated puppy; the wound was not washed, later developed hydrophobia and was diagnosed with rabies. The second man had his hand licked by a puppy, only alcohol disinfection performed, and no post-exposure prophylaxis, subsequently requiring ICU care. Rabies has near 100% fatality. The report emphasizes that even small dogs or puppies can carry the virus, and any breach of skin barrier constitutes exposure requiring immediate wound irrigation and rabies vaccination (Category II exposure). The article cautions against relying on luck when bites or saliva contact occur on broken skin. Public health advice: seek prompt post-exposure prophylaxis after potential rabies exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 子犬に傷口を舐められた男性が狂犬病を発症しICUに入院
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は中国で地域流行している既知の疾患であり、本記事は個別症例2件の啓発的報道にとどまる。異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は中国で地方流行病であり、本記事は暴露後予防（PEP）の重要性を啓発する個別症例報道。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、散発例のため公衆衛生上の国際的懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'โรคฝีดาษวานร" ยุคใหม่ 'อาการ' อาจไม่ตรงไปตรงมา 'ตรวจเลือด' ไม่ยืนยันโรค
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox in the New Era: Symptoms May Not Be Straightforward; Blood Tests Do Not Confirm the Disease.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) in the new era can present with non-classic symptoms, and blood tests do not confirm the disease. As of 7 November 2026, Thai public health authorities note transmission through close contact with lesions or mucous membranes, including sexual contact, kissing, and skin-to-skin contact, and via contaminated items (towels, clothing, bedding) with possible close-range respiratory droplets. Infection can occur without sex. Incubation is typically 3–17 days, up to 21 days; initial symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy, followed by skin lesions or rash. In current outbreaks, some patients have genital, anal, or mucosal involvement with few lesions or localized rashes, and may experience anal pain or other mucosal symptoms. Clinicians should obtain risk histories and examine for clues; differential diagnoses include herpes, conjunctivitis, varicella, and deep neck infection. Public should avoid direct contact with patient lesions, shared personal items, and seek testing promptly if exposure or symptoms occur.

triage.headline_ja: 新時代の『サル痘（Mpox）』：症状が典型的でない可能性があり、血液検査では確定診断できない
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイの公衆衛生当局によるMpoxの症状・鑑別診断に関する一般的な医学教育・啓発情報であり、新規症例数や集団発生など具体的なイベントデータは示されていないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はMpoxの臨床的特徴・診断上の注意点に関する啓発記事であり、タイ国内での具体的な新規症例や集団発生の報告ではないため、発生国としての特定は行わなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Россияне стали жертвами неизвестного вируса во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians have fallen victim to an unknown virus in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: An unknown virus has struck Russian tourists in Vietnam's resort city of Nha Trang. Local reports indicate several cases among visitors, including many children, presenting with influenza-like symptoms such as runny nose, fever, headache, and cough. One child was hospitalized. A 39-year-old Moscow woman has endured a three-week coughing spell; CT imaging was performed (cost about 12,000 rubles) and antivirals/antibiotics were prescribed, but doctors have not determined the pathogen. Health workers have yet to identify the viral type. Tourists suspect possible transmission through air-conditioning systems. The article notes a previous Russian infection in Vietnam, but provides no pathogen confirmation or outcome. The situation is ongoing as of 2026-11-07.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人がベトナムで未知のウイルスの犠牲になった
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの観光地でロシア人観光客に未知のウイルスによるインフルエンザ様疾患が発生し、病原体が特定されていない点で異常性があり、メディアの関心も高いためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 病原体は未特定。ロシア人観光客のみの報告で現地ベトナム人への感染拡大や公式発表は確認できていない。続報で病原体特定情報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Νεκροί 30 ιπποπόταμοι που δηλητηριάστηκαν από άνθρακα σε εθνικό πάρκο στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 30 hippos dead after being poisoned by carbon in a national park in Congo
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Virunga National Park, at least 30 hippopotamuses have died since September from anthrax, caused by Bacillus anthracis; park authorities confirmed the deaths. Anthrax is a zoonotic disease with soil-dwelling spores that can persist for decades, and hippos are particularly susceptible. No new cases have been reported in the past two weeks, but the situation is being closely monitored. Officials believe heavy rainfall may have released the bacterium from the soil. Last year, the park saw at least 50 hippos and other large wildlife killed by anthrax. Local communities have been advised not to touch or consume dead animals and to report them. Virunga National Park, founded in 1925 and spanning about 3,000 square miles, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site renowned for its active volcanic chain and biodiversity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの国立公園で炭疽により30頭のカバが死亡
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（カバ)における炭疽の動物流行事例であり、ヒトへの感染は報告されていないが、人獣共通感染症であり地元住民への注意喚起がなされているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 炭疽菌の土壌中残存による野生動物感染が毎年繰り返されている（昨年は50頭以上が死亡）。ヒト感染例の報告はないが、人獣共通感染症であり地元住民への接触回避の呼びかけがされている。

article.articleHeadline: Governo Federal investiga suspeita de síndrome respiratória em ave achada em Guarujá, no litoral de São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal Government investigates suspected respiratory syndrome in a bird found in Guarujá, on the coast of São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (MAPA) is investigating a suspected respiratory and nervous syndrome in a wild Cairina moschata (wild muscovy duck) found in Guarujá, on the coast of São Paulo state, in the Sítio Conceiçãozinha area of the Vicente de Carvalho district. Samples have been collected for laboratory analysis, with results not yet disclosed. The inquiry aims to determine whether avian influenza (bird flu) or Newcastle disease are involved; a suspected case is not a confirmation. Lab confirmation will guide any specific sanitary actions. Surveillance is conducted by agrodefense agencies under standard vigilance protocols. MAPA emphasizes that disease investigations in birds do not by themselves pose a risk to consuming poultry; chicken meat and eggs from officially inspected facilities remain safe.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦政府、サンパウロ沿岸グアルジャで発見された鳥の呼吸器症候群疑いを調査
triage.triage_reason: 野生水鳥における呼吸器・神経症状の疑い事例であり、鳥インフルエンザ・ニューカッスル病の可能性を調査中だが、検査結果未確定で人への感染報告もないため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 野生の一羽の鳥における疑い事例であり、検査結果未確定の段階。確定診断や追加症例の有無を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox aumentam no estado do Rio; Baixada Fluminense está entre as regiões em alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases are rising in the state of Rio de Janeiro; Baixada Fluminense is among the regions on alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 6 November 2026, Rio de Janeiro state has 298 confirmed mpox infections, with 207 in Rio de Janeiro city; no deaths this year. The rise prompted heightened surveillance and health-service readiness. The Ministry of Health authorized purchase of up to 20,000 mpox vaccines and sent over 2,000 doses to Rio de Janeiro; initial reinforcements target the capital, which accounts for most cases. Baixada Fluminense is also under alert, though municipality-level case distribution isn’t disclosed. Nationally, 665 mpox cases have been reported in 2026, well below the 2022 outbreak (>10,000). Vaccination prioritizes high-risk groups: people living with HIV at higher risk, PrEP users, and laboratory workers; two-dose regimen with a 28‑day interval. By 2 November, 953 doses had been administered in the state. Transmission occurs mainly via close contact with lesions or bodily secretions; common symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が増加；バイクサーダ・フルミネンセも警戒地域に
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロ州でMpox症例が298件に増加し、保健省がワクチン購入・配布を行うなど対応を強化しており、持続的曝露と流行しやすさの基準に該当し社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 死亡例はなく、2022年の大規模流行時より症例数は少ないが、HIV感染者やPrEP利用者など高リスク層への持続的な感染リスクがあるため経過を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Назван возможный источник поразившего российских туристов во Вьетнаме заболевания
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A possible source of the illness that afflicted Russian tourists in Vietnam has been named.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa Province, Vietnam report an unknown respiratory illness characterized by high fever and severe cough, affecting many children. Local clinicians have not confirmed a specific pathogen, treating patients with antivirals or antibiotics without a definitive diagnosis. Some travelers suspect air-conditioning–borne microbes; authorities have not released official data on a Khanh Hoa outbreak. Previously, Coxsackie virus infections were reported in Cam Ranh near Nha Trang, with a hotel cluster under observation. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health (Jan–Aug 2026) logged about 100,000 enterovirus infections, roughly 2.5 times higher than the same period last year, with children under five accounting for more than 87%. The hardest-hit regions include Ho Chi Minh City, Dong Nai, Dong Thap, Tay Ninh, Lam Dong, Da Nang, and Hanoi. The report provides no laboratory confirmation or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでロシア人観光客を襲った疾患の感染源の可能性が特定される
triage.triage_reason: 病原体未特定の呼吸器疾患クラスターに加え、ベトナム全土でエンテロウイルス感染が前年同期比2.5倍（約10万例、5歳未満が87%）に急増しており、異常性・流行性の観点から複数基準に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未確認（コクサッキーウイルス疑いあり）。ロシア人観光客への感染拡大が報じられているが、帰国後の症例報告や検査確定情報はなし。ベトナム保健省のエンテロウイルス統計（2026年1-8月）は別途全国的な増加傾向を示しており、観光客クラスターとの関連性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы заболели загадочным вирусом во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists fell ill with a mysterious virus in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: In Nha Trang, Vietnam, Russian tourists are affected by an outbreak of an unknown illness, with local doctors unable to diagnose a pathogen. Reported symptoms include high fever and severe coughing, and many patients are children. A girl reportedly went from runny nose to fever and headache overnight; doctors described a 'circulating influenza-like virus' but did not specify the type, and antivirals were prescribed. Another Russian woman has suffered a persistent cough for three weeks, with a CT scan failing to identify the illness. The report provides no laboratory confirmation, no defined infection source, and no information on import/export status of the cases. The information comes from Life.ru citing Telegram channels. Date of coverage: 7 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでロシア人観光客が謎のウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: 病原体未特定のインフルエンザ様疾患がロシア人観光客に報告されているが、検査確認や感染源情報がなく、情報源もTelegramチャンネル経由と信頼性が低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 情報源がTelegramチャンネル経由の報道であり、病原体の検査確認がなされていない点に注意。地元当局や公式機関からの発表が確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, nouveaux vaccins et préparation sanitaire en Afrique (Point santé)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, new vaccines and health preparedness in Africa (Health Update).
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has surpassed 10,500 confirmed cases and 5,100 deaths as of 1 November. Two vaccine candidates, ChAdOx1 (Oxford) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna), join the Tumaini ring-vaccination trial pending Congolese approval, addressing Bundibugyo where human efficacy is unproven; Ervebo (Zaïre strain) is evaluated but its efficacy against Bundibugyo remains uncertain. The WHO backs the PARTNERS trial of experimental therapies, including remdesivir and monoclonal antibodies. A physician infected with Bundibugyo has been transferred to London. Nigeria reports 1 confirmed case with 62 contacts; 56 under surveillance. Kenya: 5 discharges after negative tests; 46 contacts completed quarantine; no new infections in two weeks since imported case on 6 October. Ghana reports four confirmed yellow fever cases contained, with vaccination campaigns underway. Liberia and Mozambique: WHO assesses emergency preparedness, with gaps in testing, IPC, staff, and isolation capacity; calls for sustainable funding for emergency medical teams.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、新規ワクチンとアフリカでの保健体制整備（保健アップデート）
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が10,500例・死亡5,100人を超え、ナイジェリア・ケニア・英国への国際的拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 主要な発生国はDRC（ブンディブギョ株エボラ、致死率約48.6%）。ナイジェリア・ケニア・英国（ロンドン）・モザンビーク・リベリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ガーナの黄熱病4例は別途報告されており、封じ込め済みとされるが監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Says More Yellow Fever Cases Likely After 18 Deaths in Africa | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever caused 18 deaths among 67 confirmed cases in nine African countries from Jan 1 to Oct 12, 2026, per WHO, with more infections likely in the African Region. Côte d'Ivoire had 30 cases and 10 deaths; Burkina Faso 15 cases and 3 deaths; Cameroon 9 cases and 1 death; Ghana and Nigeria each 4 cases (Ghana 3 deaths, Nigeria 1 death); Central African Republic 2; Guinea and Togo 1 each (no deaths); Liberia 1 case (deaths not listed). As of Oct 27, WHO rated moderate public-health risk in the African Region and low worldwide. Main activity is near borders in Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana and Liberia; cross-border travel, mosquitoes, uneven vaccine coverage and immunity gaps heighten spread. Vaccination is the main preventive measure; one dose protects for life. Yellow fever is mosquito-borne; ~15% develop severe illness and about half of those die within 7–10 days; care is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカで黄熱病による18人の死亡後、さらなる症例増加の可能性を指摘
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ9カ国にまたがり67症例・18死亡が確認され、WHOが「更なる感染拡大の可能性」と公衆衛生上の中等度リスクを評価しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当が認められるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストには複数のアフリカ諸国（コートジボワール、トーゴ、中央アフリカ共和国、カメルーン、ブルキナファソ、リベリア、ギニア、ナイジェリアなど）が含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはガーナ（Ghana、4症例・3死亡）のみ。他国は対象国リスト外のため除外した。黄熱病はアフリカの既知の地域病だが、今回は9カ国にわたる同時多発的な流行であり、国境地帯での活動が活発な点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ข่าวดี!! สธ. เพิ่มวัคซีน PCV ป้องกันโรคนิวโมค็อกคัสในเด็กเล็ก - The Bangkok Insight
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Good news!! Ministry of Public Health expands PCV vaccination to prevent pneumococcal disease in young children - The Bangkok Insight.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Department of Disease Control expands pneumococcal vaccination (PCV) to prevent severe pneumococcal disease in children aged 0-5. Pneumococcal disease is caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae (over 100 serotypes) and can range from pneumonia, otitis media, and sinusitis to severe meningitis and sepsis. In 2023-2025, 5,217 cases of severe pneumococcal disease were reported among 0-5-year-olds, with annual incidence of 47.35, 60.98, and 61.24 per 100,000. The policy adds PCV to the National Immunization Program on a 2p+1 schedule: two primary doses at 2 and 4 months, plus a booster at 12 months. Vaccination aims to boost immunity, reduce disease risk, and prevent severe outcomes. Parents should vaccinate at participating health facilities and bring the child’s health/vaccine booklets. Maintain hygiene and monitor for fever, rapid breathing, lethargy, or poor feeding, seeking prompt medical care as needed. Hotline: 1422.

triage.headline_ja: 朗報!! 保健省、小児を対象にした肺炎球菌感染症予防のPCVワクチン接種を拡大 - The Bangkok Insight
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はタイ保健省による定期予防接種プログラムの拡大に関する政策発表であり、異常な感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 肺炎球菌感染症は既知の疾患であり、本記事は予防接種プログラムの拡大という通常の公衆衛生施策を報じるものであり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: ฝีดาษวานร" มีตุ่มไม่กี่จุดก็เสี่ยงติดเชื้อ กรมการแพทย์เตือนอย่าชะล่าใจ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox: Even a few lesions pose a risk of infection; Department of Medical Services warns not to be complacent.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) in Thailand: The Department of Medical Services’ Institute of Dermatology warns Mpox can present atypically, with lesions confined to genital, anal, or oral regions and without a generalized rash or enlarged lymph nodes. The Orthopoxvirus spreads via close contact with lesions, blisters, wounds, or mucous membranes, and can be transmitted through kissing and sexual activity. Transmission also occurs via contaminated objects such as clothing, towels, and bedding, and through respiratory secretions in close proximity. The advisory emphasizes vigilance and notes Mpox is not limited to sexual transmission; individuals with suspicious lesions or recent exposure should seek timely diagnosis. Published 2026-11-07.

triage.headline_ja: 「サル痘」は病変が少数でも感染リスクあり、医療局が油断しないよう警告
triage.triage_reason: タイ保健当局によるMpoxの非定型症状・感染経路に関する一般的な注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や流行拡大の記述がないため、現時点では情報不足として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染者数やアウトブレイク事例を示さず、医療専門家による一般的な啓発・注意喚起記事である。性的接触を含む濃厚接触での感染拡大リスクに言及しているため、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（epidemic_prone）はYesとした。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Beni : la fuite de malades d'Ebola à Cantine fait craindre une nouvelle flambée | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Beni: Ebola patients' escape in Cantine raises fears of a new outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak risk escalates in Cantine, Nord-Kivu, DRC, after an ADF rebel attack allowed several patients and high-risk contacts to flee from a local health center about 55 km west of Beni. At the time of the attack, one confirmed Ebola case, five suspected cases, and three high-risk contacts were being followed. The escape dispersed patients into the community, complicating identification and contact tracing. Cantine had previously recorded nearly a hundred positive cases, heightening fears of renewed transmission as people disperse. Response teams must locate the escapees, identify contacts, and decontaminate dwellings visited by patients. Authorities urge displaced individuals with symptoms to seek care at an Ebola treatment center or health facility. The violence-driven dispersion adds to the outbreak-control challenges.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | ベニ：カンティーヌでのエボラ患者逃亡により新たな感染拡大の懸念
triage.triage_reason: ADF反乱軍の攻撃により確認・疑い患者および濃厚接触者が逃走し、接触者追跡が困難化。過去に約100例の陽性者を記録した地域での再燃リスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（ADF反乱軍の活動地域）での発生であり、治安状況が接触者追跡・隔離対応を著しく困難にしている。武力紛争下でのアウトブレイク対応という点で管理可能性に重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: QC records over 7k dengue cases, holds 3-day activities to "dengue-clustering" area
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Quezon City reached 7,340 cases from January 1 to November 5, 2026, per QCESD. This is 29% fewer than 2025's 10,369. District 2 reported 2,654 cases; District 5, 1,177; District 4, 974. Children aged 10 and under accounted for 3,201 cases (44%). In response to dengue clustering, the QC Health Department conducted a three-day prevention activity along Margarita Street, Barangay Gulod (3–5 November 2026). District 5 Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit led active case finding, with spraying and fogging by the QCHD Environment and Sanitation Division. Margarita Street area recorded three dengue cases in four weeks; Barangay Gulod totals 153 cases and two deaths per the latest QCESD report. No laboratory confirmation details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: ケソン市、デング熱感染者7千人超を記録、「デング集積地域」で3日間の対策活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する既知の疾病であり、今年は前年比で減少傾向。地方自治体レベルでの通常の対策活動であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、継続的な流行状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ケソン市における地域的なデング熱流行とクラスター対応に関する報道。前年比で症例数は減少しており、既存の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Таинственный вирус атаковал российских туристов: что происходит на популярном курорте во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A mysterious virus has attacked Russian tourists: what's happening at the popular resort in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Russian tourists at the Vietnamese resort city of Nha Trang report an unknown illness with high fever, severe headache, and prolonged cough, resembling a severe flu and affecting many children. Local clinicians struggle to identify the exact pathogen, often treating with standard antivirals or antibiotics. In one family, the daughter developed fever and headache and was rushed to a local clinic; doctors suspected a seasonal viral infection but could not name the strain. A 39-year-old Moscow tourist with a three-week cough underwent CT scanning costing about 12,000 rubles, with no definitive diagnosis. Some speculate unmaintained hotel air conditioning systems as the source, but there is no official confirmation. Dr. Elena Malinnikova, an infectious disease physician and virologist, highlighted the main signs of a new coronavirus strain PJ.2.1.

triage.headline_ja: 謎のウイルスがロシア人観光客を襲う：ベトナムの人気リゾートで何が起きているのか
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明の呼吸器症状が報告されているが、病原体が特定されておらず公式確認もないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの大衆紙（kp.ru）によるもので、病原体の特定や公式な感染者数・死亡者数の発表はなく、エアコン設備の不備など未確認の推測情報も含まれる。新型コロナ変異株PJ.2.1への言及も専門家の見解にとどまり裏付けがない。

article.articleHeadline: Atypical Toxoplasma gondii Genotypes Cause Fatal Infections in Captive
article.articleSummary: Fatal infections by atypical Toxoplasma gondii genotypes ToxoDB #15 and #169 in two captive primates at a Guangdong Province zoo, China, with deaths occurring between 2024 and 2025. The red-backed bearded saki (Chiropotes chiropotes) and a mandrill suffered rapid disseminated toxoplasmosis without prior signs. Necropsy showed diffuse multi-organ vascular damage, edema, and scattered petechiae; histology revealed acute diffuse inflammation with dense tachyzoite burdens in the saki’s lungs, spleen, and liver and in the mandrill’s myocardium, lungs, and intestinal mucosa. Serology detected anti-Toxoplasma IgG titers of 1:32 (saki heart fluid) and 1:128 (mandrill heart fluid), consistent with seropositivity. Molecular confirmation via TOX-5/TOX-8 PCR detected TgMonkeyGd2 (ToxoDB #15) and TgMonkeyGd3 (ToxoDB #169); viable isolates were recovered in interferon-gamma knockout mice and CV-1 cells. Genotyping across ten loci (SAG1, SAG2, SAG3, BTUB, GRA6, c22-8, c29-2, L358, PK1, Apico) matched TgMonkeyGd2 to ToxoDB #15 and TgMonkeyGd3 to #169; virulence determinants ROP18 4/3 and ROP5 2/3 were identified. This marks the first Asia documentation of these atypical genotypes; hypotheses include recrudescence of latent infection or subclinical primary infection. Negative retrospective virology (SIV, SRV, STLV, hepatitis B).

triage.headline_ja: 非定型トキソプラズマ・ゴンディ遺伝子型が中国の飼育霊長類に致死的感染を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 中国広東省の動物園で飼育されていた霊長類2頭に限定されたトキソプラズマ症の事例であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物園内の飼育霊長類（サキとマンドリル）2頭に限定された獣医学的症例であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒト感染リスクやヒト-ヒト感染の可能性を示す記述はない。アジア初の非定型遺伝子型確認という学術的新規性はあるが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le Nord-Kivu enregistre désormais le plus grand nombre de nouveaux cas avec 37,1 %
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: North Kivu now records the largest share of new cases at 37.1%.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows North Kivu now recording the largest share of new cases at 37.1%, while Ituri remains the cumulative epicenter with 70% of total cases since onset but accounts for 37.1% of new cases. Bandina health zone has surpassed its epidemic peak but remains in danger. Since the outbreak began, over 2,881 people have recovered, and the overall patient follow-up rate is 83.9%. Of 178 health zones, 58 are affected; 25 have had no new confirmed cases for at least 21 days, including 10 zones with 21–42 days without new notifications and 15 with 42+ days. Authorities view this as encouraging progress in transmission reduction, while stressing sustained enhanced surveillance to prevent resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（DRC）：ノースキブ州が新規症例の最大割合37.1%を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2上automatic notification対象であり、58保健地区に及ぶ大規模な進行中アウトブレイクであるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にロシア（Pskovskaya Oblast'）が含まれているが、記事内容はDRC（北キブ州・イトゥリ州）のエボラ流行に関するものであり、ロシアへの言及は本文サマリーに存在しないためジオコーディング誤りと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы пожаловались на вспышку неизвестной болезни во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists reported an outbreak of an unknown disease in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: As of November 7, 2026, Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa Province, Vietnam, report an outbreak of an illness with influenza-like symptoms. Dozens of cases include many children. One parent described his daughter developing rhinitis in the evening, then high fever and severe headache the next morning. Local doctors suspected a circulating influenza virus but did not specify the subtype, and the girl received antivirals without a definite diagnosis. A 39-year-old Moscow resident reported three weeks of a severe cough; imaging (CT) did not yield a cause. Tourists speculated that airborne micro-organisms in air-conditioning systems could be involved, though no evidence supports this. In most cases, physicians reportedly refrain from naming a precise disease, instead prescribing antivirals and antibiotics. The report does not confirm a pathogen, laboratory confirmation, outbreaks, or imported/exported cases, and there is no stated risk to travelers beyond routine caution.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客がベトナムで未知の病気の流行を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客を中心にインフルエンザ様症状の集団発生が報告されているが、病原体や診断が未確定であり、公式な流行確認や重篤度の裏付けがないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ロシアメディアによる観光客証言ベースの報道であり、現地保健当局やベトナム政府からの公式発表・検査結果は示されていない。続報での病原体特定や患者数拡大の有無を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы пожаловались на неизвестное заболевание на курорте Нячанг во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists complained of an unknown illness at the Nha Trang resort in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam report an unknown illness presenting with high fever, severe cough, and headache, with several cases including children. Symptoms often emerge within days of arrival at the resort. In at least one child, high fever and intense headache followed an initial runny nose; doctors suspected a circulating influenza virus, but the influenza type was not disclosed and no definitive diagnosis or laboratory confirmation has been reported. Antiviral treatment was prescribed for the child. Another Moscow tourist has endured a three-week cough; CT scan reportedly did not identify a cause. Some visitors speculate pathogens proliferating in hotel air-conditioning systems, but this theory remains unconfirmed. Tourists report a lack of clear explanations about the illness and the prescribed treatment. Reports come via SHOT Telegram channel and Life.ru; published 2026-11-07.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客がベトナム・ニャチャンのリゾートで原因不明の疾病を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのリゾート地で原因不明の発熱・咳の症例がロシア人観光客に複数報告されているが、検査による確定診断がなく、情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未確定（インフルエンザ疑いだが型不明）。ロシアのSNS/メディア発の情報で、公式保健当局からの発表は確認できない。ロシア（Moscow）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報での検査結果・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية" تحذر من تفشي الحمى الصفراء في 9 دول أفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of a yellow fever outbreak in nine African countries.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, the World Health Organization warns of ongoing yellow fever outbreaks across nine African countries, with 67 confirmed infections. The affected nations are Burkina Faso, Cameroon, Central African Republic, Côte d'Ivoire, Ghana, Guinea, Liberia, Togo, and Nigeria. The report cites cross-border population movement, mosquito vectors, and uneven vaccination coverage as key factors driving transmission and expansion. WHO classifies regional health risk as medium and global risk as low, highlighting the regional spread and the ongoing threat posed by insufficient vaccination coverage and vector activity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカ9カ国で黄熱病の流行を警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOがアフリカ9カ国にまたがる黄熱病流行（確定症例67例）を警告しており、越境人口移動とワクチン接種率の不均一さによる地域的拡大リスクが指摘されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに含まれるのはガーナのみ。他の影響国（ブルキナファソ、カメルーン、中央アフリカ共和国、コートジボワール、ギニア、リベリア、トーゴ、ナイジェリア）は対象国リスト外のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: IS-linked militants kill 33, force Ebola patients to flee.
article.articleSummary: Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, experienced a deadly attack late Thursday night by Islamic State–aligned Allied Democratic Forces that killed 33 civilians, burned a health post and several houses, and forced confirmed and suspected Ebola patients to flee. The assault occurred about 50 km west of Beni. The eruption coincides with an unprecedented Ebola outbreak in DRC, with North Kivu accounting for roughly half of all new infections; nationwide totals exceed 10,000 cases and 5,000 deaths. A concurrent cholera epidemic has caused about 1,800 deaths and nearly 60,000 cases this year. The ADF’s history of civilian attacks, including a July 2025 incident with 66 fatalities, compounds response challenges. Heavy rains hinder security operations and investigations, and ongoing violence slows efforts to contain Ebola and cholera in conflict-affected, remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：IS関連武装勢力が33人を殺害、エボラ患者を避難させる
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で前例のない規模のエボラ流行（1万例超・死者5千人超）とコレラ流行が進行中のところ、武装勢力の攻撃により医療体制が破壊され患者が避難するなど、感染制御がさらに困難化しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異常な事態としてフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は武装勢力攻撃とエボラ・コレラ流行の複合危機を報じている。国際的拡大リスクや渡航貿易制限については記事内に明示的記載がなく不明と評価した。紛争による医療アクセス悪化がアウトブレイク制御の重大な障害となっている点に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: متشددون يجبرون مصابين بإيبولا على الفرار في هجوم خلف قتلى
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Militants force Ebola patients to flee in an attack that left people dead.
article.articleSummary: 7 November 2026 – In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, militants linked to ISIS-affiliated Allied Democratic Forces attacked Kantine-Aloya village in North Kivu, killing at least 33 civilians and forcing Ebola patients or those suspected of infection to flee a health centre that was set on fire. Hospital chief Christian Kakul Volimbira told Reuters that among those who fled was one laboratory-confirmed Ebola patient and five suspected cases, including three who had direct contact with the confirmed patient. A regional commander said the attackers also burned several homes and indicated the death toll could rise, given heavy rains hampering military and investigative actions. Local civil society leaders reported 33 recovered bodies after the raid, most showing gunshot injuries, with some bodies burned or hacked with machetes, underscoring an ongoing Ebola outbreak context in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:武装勢力がエボラ患者を逃走させる攻撃で死者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者及び疑い例が武装勢力の襲撃により隔離施設から逃走しており、接触者を含む感染拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州での既存のエボラ流行の最中に武装勢力の攻撃が発生し、検査確定患者1名と疑い例5名(うち3名は確定患者と直接接触)が治療施設から逃走。隔離の破綻により感染拡大及び追跡調査の困難化が懸念される。武力紛争下での公衆衛生対応の管理可能性にも大きな課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы во Вьетнаме пожаловались на неизвестный вирус
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists in Vietnam complained about an unknown virus
article.articleSummary: Unknown virus causing fever and severe cough reported among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam. As of 7 November 2026, several travelers developed flu-like symptoms after arrival, including high fever. A child presented with runny nose, high fever, and severe headache; antiviral medications were prescribed without a confirmed diagnosis. A Moscow tourist reports a three-week persistent cough. Local doctors have difficulty identifying the pathogen. The Russian Union of Travel Industry says there have been no mass Coxsackie virus outbreaks among Russians in Vietnam. The incident underscores travel-related respiratory symptoms among visitors to Vietnam during the November holiday period, with cases described as suspected viral illness rather than a confirmed pathogen.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのロシア人観光客、未知のウイルスについて苦情を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 病原体未確定で散発的な旅行者症例にとどまり、組織的アウトブレイクの証拠はないが、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 病原体は未確定で、ロシア旅行業界団体はコクサッキーウイルスの集団発生を否定している。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、現時点では個別の旅行者症例に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Des survivants d'Ebola guéris, puis rejetés par leur quartier
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola survivors who recovered, then rejected by their neighborhood.
article.articleSummary: As of November 2, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) has caused 5,165 deaths and more than 10,500 confirmed cases across eight provinces: Ituri, Tshopo, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Sud-Ubangi, and Nord-Ubangi; Ituri accounts for over 7,400 cases. Mongbwalu in Ituri has about 700 confirmed cases and 386 deaths by November 3. Rain and armed groups hamper response. More than 2,700 survivors have been declared cured since May. MSF opened a Survivors Clinic in Mongbwalu for months of follow-up and psychosocial care; Bunia and Beni host clinics opened Sept 19 and Oct 17. Two-hour visits include medicine, psychology, nutrition, laboratories, and pharmacy; survivors may still transmit in semen, so condoms are provided. A Tumaini vaccination trial began in Bunia; on November 4, WHO announced two candidate vaccines (ChAdOx1 Oxford and mRNA-1469 Moderna) for Bundibugyo, not yet proven effective. Ending the epidemic depends on sustained survivor follow-up and community acceptance, alongside vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:回復したエボラ生存者が、その後地域社会から拒絶される
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が8州に拡大し、死者5,165人・症例1万人超と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、武装勢力や降雨により対応が困難なため、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす既存の重大アウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の大規模エボラアウトブレイクの継続報道（生存者の社会的スティグマ、MSFの生存者クリニック、ワクチン候補の発表）であり、既にWHO等による国際対応が進行中と推測される。新規シグナルというより既存イベントのフォローアップだが、規模の大きさからPICKUP判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: अफ्रीका में आया इबोला का नया वायरस, भारत पर क्या पड़ेगा असर?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola virus has emerged in Africa; what impact will it have on India?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak is concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Ituri province reporting 9,704 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,687 deaths as of 20 October 2026 (case fatality 48.3%), and many deaths occurring before hospital arrival. Kenya has 9 cases and 1 death by 20 October after importations from Congo, with 8 contacts and no large-scale community spread; Nigeria reports 1 case in a traveler from Uganda, isolated and under investigation. India has no confirmed Bundibugyo or other Ebola virus infections; a May 2026 Bengaluru concern involving a Ugandan woman tested negative at Pune’s National Institute of Virology. Bundibugyo virus, identified in 2007 in Bundibugyo, Uganda, is a Filoviridae virus spread by direct contact with blood or body fluids; no airborne transmission evidence. Early symptoms include fever, headache, and body aches, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, and possible bleeding in severe cases.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで新たなエボラウイルスが出現、インドへの影響は？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの大規模流行（確定症例9,704件、死亡4,687件、致死率48.3%）が発生し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: インドでは確定症例なし（バンガロールの疑い例はプネーの国立ウイルス学研究所で陰性）。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Terra Indígena Yanomami não registra morte por malária no 1º semestre de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yanomami Indigenous Territory records no malaria deaths in the first half of 2026.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in the Yanomami Indigenous Territory (between Amazonas and Roraima, Brazil) recorded no malaria deaths in January–June 2026, according to a Ministry of Health report released November 5, 2026. During the first half of 2026, 6,891 malaria cases were reported in the territory, a 50.8% reduction from January–June 2023 (14,018 cases), aided by expanded diagnostic capacity and control measures, including tafenoquine administered as a single dose for eligible patients. In 2025, no deaths occurred in the first half, though five deaths happened between July and December; in the first half of 2024 there were nine deaths, eight of which were children aged 0–9; and in January–June 2023 there were 14 deaths.
