The report attributes the malaria surge to illegal gold mining; the government notes a 98.77% reduction in mining activities in Yanomami. The territory spans 96,650 km2. Symptoms include high fever, chills, tremors, sweating, and headache.

triage.headline_ja: ヤノマミ先住民族地域、2026年上半期にマラリアによる死亡者ゼロを記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例数・死亡者数ともに減少傾向を示す肯定的な進捗報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル保健省の報告に基づく進捗報告であり、死亡者数・症例数とも大幅減少を示す肯定的内容。地域の風土病（マラリア）の継続的曝露はあるが、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: AIIMS Deoghar trains 235 health workers in TB detection
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, AIIMS Deoghar trained 235 community-level health workers in Dumka to help identify suspected extrapulmonary tuberculosis (TB) and ensure timely diagnosis and treatment. The initiative targets TB affecting organs other than the lungs, with frontline workers trained to recognize symptoms such as abnormal swellings or lumps in the neck, armpit, and groin, reinforced by practical mannequin demonstrations. Dean (Research) Prof Somashekhar Nimbalkar said strengthening diagnostic capacity at the grassroots level is essential for improving health outcomes, and the program aims to bridge the gap between primary healthcare services and specialized diagnostic facilities. The effort emphasizes early detection at the primary level to facilitate timely care for extrapulmonary TB cases.

triage.headline_ja: AIIMSデオガル、235名の医療従事者に結核検出のトレーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の公衆衛生能力強化・研修活動の報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドのデオガルにおける結核検出研修プログラムに関する内容であり、感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではないため、対象国としての特定イベントはなしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam : un étudiant français meurt au cours d'un voyage des suites de la dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnam: a French student dies during a trip due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old Mathis Blondeau, a French rugby player from Quimper, Brittany, died on October 27 in Vietnam from dengue fever transmitted by tiger mosquitoes (Aedes). The traveler had spent weeks in Southeast Asia, including a stop in Bali, Indonesia, before arriving in Vietnam during a gap year after commerce studies in Lyon. The Rugby Club Quimpérois announced the death on Facebook, describing Blondeau as a leader with a sunny disposition. A tribute is planned Sunday at 3:00 p.m., with a minute of silence before the Fédérale 3 derby against Concarneau; his family will attend. The incident underscores dengue risk in Southeast Asia, where dengue is transmitted by tiger mosquitoes. The article does not report laboratory confirmation or details on local health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム:フランス人学生が旅行中にデング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個別の渡航者死亡事例であり、デング熱は東南アジアで流行する既知の風土病で異常性・新規性は低く、公衆衛生上の広域的な影響や国際的拡大リスクを示す情報もない。
triage.notes: ベトナムでのデング熱感染による単発の渡航者死亡例。ベトナム滞在中に発症し死亡しているため発生国はベトナムと判断。バリ島(インドネシア)は経由地であり感染源の特定はされていない。フランス、リヨン、ブルターニュ等は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Formation des autorités sur la lutte contre la résistance épidémiologique d'Ebola à Butembo - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities' training on combating Ebola's epidemiological resistance in Butembo - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), 28 neighborhood authorities were trained on Ebola prevention and countering youth resistance in a MSF-led effort to mobilize communities and curb transmission. The program emphasizes showing that Ebola is present and engaging residents, particularly youths, to end the transmission chains. Kyaghala district, previously a resistance hotspot, is no longer in the red zone as cases decline due to intensified sensitization. The 5 November epidemiological bulletin (published 6 November) reports Katwa health zone with 714 confirmed Ebola cases, 495 deaths, and 157 recoveries; Butembo health zone with 377 confirmed cases, 107 deaths, and 42 recoveries. The response focuses on barrier measures and community engagement to halt spread and conclude the outbreak in these zones.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボにおけるエボラ疫学的抵抗との闘いに関する当局者研修 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の大規模な継続的アウトブレイクが報告されており（カツワ保健地区714例495死亡、ブテンボ保健地区377例107死亡）、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大のリスクがあるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラアウトブレイクに関する継続報告であり、MSF主導のコミュニティ動員活動と疫学速報（11月5日付）のデータを含む。カツワ・ブテンボ両保健地区で致死率が高く（カツワ約69%、ブテンボ約28%）、継続的な監視と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trente-deux nouveaux cas confirmés enregistrés portant le cumul à 2754 au Nord-Kivu - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thirty-two new confirmed cases recorded bringing the cumulative total to 2,754 in North Kivu - ACP.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, records 32 new confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases, bringing the cumulative total to 2,754 as of 5 November 2026 amid the province’s 17th outbreak. Beni accounts for 22 of the new cases (eight deaths), with Kalunguta (5), Mabalako (2), and single cases in Butembo, Mutwanga, and Masereka; two probable cases are reported in Kyondo and Beni. The toll stands at 1,649 deaths (case fatality ~60%), 411 recoveries, 640 active cases, and 54 discharged from facilities without medical supervision. There were 277 suspected cases that day, including 79 deaths among suspects, with 133 samples collected. Active contacts total 19,262, of which 15,182 were followed that day (79% follow-up). Seventeen health zones across Nord-Kivu are affected, with 206 of 684 health areas affected (30%), hotspots at 62% (206/333). Cumulative by health zones: Beni 814, Katwa 714, Butembo 377, Musienene 169, Mabalako 129, Oicha 104, Mutwanga 84, Vuhovi 56, Masereka 46, Kyondo 45, Lubero 44, Biena 25, Alimbongo 19, Manguredjipa 16, Kayna 9. Incident manager: Governor Evariste Somo Kakule. The outbreak remains active in Nord-Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州で新たに32人のエボラ出血熱感染確定例、累計2,754人に - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて新規確定例32人（累計2,754人、死亡1,649人、致死率約60%）が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約60%、接触者19,262人のうち79%を追跡中という大規模アウトブレイクであり、17の保健地域に拡大。州知事が対応指揮を執っており、国際支援の必要性が高いと推察される。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: British Ebola patient evacuated from DR Congo arrives at London hospital
article.articleSummary: British medical professional contracted Ebola while working on humanitarian response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has been evacuated to the United Kingdom for specialist care. Treated at a dedicated high‑level isolation facility at the Royal Free Hospital, Hampstead, north London, following a Department of Health and Social Care–arranged flight. This marks the first confirmed case of a British national contracting Ebola in the current DR Congo outbreak. Public risk remains low due to strict infection prevention and control measures; staff use appropriate PPE and isolation protocols to prevent transmission. The DR Congo outbreak, declared earlier this year, is the second largest on record with over 10,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths, and has spread to Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria’s capital. The UK has previously recorded four Ebola cases: one lab-related in 1976 and three among health workers during the 2014–2015 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 英国人エボラ患者、DRコンゴから避難しロンドンの病院に到着
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴで史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行（1万人超感染、5000人超死亡）が継続し、複数国への越境拡大と英国人感染者の国際搬送が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリア・英国・米国が含まれるが、記事の主題である発生国はDRコンゴであり、これら拡大先国・搬送先国は対象国リスト外（DRC以外）のため除外。Hampstead(米国ニューハンプシャー州の地名)等は地名の誤マッチと判断。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : ChAdOx1 et mRNA-1469 pourraient rejoindre l'essai Tumaini
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469 could join the Tumaini trial.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo in DRC is advancing vaccine evaluation, with no proven human efficacy yet. Two candidates—ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469—could join the Tumaini trial in Bunia, Oct 23, pending authorities’ approval. Tumaini uses ring vaccination of contacts; Ervebo is also evaluated but may not protect Bundibugyo. WHO backs the PARTNERS trial for experimental treatments like remdesivir and monoclonal antibodies. By Nov 1, the outbreak exceeded 10,500 confirmed cases and 5,100 deaths. A doctor infected was transferred to London for care. In Nigeria, 1 confirmed case as of Nov 4, 62 contacts; 6 completed 21-day follow-up; 56 monitored. Over 630,000 border checks since Oct 28; two suspected in northeast Nigeria tested negative after two rounds. In Kenya, five hospitalized patients discharged after negative tests; no new infections in two weeks; 46 contacts completed quarantine. In Liberia, a WHO mission found gaps in testing, IPC, staffing, and isolation facilities in Lofa, Bong, and Margibi.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ChAdOx1とmRNA-1469がTumaini試験に参加する可能性
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクは10,500例超・死者5,100人を超える大規模流行であり、ナイジェリア・ケニア・リベリア・英国への感染拡大や医療従事者の国際搬送も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・リベリア・英国での関連症例・調査も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Китай построит в Замбии завод по производству вакцин против холеры
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China to build a cholera vaccine production plant in Zambia.
article.articleSummary: China to build a cholera vaccine production plant in Zambia's Lusaka-South Economic Zone to cut dependence on imports and potentially supply other African nations. Zambia's 2023-2024 cholera outbreak recorded over 20,000 cases and nearly 700 deaths. The plant will include a bottling and packaging line for oral cholera vaccines, with capacity up to 20 million doses per year, split 50% for Zambia and 50% for export pending regulatory approvals. Future expansion could add pediatric and veterinary vaccines, subject to financing and regulatory clearances. The project supports the African Union's goal of producing 60% of Africa's medicines locally by 2040, addressing ongoing import reliance and the legacy of vaccine shortages during the Covid-19 pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ザンビアにコレラワクチン製造工場を建設
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン製造工場建設計画に関する産業・保健インフラ投資ニュースであり、新規の感染症発生や急性の公衆衛生事象を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 2023-2024年のザンビアでのコレラ流行（2万例超、死亡約700人）への言及はあるが、これは過去の出来事の背景説明であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではない。中国はワクチン製造拠点として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: MS investiga novo óbito por dengue e casos confirmados da doença passam de 2,3 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health investigates a new dengue-related death and confirmed dengue cases exceed 2,300.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso do Sul reports 2,325 confirmed dengue cases and 3,872 probable dengue cases in 2026, with one confirmed death and one death under investigation. The dengue fatality occurred in Bonito and involved an 11-year-old male. Corumbá leads in confirmed dengue with 788 cases; Costa Rica (197), Dourados (160), and Santa Rita do Pardo (141) follow. For chikungunya, the state records 11,000 confirmed and 12,646 probable cases, including 121 confirmed in pregnant women. There are 31 chikungunya deaths, with no new deaths under investigation. Dourados has the most chikungunya deaths (19) and the most confirmed chikungunya cases (5,314). Other municipalities with notable chikungunya totals include Corumbá (789), Fátima do Sul (641), and Jardim (405). Data refer to epidemiological week 42 and were released by SES-MS on Thursday the 5th.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州、デング熱による新たな死亡疑い例を調査、確定症例は2,300件超に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マットグロッソ・ド・スル州でデング熱・チクングニア熱の季節性流行が継続しており死亡例もあるが、例年起こりうる蚊媒介感染症の定期報告であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は確認できないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事中のCosta Ricaはマットグロッソ・ド・スル州内の自治体名であり、コスタリカ国を指すものではない。デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで季節的に流行する既知の蚊媒介感染症であり、州保健局(SES-MS)による定期的な疫学週報（第42週）に基づく報告。

article.articleHeadline: Armed men kill at least 33 in village in Ebola-hit eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, armed, Islamic State-linked militants from the Allied Democratic Forces killed at least 33 civilians in Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, DRC, exacerbating the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo. The attackers set fire to a health post; patients from a nearby hospital fled, including one confirmed Ebola patient and five suspected cases (three high-risk contacts). Authorities said the death toll could rise as heavy rain hampered search and investigations; 33 bodies recovered, most with gunshot wounds, others burned or hacked. The village lies about 50 km west of Beni, around 11 p.m. local time on Thursday. North Kivu currently accounts for about half of new Ebola infections in Congo, with over 10,000 cases and 5,000 deaths nationwide. The incident underscores ongoing transmission risks within an outbreak hotspot, with healthcare facilities directly attacked.

triage.headline_ja: 武装集団が少なくとも33人を殺害、エボラ流行下の東部コンゴの村で
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行地での武装襲撃により確定・疑い患者が逃亡し、医療施設も焼失するなど感染拡大リスクが急激に高まっており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（ADF/IS関連）による襲撃で医療施設が破壊され、確定エボラ患者1名・疑い例5名（うち高リスク接触者3名）が逃亡。北キブ州は国内新規感染の約半数を占めるホットスポットであり、治安悪化が感染症対応を一層困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mandima : plus de 520 cas confirmés et 300 décès enregistrés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mandima: more than 520 confirmed cases and 300 deaths recorded - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Mandima health zone, Ituri Province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 520 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 300 deaths, plus about 60 recoveries, reported as of 7 November 2026. The high transmission is exacerbated by treatment-center evasion, expanding the virus transmission chain. Coordinators from Socico urge stronger support from national and provincial authorities, including the Ministry of Health and the Provincial Health Division, to bolster the response. They also call on development partners backing the government to intensify interventions in Mandima and acknowledge ongoing holistic care efforts for the affected population. The article emphasizes the urgent need to curb transmission and scale up surveillance, treatment, and containment measures within the Mandima health zone.

triage.headline_ja: マンディマのエボラ出血熱：確認症例520件以上、死者300人以上を記録 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（致死率の高さ、症例数500件超、治療拒否による感染拡大）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的な支援要請も明示されているため。
triage.notes: 治療センターからの逃避（evasion）により感染連鎖が拡大している点、致死率が非常に高い点（300/520超）が懸念材料。国際的な開発パートナーへの支援要請が明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: Zambie : un partenariat avec la Chine pour produire localement un vaccin contre le choléra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia: a partnership with China to locally produce a cholera vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Cholera vaccine production in Zambia moves closer to local supply as Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) of Zambia and China's Jijia (Beijing) International Medical Technology sign a joint venture to form ZAMVAX Limited to build a cholera vaccine manufacturing unit in the Lusaka South Special Economic Zone. The initial investment of 24.13 million USD will finance the first phase, which will fill, finish, package and quality-control oral cholera vaccines from imported antigens, with full local production of antigens planned in a later phase. The plant targets up to 20 million doses per year. Ownership is 60% IDC and 40% Jijia. The project includes technology transfer and training for Zambian workers, with aims to expand to pediatric and veterinary vaccines subject to feasibility and regulatory steps. The drive follows Zambia's 2023-24 cholera outbreak (over 20,000 cases and around 700 deaths) and Africa-wide ambitions to boost local vaccine production toward 2040.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：中国との提携でコレラワクチンを現地生産へ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はコレラワクチンの現地生産に関する産業・経済提携のニュースであり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は2023-24年のザンビアでのコレラ流行（2万例以上、約700人死亡）を背景とした、将来的なワクチン生産体制構築に関する報道であり、新規の感染症発生情報ではない。中国は投資パートナーとして言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tay chân miệng tăng mạnh, não mô cầu ghi nhận 8 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand-foot-and-mouth disease on the rise; meningococcal disease reports 8 fatalities.
article.articleSummary: By 7 November 2026, Vietnam reports 150,200+ hand-foot-and-mouth disease cases and 12 deaths, up 91.5% from the same period in 2025; October cases rose 36.6% month-on-month. HFMD is most common in the South (70.2%), with the North (14.6%), Central (7.8%), and Central Highlands (7.4%). Meningococcal disease records 69 cases and 8 deaths, down 15 from 2025; cases occur weekly (1–4) across the country, with 48 in the South, 15 in the North, 4 in the Central Highlands, and 2 in the Central region. COVID-19 has 9,376 cases and 0 deaths, down 37.9% year-on-year; after August’s rise, numbers have fallen, with fewer than 50 cases in recent weeks, mainly in the North (≈93.2% of total). Rabies causes 59 deaths YTD, down 7; authorities urge dog/cat vaccination and prompt wound care. Surveillance will be intensified at borders, healthcare facilities and communities to early-detect and contain outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が急増、髄膜炎菌感染症で8人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 手足口病が前年同期比91.5%増と急増し死亡例も報告されているほか、髄膜炎菌感染症でも死亡が継続しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当が多いためフルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 複数疾患（HFMD、髄膜炎菌感染症、狂犬病、COVID-19）を含む国家サーベイランス報告。HFMDの急増と死亡者数増加が主要な懸念点。国境・医療機関・地域での監視強化が言及されているが、国際支援の必要性については記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 aumentam em SP e preocupam autoridades de saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise in São Paulo and worry health authorities.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19–related Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases surge in São Paulo, prompting epidemiological alerts from Fiocruz and SES-SP. By Oct 31, 2026, 1,328 SRAG cases graded as severe due to COVID-19 and 429 ICU admissions in São Paulo were recorded. The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin also reports rising COVID-19 activity in Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, the Federal District, and Mato Grosso do Sul, with the latter showing the highest incidence. Metapneumovirus has spread to capitals and municipalities across the Southeast, South and Northeast, increasing pressure on hospitals. The simultaneous circulation of SARS-CoV-2, metapneumovirus, and rhinovirus raises concerns for more severe respiratory disease and greater high-complexity bed occupancy. In the last eight weeks, children up to 2 years have the highest SRAG incidence (rhinovirus, RSV, metapneumovirus), while those 65+ show the greatest mortality. Prevention guidance emphasizes hands hygiene, cough etiquette, and respiratory isolation when flu-like symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロで新型コロナウイルス重症例が増加し、保健当局が懸念
triage.triage_reason: WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当し、保健当局や公的機関（Fiocruz, SES-SP）の関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器系ウイルス（SARS-CoV-2、メタニューモウイルス、ライノウイルス）が同時流行しており、重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の増加と集中治療室入院が報告されている。地域はサンパウロを中心にリオデジャネイロ、サンタカタリーナ、連邦直轄区、マットグロッソ・ド・スルなど複数州に拡大。

article.articleHeadline: Araguatins reforça prevenção da Malária e avança rumo à certificação da eliminação da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Araguatins strengthens malaria prevention and advances toward certification of malaria elimination.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains non-endemic in Araguatins, Tocantins, Brazil, with no locally acquired cases since 2018 and ongoing efforts toward transmission-elimination certification. On Americas Malaria Day (November 6, 2026), the municipal health department intensified guidance on prevention, early symptom recognition, and prompt medical care. Authorities warn against imported cases from endemic and mining areas and stress continuous surveillance of travelers to preserve gains. Common symptoms include high fever, intense chills, headaches, heavy sweating, and malaise. Residents are urged to seek care at the nearest Basic Health Unit or Municipal Hospital for timely diagnosis and treatment. Officials underscore epidemiological surveillance, rapid case identification, and swift laboratory diagnosis as essential to maintaining progress and achieving official elimination certification, with support from the Ministry of Health, Sesau, and frontline health teams.

triage.headline_ja: アラグアチンス市、マラリア予防を強化し、疾病排除認証に向けて前進
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは2018年以降現地感染例なく非流行状態であり、本記事は排除認証に向けた予防啓発活動の紹介に過ぎず、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の啓発活動に関する内容であり、非流行地域での予防強化策の紹介であるため、対象国リストに該当する発生国はないと判断（ブラジルは発生国ではなく予防啓発の主体）。

article.articleHeadline: แพทย์เตือน! ฝีดาษวานรพุ่ง แนะวิธีรับมือและป้องกันตัวในฟิตเนส สถานบันเทิง และพื้นที่แออัด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn! Monkeypox on the rise; tips to cope and protect yourself in gyms, entertainment venues, and crowded areas.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) infections are rising in Thailand, triggering a public health advisory as of 7 November 2026. Authorities urge reducing skin-to-skin contact and avoiding shared items in gyms, entertainment venues, and crowded spaces. Prevention guidance: Gyms – disinfect equipment before and after use, bring personal mats, towels, and water bottles, avoid touching the face, and wash hands and shower after workouts. Nightclubs and social events – monitor others for visible skin lesions, minimize close contact, do not share drinks, straws, or cigarettes, and discuss any genital or oral lesions before sexual activity; condoms reduce exposure to secretions but do not fully prevent mpox if lesions are present near genitals or thighs. Crowded public spaces – wear long sleeves, keep skin covered, and use alcohol gel; masks can help reduce droplet exposure. Return travel: observe symptoms for 21 days, isolate if fever, lymphadenopathy, or rashes appear, and seek medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: 医師警告!サル痘が急増、ジム・娯楽施設・混雑地域での対処法と予防法を助言
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内でMpox感染増加の公衆衛生注意喚起があるが、症例数・重症度・クレード種別など具体的データが不明であり、続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発が中心で、感染者数・クレード型・死亡例などの具体的疫学情報が欠如している。続報で感染規模やクレード種別を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Islamist Militant Attack Forces Patients to Flee Ebola Clinic in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsened after militants linked to Islamic State attacked a health center in Cantine-Aloya, about 28 miles west of Beni, killing at least 44 people and burning homes, forcing infected patients to flee. The assault underscores security challenges facing the response to what has become the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record since the first case was detected in May, spanning eight eastern provinces. Across eastern Congo, more than 100 armed groups operate, with the Allied Democratic Forces—the ISIS affiliate responsible for the Cantine-Aloya attack—noted for brutality. The violence disrupts containment efforts and endangers patients and healthcare workers, with outbreaks worsening in areas where access is limited. The report highlights how insecurity threatens to derail progress in an outbreak that has already spread across a wide area.

triage.headline_ja: イスラム過激派の襲撃により、コンゴのエボラ治療施設から患者が避難を強いられる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で記録上2番目に大きいエボラ流行が拡大中であり、武装勢力の攻撃により封じ込め対応が妨げられ国際的拡大リスクが高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による攻撃がエボラ対応の安全確保を困難にし、感染拡大のリスクを高めている。治安状況の悪化が今後の対応能力に大きく影響する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يدق الأبواب.. موانئ ليبيا تتحرك فوراً وتفرض قيوداً صارمة على السفن القادمة من أفريقيا - أخبار ليبيا 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola" knocks on the doors... Libyan ports move immediately and impose strict restrictions on ships arriving from Africa - Libya News 24
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Libyan Ports and Maritime Transportation Authority has ordered urgent preventive measures at Libyan harbors to curb spread of infectious diseases such as Ebola and other epidemics, amid outbreaks in Africa including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, and Nigeria. The rules require pre-notification of ships coming from outbreak countries or those docking at high-risk ports, along with a maritime health declaration and prompt disclosure of any atypical crew symptoms. Port health teams may conduct examinations and testing, with strict enforcement of cleanliness, disinfection, safe waste disposal, and verification of drinking water and onboard food safety. Skippers should be educated on preventive practices and avoid contact with suspected cases except per health guidance. The measures align with International Health Regulations and WHO recommendations, but will not disrupt navigation; each health situation will be assessed independently.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がノックする扉…リビアの港湾当局が即座に動き、アフリカからの船舶に厳格な規制を課す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国等でのエボラ出血熱流行を受け、リビアが国際港湾で渡航・貿易制限措置を講じており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はリビア当局の予防的港湾規制措置が主題であり、コンゴ民主共和国・ケニア・ナイジェリアでのエボラ流行自体についての一次情報（症例数・発生時期・地域詳細）は含まれていない。ケニア・ナイジェリア・リビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。続報で実際の流行状況の確認が必要。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Outbreak Death Toll Reaches 5,198 As Cases Climb To 10,668
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 5,198 deaths and 10,668 confirmed cases, with data through November 3, 2026, giving a case fatality rate of 48.7%. The high mortality and ongoing transmission raise concerns about spillover to neighbouring countries. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention Director-General Jean Kaseya warned that sustained transmission in DR Congo poses a regional threat. Earlier reporting noted a UK citizen tested positive for Ebola, illustrating cross-border implications of the outbreak. Health authorities continue surveillance and reporting on the latest official tallies as of early November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、死者数5,198人・症例数10,668人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.7%の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、英国人感染者の存在から国際的拡大リスクも確認されるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 英国での感染者確認は越境拡大の証左だが、対象国リストに英国は含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。アフリカCDCが地域的脅威として警告している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Uruguai retoma compras de aves do Brasil após foco de doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uruguay resumes Brazilian poultry purchases after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Uruguay resumed Brazilian poultry imports after a Newcastle disease outbreak, lifting nationwide restrictions while keeping limits confined to Santa Catarina. On 6 November 2026, Uruguay announced purchases from other Brazilian states could resume; restrictions remain for Santa Catarina due to outbreaks in its poultry sector. The affected municipalities under restriction are Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. Estimated restrictions affect about 15,000 tonnes per month—roughly 3% of Brazil’s average monthly poultry exports (about 500,000 tonnes). The latest outbreak was recorded on 18 October 2026 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, with national restrictions ending 19 days later. A previous outbreak in Rio Grande do Sul in July 2024 also triggered temporary restrictions that ended after 74 days. Authorities say poultry under official inspection remains safe and without contraindications, though international restrictions on Santa Catarina persist among about ten exporting countries.

triage.headline_ja: ウルグアイ、ニューカッスル病発生後にブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を再開
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、記事内容はブラジル-ウルグアイ間の貿易制限解除に関するもので、人の公衆衛生への直接的な影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 家禽の動物衛生・貿易に関する事案であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクとしての公衆衛生上の懸念は記事中に記載されていない。貿易制限は経済的影響として言及されているが、IHR(2005)上の人の健康危機とは直接関係しない。

article.articleHeadline: Delamanid Resistance Emerges Rarely During Multidrug-Resistant Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: China conducted a prospective multicenter cohort across ten centers (Beijing Chest Hospital; Hangzhou Red Cross Hospital; Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Chest Hospital; Chengdu Public Health Clinical Center; Henan Provincial Chest Hospital; Jiangxi Chest Hospital; Kunming Third People's Hospital; Infectious Disease Hospital of Heilongjiang Province; Changsha Central Hospital; Guiyang Public Health Treatment Center) to evaluate delamanid resistance in 263 culture-confirmed MDR/RR-TB patients treated with delamanid-containing regimens between 2020 and 2024. Primary delamanid resistance was detected in 0.76% of tested isolates. Among 263 patients who completed therapy, 187 had favorable outcomes (71.1%) and 76 unfavorable (28.9%). Baseline isolates were largely susceptible to delamanid, and acquired resistance during treatment was extraordinarily rare, supporting the durability of delamanid in MDR-TB regimens. Globally, TB affected about 10.8 million people in 2024 with 1.25 million deaths; China’s MDR-TB burden remains substantial, with 66% treatment success.

triage.headline_ja: 中国において多剤耐性結核治療中にデラマニド耐性が稀に出現
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中国における多剤耐性結核治療中のデラマニド耐性に関する前向きコホート研究の結果報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 研究論文の内容であり、結核の耐性株出現率は0.76%と極めて稀。既存薬剤の有効性を支持する内容で、新たな公衆衛生上の脅威やシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: La fuite de malades suspects d'Ebola après une attaque des ADF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The escape of patients suspected of having Ebola after an ADF attack.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola patients and high-risk contacts escaped from Kelele Hospital in Cantine, Beni Territory, North Kivu, after an ADF rebel attack. Local civil society reports at least 30 civilians killed in the assault. Gunfire around 23:00 caused panic, and by midnight the hospital had emptied of all patients, including those in isolation for suspected Ebola or exposure. Medical staff warn that dispersal of potentially infected individuals into communities could spark transmission, with evacuees moving to areas with no reported cases. The hospital’s medical director, Dr. Christian Kakule Vulembera, says the situation is worrying and could complicate surveillance and follow-up for exposed persons, especially for the Madiwe groupement, amid ongoing security deterioration that hampers case management.

triage.headline_ja: ADFの攻撃後、エボラ疑い患者らが病院から逃走
triage.triage_reason: 武装勢力の攻撃により隔離中のエボラ疑い患者・濃厚接触者が病院から逃走し、感染追跡が困難になっている。公衆衛生上重大かつ異常事態であり、地域拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 治安悪化（ADF攻撃）によりエボラ疑い患者・接触者の追跡・隔離管理が破綻しており、コミュニティへの感染拡大リスクが高い。続報で感染確認者数・拡散状況の把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará registra mais 16,8 mil casos de dengue em 2026; Brasil pode ter 860 mil ocorrências em 2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará records another 16.8 thousand dengue cases in 2026; Brazil could have 860 thousand dengue cases in 2027.
article.articleSummary: Ceará, Brazil, registered 16,813 confirmed dengue cases in the first 40 epidemiological weeks of 2026 (through October 10), per IntegraSUS data from the Ceará Health Secretariat (Sesa). In 2025, 4,876 cases were recorded. After declines from 2023–2025, dengue activity rose in 2026 and already exceeds the total of the prior three years. A Brazil-wide projection presented November 6 during the webinar Preparação para a Temporada de Dengue 2027 estimates about 860,000 dengue cases in 2027, with a peak near 40,000 in April and an overall range of 560,000–1.6 million (80% uncertainty). Despite expectations of a super El Niño next summer, the outlook mirrors 2025–2026. Prevention emphasizes removing standing-water containers (plant pots, tires, gutters); individuals with fever, body aches, and rash should seek care at a health unit.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州、2026年にデング熱症例が新たに16,800件登録；ブラジルは2027年に86万件発生の可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで季節性・地方流行性のデング熱症例増加が報告されているが、異常性や重大な公衆衛生インパクトを示す明確な記述はなく、通常のサーベイランス・予測情報の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで季節性・地方流行性の疾患であり、本記事は2026年の症例増加と2027年の予測シナリオに関する統計・公衆衛生準備情報。重症度や入院・死亡の詳細は記載なし。政府機関（Sesa）によるモニタリングとウェビナー開催があり一定の行政関心は確認できるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria, eight other African countries record 67 yellow fever cases, 18 deaths - W.H.O
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever in Nigeria and eight other African countries totals 67 confirmed cases and 18 deaths from January to October 2026, based on data up to October 12, 2026. The affected countries are Burkina Faso (15 cases, 3 deaths), Cameroon (9 cases, 1 death), Central African Republic (2 cases, 0 deaths), Côte d'Ivoire (30 cases, 10 deaths), Ghana (4 cases, 3 deaths), Guinea (1 case, 0 deaths), Liberia (1 laboratory-confirmed infection), Nigeria (4 cases, 1 death), and Togo (1 case, 0 deaths). No deaths have been reported in CAR, Guinea, or Togo. Transmission remains active in the African Region, with recent outbreaks largely concentrated in West Africa near international borders. WHO Disease Outbreak News dated November 6, 2026 notes ongoing yellow fever transmission based on data through October 12, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアを含むアフリカ9カ国で黄熱病67例、死亡18例を記録 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ9カ国（うち対象国はガーナ）にまたがる黄熱病の継続的な伝播があり、死亡例も発生しておりWHO Disease Outbreak Newsが発出されていることから、IHR基準の複数該当が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は西アフリカ複数国にまたがる黄熱病流行を報じているが、対象国リストに該当するのはガーナのみ（4例中3例死亡と致死率が高い）。他の国（ナイジェリア、ブルキナファソ、カメルーン、中央アフリカ共和国、コートジボワール、ギニア、リベリア、トーゴ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Российские туристы пожаловались на неизвестное заболевание в пляжной столице Вьетнама
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russian tourists complained about an unknown illness in Vietnam's beach capital.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists reported influenza-like illness with fever and cough in Nha Trang, Vietnam, including children; doctors could not determine the cause. Symptoms include runny nose, fever, and headache; a child developed symptoms after arrival, with the hospital suspecting a circulating influenza virus, though the type was not specified and antivirals were prescribed. A Moscow tourist has endured a severe cough for three weeks, with CT not revealing the cause. Some travelers speculate contaminated hotel air conditioning, but this remains unconfirmed and no official information on an outbreak or pathogen is provided. In October, Russian tourists reported Coxsackievirus infections in Cam Ranh. After media coverage, Rospotrebnadzor requested information from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and Russia’s tour-operators association; the Russian Travel Industry Union did not confirm a mass outbreak. Direct flights from Kazan to Nha Trang began in May 2025; VietJet Air and Nordwind operate services; travel time about nine hours.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客がベトナムのビーチリゾート都市で原因不明の疾患を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ロシア人観光客の間でインフルエンザ様症状が報告されているが、病原体や集団発生の公式確認はなく、情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未確定（インフルエンザ疑いだが型不明）。ロシア当局（Rospotrebnadzor）がベトナム保健省に照会中だが、集団発生の公式確認はまだない。過去にはコクサッキーウイルス感染の報告もあり、継続的な動向注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил данные о заболевании российских туристов во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data on the illness of Russian tourists in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor has requested information from the Association of Tour Operators of Russia and Vietnam’s Ministry of Health after media reports of influenza-like illness among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam. The agency seeks official data on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and traveler notification. Tourists reported symptoms of runny nose, cough, high fever, and headache. Rospotrebnadzor recommended regular hand washing, avoiding contact with symptomatic individuals, and avoiding crowded places. Gazeta VZGLYAD reported infections with an unknown virus among Russian vacationers in Vietnam. The Russian Union of Travel Industry did not record mass outbreaks of Coxsackie virus among Russians there last month. No confirmed outbreak is established in the article; authorities are seeking clarity and continuing risk communication for travelers.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、ベトナムのロシア人観光客の疾病に関するデータを要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのロシア人観光客間のインフルエンザ様症状の報告があるが、確定診断や集団発生の確認はなく、当局が情報収集中の段階のため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染症の病原体は未確定（インフルエンザ様症状、コクサッキーウイルスの集団発生は否定）。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил данные о заражении туристов из РФ гриппом во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data on influenza infection among Russian tourists in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Influenza infection among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam, prompted official action by Russia's Rospotrebnadzor. On November 7, 2026, the Russian consumer safety and health watchdog sent a request to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia and prepared an official letter to Vietnam's Ministry of Health seeking information on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how tourists traveling to Vietnam are being informed. Reports describe Russian travelers ill with influenza-like symptoms in Nha Trang, including runny nose, severe cough, high fever, and severe headache. The article notes guidance on influenza and respiratory infection prevention, such as regular handwashing, avoiding close contact with the sick, avoiding crowded places when possible, and practicing respiratory etiquette. No laboratory confirmation or case counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ベトナムでのロシア人観光客インフルエンザ感染に関するデータを要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様症状が報告され当局が情報収集を開始したが、検査確定や症例数等の詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ロシア当局がベトナム保健省に情報提供を要請した段階であり、検査確定症例や発生規模は不明。季節性インフルエンザの可能性もあり、続報を注視する必要がある。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил данные о случаях гриппа у россиян во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data on influenza cases among Russians in Vietnam
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor has requested official data from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia regarding reports of influenza among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam. Media chatter from the SHOT Telegram channel describes Russians in Vietnam suffering from an illness with high fever, cough, and headache, characterized as an unknown virus, though the official focus remains on influenza A among Russians. Rospotrebnadzor issued formal inquiries into the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how information is conveyed to travelers to Vietnam, and prepared an official letter to Vietnam’s health ministry. The agency also sought information on influenza A among Russians in the United Arab Emirates. The report provides no case counts or laboratory confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁（Rospotrebnadzor）、ベトナムでのロシア人インフルエンザ症例に関するデータを要請
triage.triage_reason: ロシア当局がベトナムでのロシア人観光客のインフルエンザA感染報告について公式データを要請したが、症例数や検査確定情報がなく、現時点では情報不足のため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はロシアの観光客に関するインフルエンザAの報告であり、確定診断や症例数は未提供。UAEに関する言及もあるが対象国リストに含まれず、ロシアも対象外のため除外。ベトナムが唯一の該当国。

article.articleHeadline: Il a contracté une maladie infectieuse lors d'un voyage en Asie : Mathis, jeune rugbyman de 23 ans, meurt des suites de la dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: He contracted an infectious disease during a trip to Asia: Mathis, a 23-year-old rugby player, dies from dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old Mathis Blondeau, former Rugby Club Quimpérois scrum-half from Quimper, died in Vietnam from dengue fever after a Southeast Asia trip during a gap year. He studied commerce at INSEEC Lyon and, to keep playing, held a license with a Rhone club; his travels included Bali, Indonesia, before arriving in Vietnam, where he died on October 27. The Rugby Club Quimpérois announced the death on November 6 and planned a minute of silence. Dengue is a mosquito-borne infection circulating mainly in tropical and subtropical regions, presenting with high fever, headaches and vomiting, and potentially progressing to severe bleeding and death. The article notes dengue as a re-emerging threat with warming climates and increased travel, citing 21 dengue deaths in Vietnam in the past ten months and a 2023 Bangladesh outbreak of over 1,600 fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: アジア旅行中に感染症に罹患し、23歳のラグビー選手マティスがデング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 個人旅行者がベトナムでデング熱に感染し死亡した単発の訃報記事であり、新たな流行や異常事態を示す情報はないため、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は個人旅行者の死亡事例であり、ベトナムの既存のデング熱流行状況（過去10ヶ月で21人死亡）は背景情報として言及されているのみで、新規の異常事態は確認されない。バリ（インドネシア）は単なる旅程であり感染源としての確証はない。

article.articleHeadline: Uruguai retoma compra de frango do Brasil após foco de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uruguay resumes buying Brazilian chicken after Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, leads Uruguay to approve regionalization and resume poultry product imports from Brazil, ending a national embargo. On Oct 18, a Newcastle disease outbreak was detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Regionalization confines restrictions to Santa Catarina, allowing other Brazilian regions to trade, and Brazil reversed all national embargoes in 19 days—much faster than the 74 days in 2024 after a Rio Grande do Sul focus. China quickly revised its stance within 24 hours after the new occurrence. The change is estimated to reduce export losses to about 15,000 tons per month (≈3% of Brazil’s usual 500,000 tons monthly). Eleven countries still restrict Santa Catarina-origin poultry. Exports from the restricted municipalities (Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim) remain suspended; products under official inspection are deemed safe, per OMSA guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: ウルグアイ、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後、ブラジル産鶏肉の購入を再開
triage.triage_reason: 本事例は動物（家禽）の感染症であり人獣共通感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは報告されておらず、貿易規制も緩和傾向にあるため、ヒトの健康危機シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病でありヒトへの感染リスクは極めて低い。記事は農業・貿易（家禽輸出入規制の緩和）に関する内容で、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。中国やウルグアイの言及は貿易規制緩和の文脈であり、発生国はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор сделал запрос Вьетнаму о заболевании россиян гриппом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor sent a request to Vietnam about Russians' influenza.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor, Russia's consumer health watchdog, has asked Vietnam's Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia for information about influenza among Russian tourists in Nha Trang. Reports describe infected tourists with runny nose, severe cough, headache, and high fever. The request follows media coverage and social-media posts about illness among vacationers in the Vietnamese city. Earlier, the SHOT Telegram channel claimed Russians in Vietnam, including children, were dealing with an unknown virus and that local doctors had difficulty establishing a diagnosis. The article provides no official case counts or confirmed pathogens; it documents an information request to clarify the situation and determine whether any health measures or exposure links apply to travelers returning from Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者保護庁、ロシア人観光客のインフルエンザ感染についてベトナムに照会
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明の呼吸器疾患が報告され当局が照会を行っているが、公式な症例数や病原体の確認はなく情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: SHOTテレグラムチャンネルの報道では「未知のウイルス」との表現もあり、インフルエンザとの確定診断は未確認。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報で病原体確定・症例数・重症度情報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Rondônia acende alerta após confirmar 11 casos de mpox e entra no ranking nacional da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondônia raises alarm after confirming 11 mpox cases and enters the national ranking of the disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Rondônia, Brazil, confirmed 11 mpox cases, ranking fifth nationally behind Rio de Janeiro (269), São Paulo (268), Minas Gerais (33), and Distrito Federal (23). Despite rising diagnoses, no mpox vaccination or intensive public guidance campaign has been announced in Rondônia. Mpox is a viral infection transmitted mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, and contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pains, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin eruptions, with lesions potentially appearing on the face, hands, feet, and genital/anal areas, lasting two to four weeks. Early diagnosis, identification of infected individuals, and preventive measures are crucial to prevent further spread. The situation underscores the need for enhanced epidemiological surveillance and population information to curb transmission in the state.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州がmpox感染11例を確認し警戒を強化、国内ランキングに新たに浮上
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で既に流行しているMpoxが新たな州（ロンドニア）にも拡大しているが、重症度や国際的拡大への言及はなく、ワクチン接種体制の不備が指摘される程度であるため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジルは既にMpoxが複数州で流行中であり、本記事はロンドニア州での新規確認例報告。全国的な症例数（RJ269、SP268等）を踏まえると、国レベルでの流行拡大傾向を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Осипов: странный недуг во Вьетнаме может быть новым штаммом COVID
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Osipov: A strange ailment in Vietnam may be a new strain of COVID.
article.articleSummary: Russian vacationers in Vietnam’s Nha Trang report a wave of illnesses soon after arrival, with fever, severe cough, headache, nasal congestion, and a prolonged temperature spike. The clinical picture resembles influenza, but no specific pathogen has been identified as no diagnostic tests (including PCR) have been performed. Patients receive standard antivirals and symptomatic care. Andrey Osipov, chief physician of Domodedovskaya Hospital, told Zvezda News that this could be a respiratory viral infection, potentially a new coronavirus strain, though Mycoplasma infection is also possible. The lack of laboratory confirmation keeps the diagnosis unknown. The World Health Organization has previously warned about the risk of spread of a new coronavirus strain. No official case counts or outbreak status are provided. The report underscores concern over imported illnesses among Russian tourists in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: オシポフ医師:ベトナムの奇妙な疾病は新型コロナウイルスの新株の可能性
triage.triage_reason: ロシア人観光客に呼吸器症状のクラスターが報告されているが、病原体の検査確認がなく、公式な症例数や発生状況も不明なため、続報を注視する段階である。
triage.notes: 診断確定前の医師個人の推測に基づく報道であり、PCR等の検査結果が未実施。ロシア発信のメディアソースであるため情報の裏付けに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Lolwa : cinq aires de santé sur dix touchées par l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Lolwa: Five health zones out of ten affected by the outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Lolwa health zone, Ituri, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, with five of ten health areas affected: Lolwa, Mambangifi, Pekele, Mabikane, and Mabukunu. As of 07 November 2026, 43 confirmed Ebola cases have been reported, including 19 recoveries and 24 deaths. Surveillance activities continue but are hampered by mobility constraints that prevent full deployment of supervisors to all health areas. Response teams also face training gaps, particularly among Community Relays (RECOs), whose efforts are hampered by insufficient capacity-building. Transport shortages, with only one motorcycle available for the Lolwa health zone since the outbreak began, further impede operations. Dr. Patrick Mbarikale, the zone's medical chief, urged urgent support to mobility and capacity strengthening to improve surveillance and response activities in Lolwa.

triage.headline_ja: ロルワのエボラ出血熱:10の保健地区のうち5地区が流行の影響を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の確認症例43例(死亡24例)が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際拡大リスクが認められるため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAに進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 致死率約56%(24/43)と高く、医療従事者が移動手段や人材育成支援を緊急要請している。サーベイランス体制の脆弱性が感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: casos aumentam há 6 semanas no Brasil; Fiocruz aponta alta nas internações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: cases have been rising for six weeks in Brazil; Fiocruz notes an increase in hospitalizations.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil over six weeks, per the Ministry of Health, with increases identified in 19 federative units plus the Federal District across all age groups. Despite higher case counts, severe COVID-19 remains at low levels, though Fiocruz notes a regional uptick in hospitalizations for grave illness. Since the start of 2026, Brazil has recorded 118,851 cases of influenza-like illness associated with COVID-19 through November 4, though not all infections are captured by surveillance. Private laboratories report nine consecutive weeks of rising test positivity, signaling greater virus circulation. Infectologist Renato Kfouri (SBIm) says the pattern fits typical respiratory-virus waves, potentially influenced by new variants and increased susceptibility, but there is no current evidence of a change in COVID-19 severity.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19: ブラジルで6週間連続で症例増加、Fiocruzは入院の増加を指摘
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例の増加傾向が見られるが、重症度や変異株の変化を示す証拠はなく、既存の季節性流行パターンの範囲内と専門家が評価しているため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル全土でのCOVID-19症例増加と入院増加の報告であり、季節性流行パターンの一環とされ、重症度変化の証拠はないと専門家が述べている。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил данные у Вьетнама из-за заболевания российских туристов
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data from Vietnam due to the illness of Russian tourists.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor (Russia’s consumer health watchdog) asked the Association of Tour Operators (ATOP) and sent a letter to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health over illnesses among Russian tourists in Nha Trang. The agency requested official information on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how information is conveyed to travelers to the Republic of Vietnam. To prevent enteroviral infections, Rospotrebnadzor recommends: regular soap and water handwashing (before meals and after crowded places); drinking only bottled or boiled water and avoiding swallowing pool water; washing fruits and vegetables with boiled or bottled water; minimizing contact with symptomatic individuals; and seeking medical help promptly if health worsens. Previously, Russian tourists reported a “mysterious virus” at Vietnamese resorts, with symptoms like high fever, cough, and severe headache. The report centers on Vietnam and Nha Trang, with Russian travelers affected.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、ロシア人観光客の病気を受けベトナムにデータを要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明の『謎のウイルス』症状（高熱・咳・激しい頭痛）が発生し、ロシア当局が公式情報を要請するなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未特定（『謎のウイルス』『エンテロウイルス感染予防』の記載あり）。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報でベトナム保健省の公式回答や症例数の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : la Police condamne l'attaque contre le centre de traitement Ebola de MSF - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Police condemn attack on MSF's Ebola treatment center - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 7 November 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, unidentified assailants attacked the MSF Ebola treatment center in the Byautu neighborhood, attempting to set it on fire. The National Police condemned the attack and urged protection of healthcare workers and facilities. Gunfire was heard around 22:00 as security forces confronted the assailants; no injuries were reported. The incident followed the daytime death of a young woman, wife of a suspected Wazalendo member, who had tested positive for Ebola. Police said gasoline bottles were found at the scene, not ignited, and seized for investigation. Ebola treatment centers remain essential to outbreak response, and securing these structures is critical amid the ongoing 17th Ebola outbreak in Nord-Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：MSFのエボラ治療センターへの攻撃を警察が非難 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国・北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク下で治療センターへの襲撃事件が発生し、確定感染者の死亡も報告されており、対応継続への重大なリスクとなっているため。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は治療センターへの襲撃という治安事案だが、進行中の第17次エボラアウトブレイク（北キブ州）の一環であり、感染確認例の死亡も報告されているため、アウトブレイク対応の継続状況として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Во Вьетнаме зафиксировали вспышку неизвестного вируса среди российских туристов
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Vietnam, an outbreak of an unknown virus among Russian tourists has been recorded.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of an unknown virus is affecting Russian tourists in the Vietnamese resort city of Nha Trang. Patients report influenza‑like illness, with several children among the affected. A father described a child who developed a runny nose in the evening and a high fever with severe headache by morning. Local doctors mentioned influenza as a possibility but did not disclose the specific pathogen, and concrete diagnoses were not established for the cases. A 39‑year‑old Moscow tourist has been plagued by a three‑week cough, and CT scans failed to yield a definitive diagnosis. Tourists have been prescribed antiviral drugs, and antibiotics are also being used. Some travelers speculate contamination from air conditioning systems as a source. No laboratory confirmation or named causative agent is provided in the report, nor details on case counts or outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムでロシア人観光客の間に未知のウイルスによる集団発生が確認された
triage.triage_reason: 病原体未特定・検査確認なしのインフルエンザ様疾患の集団発生であり、重症度や感染経路など情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ロシア語メディアによる報道で、観光客（ロシア人）の間での発生。病原体は未特定、検査確認なし、症例数・転帰の詳細もなく、空調設備が感染源として憶測されている段階。発生地域としてロシア・モスクワが付与されているが、感染事例はベトナム・ニャチャンで発生しているためベトナムのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: Россияне массово жалуются на вспышку неизвестного вируса во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russians complain en masse about an outbreak of an unknown virus in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Unknown-virus influenza-like illness outbreak among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam, reported as of 7 November 2026. Patients, including many children, exhibit flu-like symptoms such as fever, runny nose, severe headache, and prolonged cough; one Moscow woman, 39, has endured three weeks of coughing. Physicians described the illness as influenza-like but did not confirm an influenza type or provide a definitive diagnosis, and antivirals were prescribed. CT scans failed to clarify the syndrome in at least one case. Some travelers speculate air-conditioning microbes as a source; however, no laboratory-confirmed cases or official outbreak classification is reported. The origin and transmission remain unclear. Reports originate from the SHOT channel, with no data on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア人観光客、ベトナムでの未知ウイルスによる集団感染を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明のインフルエンザ様疾患が集団発生しているが、ラボ確認や公式分類がなく、重症度・感染経路など情報不足のため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にMoscow/Russian Federationが含まれるが、記事の主題はベトナム・ニャチャンでのロシア人観光客への感染であり、発生国はベトナムと判断。ラボ確認された症例や公式な病原体同定はなく、SHOTチャンネルという非公式ソースからの報道である点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор заинтересовался загадочным вирусом во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor Interested in a Mysterious Virus in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s consumer health watchdog, has asked Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and Russia’s Association of Tour Operators (ATOR) for official information regarding reports of Russian tourists contracting a flu-like illness in Vietnam. The inquiry seeks data on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and guidance for informing travelers heading to Vietnam. A SHOT Telegram channel report claimed a mysterious virus affected Russian visitors in Nha Trang, a major resort city. Patients described flu-like symptoms after arrival; in one case a daughter developed a runny nose followed by fever and severe headache, and was hospitalized. Local doctors reportedly identified several such cases at the resort but cannot identify the virus type yet; many of the patients are children. Previously, Rospotrebnadzor requested information about influenza A among Russian tourists in Dubai.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、ベトナムの謎のウイルスに関心
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのリゾート地で原因不明のインフルエンザ様疾患がロシア人観光客に発生し当局が情報収集を開始しているが、病原体の特定や重症度・拡大状況など詳細情報が不足しているため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: ドバイのインフルエンザA型事例は別件として言及されているが、本記事の主題はベトナム・ニャチャンでの未特定ウイルス感染。ロシア・UAEは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。続報で病原体特定情報が得られ次第、再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a avançar no Brasil e acende alerta para internações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is on the rise again in Brazil and raises concerns about hospitalizations.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil for six weeks, with 19 states including Bahia seeing increases across all age groups. Hospitalizations are also increasing: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe reports growing severe COVID-19 cases in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, Mato Grosso do Sul, and the Distrito Federal, and Mato Grosso identifies SARS‑CoV‑2 as the main driver of SARI (severe acute respiratory infection) growth. By Oct 31, Brazil recorded 3,479 SARI hospitalizations with SARS‑CoV‑2 detected and 437 deaths among severe cases where the virus was identified. Private-lab positivity rates have climbed for nine weeks. Experts say waves reflect broader circulation of respiratory viruses and susceptible populations, not yet a change in virulence. Genomic surveillance shows 2,199 sequences through week 42 of 2026, with 127 lineages; ~90% belong to XFG or descendants. Bahia is among 19 states with rising cases; health authorities classify overall activity as low risk.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19が再拡大、入院増加への警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル19州でCOVID-19症例・入院が増加しているが、既知の病原体（既存系統XFG系統中心）による季節性の波であり、当局自体が『低リスク』と分類しているため、現時点ではIHR基準の明確な該当はなく、継続監視が妥当と判断する。
triage.notes: ゲノムサーベイランスでは既知のXFG系統が約90%を占め、新規変異株の出現や病原性変化は確認されていない。当局は全体として『低リスク』と評価しており、入院・死亡増加の推移を注視する段階にある。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya wins praise over its Ebola response strategy
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s imported Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak receives praise from Africa CDC for effective containment. Nine confirmed infections originated from a single transmission chain, with no evidence of community spread. As of Nov 6 (Day 32 since the first imported case on Oct 6), six recovered, one remains in treatment, and no new infections have been recorded in 18 days. The sixth patient was discharged; 66 contacts completed the 21-day monitoring, while 52 remain under quarantine to finish by Nov 11. Kenya will commence the 42-day countdown after the last discharge to declare the outbreak over. Entry screening at 26 points of entry has screened over 760,000 travellers; electronic traveler surveillance via the UHAI Chatbot asks arrivals to report symptoms within 21 days. Continent-wide Ebola, centered in the DRC, totals 10,699 confirmed infections and 5,202 deaths (case fatality rate 48.6%), with ~2,900 recoveries; Africa CDC urges strengthened preparedness and funding.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ対応戦略で称賛を受ける
triage.triage_reason: DRC中心のエボラ流行は10,699例・5,202死亡（CFR48.6%）と深刻で継続中であり、ケニアへの越境輸入例も発生していることから国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおける輸入エボラ症例への対応評価だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは大陸規模流行の中心として実質的データ（感染者数・死亡者数）が明記されており、継続中の重大イベントとして含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор обратился в Минздрав Вьетнама после сообщений о гриппе у россиян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor appealed to Vietnam's Ministry of Health after reports of influenza among Russians.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-07, Russia’s consumer health watchdog Rospotrebnadzor appealed to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia after reports of influenza among Russian tourists. The agency requested official information on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how tourists are being informed. It urged standard precautions: frequent handwashing, avoiding close contact with those showing symptoms, and not attending mass events. For anyone developing high fever, body aches, cough, runny nose, or sore throat, medical care should be sought. The SHOT Telegram channel had earlier reported influenza-like illness among Russian visitors at the popular Nha Trang resort in Khanh Hoa province, with many children among the affected. The exchanges reflect cross-border public health coordination and traveler advisories.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ロシア人のインフルエンザ報告を受けベトナム保健省に照会
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様疾患が報告され、ロシア当局が情報照会を行っているが、現地での規模・重症度等の詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ロシア国内での発生ではなく、ベトナム・ニャチャン（カインホア省）滞在中のロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様症状が確認された事案。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。季節性インフルエンザの可能性もあるが、детали不足のため経過観察。

article.articleHeadline: Arrastão da Dengue percorre quatro bairros de Franca neste sábado, 7; veja quais são - Jornal da Franca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue sweep hits four Franca neighborhoods this Saturday, the 7th; see which ones - Jornal da Franca
article.articleSummary: Four Franca neighborhoods will host a dengue sweep on Saturday, November 7, 2026, starting at 8:00 a.m., as the Municipal Health Department combats Aedes aegypti. Vila Santos Dumont, Jardim Independência, Califórnia, and Raycos will receive health teams that walk streets to collect discarded materials likely to hold water and to educate residents on prevention. Residents should place items on sidewalks; agents will not enter homes. The effort aims to eliminate mosquito breeding sites and reduce dengue transmission. In the last sweep (late October) 5.9 tons were collected in Jardim Aeroporto. Earlier actions covered Jardim Palmeiras, Anita, Residencial Júlio D’Elia, São José, Vila Santa Cruz, Regina Helena, Higienópolis, Roselândia, Francano, Recanto Elimar I & II, Residencial Dourado and Vila Real. Franca has 1,173 confirmed dengue cases with no deaths. For information, contact Vigilância Sanitária at (16) 3706-8437/8438/8439. Keep yards clean and avoid standing water.

triage.headline_ja: デング対策の一斉清掃、今週土曜7日にフランカ市の4地区で実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・フランカ市における日常的なデング媒介蚊対策活動の告知記事であり、死亡例もなく、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、デングはブラジルの風土病であり、本記事は地域の定期的な予防活動の案内に過ぎない。死亡例なし、1,173件の確定例は既存の流行状況の一部と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Andhra Pradesh steps up surveillance, readies isolation beds
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak prompts Andhra Pradesh to boost surveillance: 46 isolation beds across five government hospitals; 3,288 PPE kits, 104 sample collection kits, five ambulances. Airports Tirupati, Bhogapuram and Vijayawada screen suspected cases; ports Visakhapatnam, Kakinada and Nellore conduct health checks. A mock drill is planned for November 12 to test state‑ and district‑level preparedness. State Health Secretary G Veerapandian and Health and Family Welfare Commissioner Chakradhar Babu briefed the Union Ministry on isolation, treatment and referral procedures. Global figures as of Oct 31, 2026: DR Congo 10,467 cases, 5,103 deaths; Uganda 20 cases, 2 deaths; Kenya 9 cases, 2 deaths; Nigeria 1 case; France 1 case; total 10,498 cases, 5,107 deaths. Bundibugyo strain. Travellers from affected countries must be screened; 21‑day travel history checked; asymptomatic individuals self-monitor; direct contacts under medical surveillance for 21 days. Testing at ICMR‑NIV Pune; Visakhapatnam VRDL, Tirupati SVIMS and Vijayawada Siddhartha Medical College.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ発生：アンドラプラデシュ州がサーベイランスを強化、隔離病床を準備
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心としたエボラ流行が複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア、フランス）に拡大しており、致死率も高く深刻。IHR4基準すべて該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインド・アンドラプラデシュ州における水際対策・サーベイランス強化であり、インド国内での発症例は報告されていないため、Indiaはverified_locationsから除外した。実際の流行発生国はDRC（中心）、Uganda、Kenya、Nigeria、Franceだが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Неизвестный вирус подкосил россиян во Вьетнаме: врачи разводят руками
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown virus laid Russians low in Vietnam: doctors at a loss.
article.articleSummary: In Nha Trang, Vietnam, Russian tourists are affected by an outbreak of an illness with symptoms resembling influenza: high fever, severe cough, headache, and a runny nose, with many affected children. A father described his daughter developing a runny nose in the evening and high fever and severe headache the next morning. A 39-year-old Moscow tourist has had a persistent cough for three weeks; CT scanning, costing 12,000 rubles, failed to reveal a cause. Local doctors attributed the illness to influenza but did not specify the type or provide a precise diagnosis, often prescribing antivirals and antibiotics. Tourists speculate about microbes in air conditioning systems. In response, Rospotrebnadzor has sent inquiries to Vietnam's Ministry of Health and to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia, requesting official epidemiological information, current preventive measures, and traveler-notification procedures for trips to Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 未知のウイルスがベトナムでロシア人観光客を襲う：医師も原因特定できず
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでインフルエンザ様症状のアウトブレイクが報告されロシア当局が照会を行っているが、病原体の特定や規模の詳細が不明なため続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: ロシアのメディア報道で、ロシア人観光客を中心とした症例に焦点が当たっている。原因病原体が未特定であり、ベトナム保健省・ロシア消費者権利保護監督庁（Rospotrebnadzor）の公式見解待ちの状況。

article.articleHeadline: "Il était la joie de vivre pure": un Français de 23 ans meurt des suites de la dengue au Vietnam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "He was the pure joy of living": a 23-year-old Frenchman dies from dengue fever in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: French rugby player Mathis Blondeau, 23, died on October 27, 2025, in Vietnam from dengue fever after traveling through Indonesia (Bali). Dengue is a viral illness transmitted to humans by mosquitoes. Blondeau, a scrum-half with Rugby Club Quimpérois (RCQ), had just begun a gap year after earning a Master 2 in Purchases & Supply Chain Management from INSEEC Lyon. His club described him as a leader with a radiant, kind personality; his father, Eddy Blondeau, sits on RCQ's board. The club announced the death on social media, and a minute of reflection and applause will be held Sunday, November 8, 2026, at 15:00 before the derby against Concarneau.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼は純粋な生きる喜びだった」：23歳のフランス人男性がベトナムでデング熱により死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱流行地域（インドネシア・ベトナム）を旅行した個人の死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常な増加や集団発生を示す情報はなく、単発の人的関心記事に留まる。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱流行地域を旅行したフランス人ラグビー選手の個人の死亡を報じるものであり、感染地が特定されていない（バリ経由、ベトナムで死亡）。デング熱は両国で流行性疾患であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生事象を示すものではない。フランスは感染発生国ではなく旅行者の出身国のため対象国に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra aumento de casos de mpox e vacinação é iniciada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records an increase in mpox cases and vaccination is initiated.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox cases in Brazil rose in 2026, prompting the Health Ministry to buy up to 20,000 vaccine doses for preventive use. By October, Brazil reported 665 cases with no deaths. Infectious-disease specialist Dr. Carolina Lázari says mass vaccination isn’t needed yet; priority groups include people living with HIV/AIDS and lab workers handling the virus, with caregivers also at risk. The article recalls 2022’s international emergency with 10,821 Brazilian cases, and 2024’s Congo outbreak driven by variant 1B that led the WHO to declare an ESPII, including child deaths. Rio de Janeiro SES-RJ notes rising cases, with more than 2,000 doses allocated to the city on Nov 4, among 298 confirmed (Jan–Nov 6), 207 in the municipality, zero deaths. In 2025, 119 cases were recorded. Vaccination prioritizes HIV patients; Rio rollout begins with those CD4 <200, ≥18, at five sites including Botafogo, Nova América, ParkShopping Campo Grande, CEVAA, and CRIE/INI.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpox症例が増加、ワクチン接種開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が増加しワクチン接種が開始されたが、死亡者はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻な影響は確認されていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（リオデジャネイロ州含む）におけるMpox症例増加とHIV患者等を優先したワクチン接種開始を主題としている。DRCの2024年流行への言及は過去の国際的背景説明であり、現在の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。死亡者ゼロ、重症度の記載なしであることから深刻度は限定的と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 dá sinais de alta no RJ, e Belford Roxo registra três casos graves até outubro - Belford Roxo 24h
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 shows signs of an uptick in Rio de Janeiro state, and Belford Roxo records three severe cases through October - Belford Roxo 24h.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz reports signs of an uptick in severe COVID-19 cases in Rio de Janeiro state, with Belford Roxo recording three residents who developed severe acute respiratory syndrome due to Covid-19 and required hospitalization from January through October 2026; one case began in October. As of November 2, none of the three had died. In the six weeks Sept 20–Oct 31, Belford Roxo had one severe case in October; data are currently insufficient to confirm a local rise. The counts reflect patients’ residence; SIVEP-Gripe tracks severe respiratory cases; mild/moderate Covid-19 are logged elsewhere. Statewide, 505 severe Covid-19 cases with onset Jan–Oct 2026, 486 hospitalizations and 73 deaths; Rio de Janeiro city contributed 180 severe cases and 27 deaths. On Oct 21, Belford Roxo’s health department held a vaccination action in Heliópolis for meningitis, also updating Covid-19 vaccination; 110 doses were administered across vaccines (meningitis, flu, Covid-19, dengue, HPV, yellow fever).

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ州でCOVID-19の増加傾向、ベルフォード・ロショでは10月までに重症3例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 通常のサーベイランス報告の範囲内であり、重症例数も少なく死亡例もなし。異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体レベルの通常のCOVID-19サーベイランスデータ報告であり、地域の増加傾向も「確認には data不足」とされている。ワクチン接種活動の報告も含まれるが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор выяснит, чем заболели российские туристы во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor will determine what Russian tourists fell ill with in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor is investigating reports that Russian tourists in Vietnam became ill with influenza-like illness in Nha Trang. The agency has not confirmed a specific disease and is requesting official epidemiological information from the Association of Tour Operators of Russia and the Vietnamese Ministry of Health. The inquiry follows media coverage of a suspected illness among travelers, characterized by high fever, cough, and headache, with a Telegram channel alleging an unknown virus. In early October there were rumors that Coxsackie virus was involved. Health officials advise anyone with high fever, body aches, cough, runny nose, or sore throat to seek medical care, and emphasize monitoring for travelers to Vietnam. The investigation aims to clarify the illness source, preventive measures, and how information is communicated to tourists.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ベトナムでロシア人観光客が罹患した疾病の原因を調査へ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様疾患が発生したとの報道があるが、病原体は未確定で公式疫学情報も未入手のため、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 原因病原体は未確定（インフルエンザ様症状、一部報道ではコクサッキーウイルスの噂もあり）。ロシア当局がベトナム保健省等に正式な疫学情報を要請している段階であり、現時点では情報不足。Russian Federationは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил у Минздрава Вьетнама данные о заболевших россиянах
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data from Vietnam's Ministry of Health on Russians who were ill.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s consumer health watchdog, has asked Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) for official data after reports of Russian tourists in Nha Trang with flu-like illness. Patients report runny nose, severe cough, high fever, and strong headache; many affected are children. Local doctors have not confirmed a precise diagnosis. The agency requested information on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how tourists are being informed before travel. Health advisories emphasize influenza/respiratory infection precautions: regular hand washing, avoiding contacts with symptomatic individuals, practicing respiratory etiquette, and avoiding crowded places when possible. If symptoms such as body aches, high fever, sore throat, cough, or runny nose occur, individuals should seek medical care and inform clinicians of recent travel, whether during a trip or after returning. The situation is described as under control by Rospotrebnadzor.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁(ロスポトレブナゾール)、ベトナム保健省に罹患ロシア人に関するデータを要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様症状が報告されているが、診断未確定かつ詳細情報が不足しているため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。診断は未確定で、インフルエンザ様症状としか報告されていない。当局は「状況はコントロール下にある」としている。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 avança e hospitais registram alta de casos em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 advances and hospitals report a surge in cases in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in São Paulo, Brazil, with October seeing a notable uptick in hospital confirmations. At Hospital Sírio-Libanês, positives rose to 70 in October from 19 in September and 12 in August; Hospital Santa Catarina – Paulista reported 98 confirmed cases in October versus 57 in September. SES and the NIES panel identify increased coronavirus circulation starting in late September, though current levels remain well below the peaks of 2025. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin also notes more severe COVID-19 cases in São Paulo and other states, reinforcing vigilance for vulnerable groups. Common symptoms resemble other respiratory infections and include sore throat, runny nose, congestion, headache, dry or persistent cough, fever, fatigue, body aches, and diarrhea. Vaccination remains available for free via SUS, with boosters and updated vaccination encouraged to reduce complications and hospitalizations; continued preventive measures are advised.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19が拡大、サンパウロの病院で症例急増
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロでCOVID-19症例が増加しているが、2025年のピークを下回る水準であり、既存の季節的変動の範囲内とみられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 既知のCOVID-19の季節的増加であり、既存の公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種、サーベイランス）で管理されている。新規変異株や異常な臨床像の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил данные о заражении россиян гриппом во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data on Russians infected with influenza in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s consumer health watchdog, requested data on Russians infected with influenza in Vietnam after media reports of cases among Russian tourists in Nha Trang. The agency sent formal inquiries to the Association of Tour Operators Russia (ATOR) and prepared a letter to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health, seeking epidemiological information on the region. Tourists reportedly experienced fever, runny nose, severe cough, and headache. Rospotrebnadzor advised regular hand hygiene, avoiding crowded places, limiting close contact with the sick, and seeking medical care if symptoms appear; travelers returning to Russia should inform their doctor about recent travel. On October 6, the agency noted it had also asked the Vietnamese health ministry and ATOR for official results following reports of Coxsackie virus illness at a hotel in Vietnam, with the MoH to provide investigation outcomes and risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督局、ベトナムでロシア人観光客がインフルエンザに感染した事例についてデータを要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に季節性インフルエンザ様症状の集団発生が報告され、ロシア当局が情報収集中だが、詳細な疫学情報や重症度は不明なため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの可能性が高く、ロシア国内メディア報道を受けた当局の確認要請段階。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、発生国としてはベトナムのみを記載。併せてコクサッキーウイルスの事例も言及されているが、本イベントの主題はインフルエンザ。

article.articleHeadline: Propriedade em Nova Erechim passa por desinfecção após foco de doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Property in Nova Erechim undergoes disinfection after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, centered on a Nova Erechim property. Three initial foci identified Oct 18–26—Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim—have completed sanitation; the fourth focus has finished depopulation. Disinfection of the affected poultry houses is ongoing, and after the required empty period the farms may resume activity. Cidasc and Mapa, with SISA-SC, oversee operations, including surveillance that has inspected all commercial poultry facilities and 100% of backyard holdings in the initial zones, with continued monitoring around the fourth focus. Six road barriers disinfect more than 1,000 vehicles daily. Internationally, Uruguay reversed national trade restrictions in 19 days, recognizing sanitary regionalization and resuming imports from other Brazilian states; restrictions now apply only to Santa Catarina. Estimated poultry export impact: about 15,000 tons per month (≈3% of Brazil’s average monthly exports of ~500,000 tons).

triage.headline_ja: ノバ・エレシンの農場、ニューカッスル病発生後に消毒作業を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の家禽におけるニューカッスル病発生で、貿易制限（ウルグアイの輸入停止）が一時的に生じたが、人の健康への影響はなく、既に防疫措置（消毒・淘汰・監視）が進み収束傾向にあるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、人への健康影響はほぼ無視できるレベル。貿易制限は既にウルグアイが19日で解除しており、影響は限定的・縮小傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue suma 43 casos en Miramar y Nombre de Dios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue totals 43 cases in Miramar and Nombre de Dios
article.articleSummary: Dengue totals 43 cases in Miramar and Nombre de Dios, both in Santa Isabel district, Upper Caribbean coast of Colón Province, Panama, with 37 cases in Miramar and 6 in Nombre de Dios. The Ministry of Health (Minsa) implemented fogging and community outreach to eliminate mosquito breeding sites. Cases affect a broad age range from under 5 years to adults. Year-to-date dengue in Colón stands at 2,912 cases in 2026. The Minsa urged residents to cooperate in eliminating breeding sites to curb transmission, highlighting ongoing vector-control efforts in these communities.

triage.headline_ja: ミラマールとノンブレ・デ・ディオスでデング熱43例に
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はパナマにおけるデング熱の発生であり、対象国リストに含まれないため、また規模も地域的な通常の流行対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にBrazilが含まれるが記事の主題はパナマであり対象国外。パナマの地方保健当局による通常の媒介蚊対策の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Amazonas registra queda histórica de 29% nos casos de malária - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amazonas records historic 29% drop in malaria cases - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Amazonas fell 29% from January to October 2026, totaling 38,149 cases—the lowest for the period since 2016. Announced on Friday, November 6, 2026, during World Malaria Day in the Americas at the PAHO Regional Meeting closing in Brasília. The Amazonas Health Surveillance Foundation (FVS-RCP) highlighted local strategies, notably tafenoquine, the shorter-course treatment now used in 14,813 people, deployed in 33 municipalities for adults and in 27 for children. Governor Roberto Cidade credited frontline endemic-area agents; FVS-RCP Director Tatyana Amorim attributed the decline to vigilant surveillance, innovation, and partnerships with municipalities. Despite the historic drop, Elder Figueiredo, Director of Environmental Surveillance, warned that the case load remains substantial and urged seeking medical care at the first malaria symptoms to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州、マラリア症例が過去最大29%減少 - アマゾナス州 | Portal do Holanda
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例数の歴史的減少を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の脅威の増大や異常事態ではなく、むしろ対策の成功を示すポジティブなニュースである。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア症例の減少（改善傾向）を報じるものであり、新規脅威やアウトブレイクではない。ただし症例数自体（38,149件）は依然として多く、地域の風土病として継続監視対象ではある。

article.articleHeadline: Ataque mata ao menos 44 e força pacientes com ebola a fugir no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Attack kills at least 44 and forces Ebola patients to flee in Congo.
article.articleSummary: An attack by militants linked to the Islamic State killed at least 44 people and forced Ebola patients to flee a clinic in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The assault targeted a health centre treating Ebola near Cantine-Aloya village, about 45 km west of Beni. Dozens of homes were burned and residents fled. Authorities identify the attackers as Allied Democratic Forces, an ISIS-affiliated group since 2019. The current Ebola outbreak—first detected in May—has become the second-largest on record and has spread across eight eastern provinces of the DRC. While reported infections have declined in some areas, numbers rise in zones harassed by armed groups not yet reached by the response. The article does not specify laboratory confirmation details or any imported/exported cases, focusing on the ongoing security and public health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで攻撃により少なくとも44人死亡、エボラ患者が避難を強いられる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上2番目の規模となっているエボラ流行が、武装勢力の攻撃により治療拠点からの患者避難を招き、対応が妨げられ国際的拡大のリスクも高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 武装勢力（ISIS関連のADF）による攻撃がエボラ対応を妨害しており、流行が東部8州に拡大している。治安悪化により対応が届かない地域で感染者数が増加している点が懸念される。
