article.articleHeadline: Votuporanga confirma segundo caso de leishmaniose visceral em 2026 e liga alerta para a saúde pública
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Votuporanga confirms second case of visceral leishmaniasis in 2026 and issues a public health alert.
article.articleSummary: Votuporanga confirms the second case of visceral leishmaniasis in 2026. A 17-year-old resident of Vila Marim is hospitalized and receiving treatment. The first case of the year occurred in Pozzobon—a 48-year-old man who responded to public-health–provided therapy and is now cured. Visceral leishmaniasis (kala-azar) is caused by Leishmania infantum and damages the liver, spleen, and bone marrow. Symptoms typically appear weeks to months after infection and include prolonged fever, weakness, weight loss, anemia, and abdominal swelling. Transmission occurs via bites from infected female sand flies; urban dogs are common reservoirs. Delayed diagnosis can lead to hemorrhages, immune suppression, secondary infections, and organ failure, with high mortality if untreated. Treatment is free through Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS), enabling cure when started early.

triage.headline_ja: ヴォトゥポランガ市、2026年2例目の内臓リーシュマニア症を確認し公衆衛生警戒を発令
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で流行地域における内臓リーシュマニア症の散発例（年間2例目）であり、既存の公衆衛生システムで対応可能な通常の症例報告であるため、特段のシグナルとはみなされない。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれる「Veneto」「Italian Republic」は記事内容と無関係（Bluedotの地域付与誤り）。記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州ヴォトゥポランガ市の内臓リーシュマニア症（砂蝿媒介、犬が保菌動物）に関する地域保健当局の通常の注意喚起報道であり、国際的拡大や異常発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde alerta para aumento dos casos de Covid-19 no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of rising COVID-19 cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Rising COVID-19 cases in Brazil over six weeks with increasing hospitalizations and signals of more severe disease across different regions, according to a Fiocruz bulletin dated November 5. Despite the uptick, overall indicators remain low nationally, with the Ministry of Health classifying COVID-19 activity as low risk in all states, while Fiocruz notes severe-case incidence remains reduced. Since January 2026, Brazil has logged 118,851 notifications of COVID-19–like syndrome, with official data updated through November 4. Common symptoms include fever or chills, cough, sore throat, runny nose or congestion, headache, fatigue, muscle aches, and loss or alteration of smell and taste, as well as diarrhea, nausea, and vomiting. Alert signs requiring immediate care include shortness of breath, persistent chest pain or pressure, blue lips or face, confusion, or trouble staying awake.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ブラジルにおけるCOVID-19症例の増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでCOVID-19症例・入院が増加傾向にあるが、当局は全州でリスクを「低」と分類しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻な懸念は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省・Fiocruzともに重症例の増加は限定的としており、既知の季節性変動の範囲内とみられる。続報があれば入院率・重症度の推移を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Militantes incendian centro de salud para el Ébola en Congo, matando al menos a 44.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Militants burn Ebola treatment center in Congo, killing at least 44.
article.articleSummary: At least 44 people were killed when the Allied Democratic Forces, an ISIS-aligned group, set fire to an Ebola treatment center near Cantine-Aloya, about 28 miles west of Beni in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. The assault began late on November 5, forcing fleeing patients and causing widespread destruction as homes were burned. The attack highlights how violence has complicated the Congo’s Ebola outbreak, with cases declining in some districts but rising in others where armed groups hinder health workers from operating. Eastern Congo hosts more than 100 armed groups after decades of conflict, turning some areas into Ebola hotspots and hampering containment. The Times cites The New York Times; ISIS-linked ADF has been active in the region since 2019, known for brutal abuses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで武装勢力がエボラ治療センターを放火、少なくとも44人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、武装勢力による治療センター襲撃で44人が死亡し、封じ込め活動が著しく妨害されている。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と異常性が認められ、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ADF（ISIS系武装勢力）による攻撃がエボラ対応を妨害しており、東部コンゴでは100以上の武装勢力が活動する地域が感染拡大のホットスポット化している。治安要因が疫学対応に直結する複合危機として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил у Вьетнама данные о заболевших гриппом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data from Vietnam on influenza cases.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor has requested data from the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) on influenza cases among Russian tourists in Vietnam and prepared an official letter to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health. Trigger were reports of Russians in Nha Trang with runny nose, severe cough, high fever and headache. The agency seeks official information on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how travelers to Vietnam are being informed. The situation is described as under control by Rospotrebnadzor. In Russia, influenza activity is stable; authorities updated all three vaccine components, signaling new influenza strains for which the population has limited immunity, said Dmitry Lioznov, director of the A. A. Smorodintsev Research Institute of Influenza (Ministry of Health). The Evening Moscow cited Dr. Nadezhda Chernyshova on what is known about the new strains and protection strategies.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁（ロスポトレブナゾル）、ベトナムに対しインフルエンザ患者データを要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム滞在中のロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様症状が報告され当局が情報照会を行っているが、疫学的詳細や重症度、異常株かどうかは不明であり続報を要する。
triage.notes: ロシア国内のインフルエンザ流行状況やワクチン更新の情報も含まれるが、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ベトナムの公式疫学データは未確認。

article.articleHeadline: Un Français de 23 ans fan de rugby meurt à cause de la dengue au Vietnam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 23-year-old French rugby fan dies from dengue fever in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: A 23-year-old French rugby player, Mathis Blondeau, died in Vietnam from dengue fever contracted during an Asia trip, the Quimper Rugby Club in Brittany (France) announced. Dengue, a mosquito-borne illness, led to his death on 27 October after he had visited Indonesia before Vietnam. Blondeau, a scrum-half, had just earned a Master 2 in management in Lyon and was taking a year off to travel in Asia. The club described him as a leader and a joyful presence, and plans a minute of silence with applause on Sunday at 15:00 before a Federale 3 match in his honor, a tribute posted on Facebook. The case highlights a travel-associated dengue fatality occurring abroad rather than in France.

triage.headline_ja: ラグビー好きのフランス人青年(23歳)、ベトナムでデング熱により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一の渡航関連デング熱死亡例であり、ベトナム・インドネシアともにデング熱は流行地域で異常性がなく、アウトブレイクを示す情報もないため見送りと判断。

article.articleHeadline: После новостей о загадочной болезни Роспотребнадзор направляет запрос во Вьетнам
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following reports of a mysterious disease, Rospotrebnadzor sends a request to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor (Russian consumer health watchdog) on November 7, 2026, issued official inquiries to Vietnam's Ministry of Health and to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia regarding the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and traveler information for Vietnam. The move follows media reports of Russian tourists in Nha Trang experiencing illness, with symptoms including runny nose, severe cough, high fever, and intense headache. Some outlets described an unknown fever-and-cough virus; Rospotrebnadzor's press release characterizes the illness as influenza. Russian tour operators say there have been no widespread health complaints among Russian travelers in Vietnam. The article does not mention laboratory confirmation, specific case counts, or transmission sources, and no details about imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 「謎の病気」報道を受け、ロシア消費者保護・福祉監督局がベトナムに照会
triage.triage_reason: ロシア人観光客の体調不良についてロシア当局がベトナム保健省に照会したが、検査確認・症例数・重症度などの詳細情報がなく、公式には季節性インフルエンザとされているため、現時点ではフルRRAに進むには情報不足。
triage.notes: ロシア側（Rospotrebnadzor）は病原体をインフルエンザと公式発表しているが、検査確定情報や症例数、重症度の詳細は記事中に記載なし。観光業者は健康被害の広範な訴えはないとしている。続報での検査結果・症例詳細の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Salud vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla a guardaparques de áreas protegidas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health vaccinates park rangers in protected areas against yellow fever.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccination campaign in Paraguay targets park rangers in protected wildlands lacking vaccination, conducted by the Ministry of Public Health with interagency partners (Health Surveillance Directorate, National Vector-borne Diseases Program, PAI, and the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development). Emphasizes pre-travel immunization for areas with virus circulation or risk zones. Yellow fever spreads via urban Aedes aegypti and sylvatic Sabethes and Haemagogus; monkeys are reservoirs and infected mosquitoes transmit the virus to humans entering the jungle. Transmission cycles include urban and sylvatic; the latter occurs in tropical Latin America and Africa. High-risk countries with active circulation include Brazil, Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela; Paraguay and Argentina have areas conducive to reactivating sylvatic cycles. Notably, Paraguay experienced a 2008 outbreak in Central Department and rural San Pedro and Caaguazú, with 28 confirmed cases and 11 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、保護区の公園管理官に黄熱病ワクチンを接種
triage.triage_reason: 予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する記事であり、新規発生や異常事態の報告ではない。対象国（パラグアイ）は対象国リストに含まれず、社会的関心や緊急性を示す情報もない。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा में बढ़ा डेंगू का प्रकोप: सामने आए 800 से अधिक मामले, पंचकूला और सोनीपत में सबसे ज्यादा केस, स्वास्थ्य विभाग ने जारी की चेतावनी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Outbreak Surges in Haryana: Over 800 Cases Reported, Panchkula and Sonipat Have the Most Cases, Health Department Issues a Warning
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak surges in Haryana: As of November 7, 2026, the state has recorded 903 dengue cases this year, with over 800 new infections reported in the last three months. Panchkula is the most affected district with 106 cases, followed by Sonipat (81). Other districts affected include Karnal (77), Faridabad (75), Gurgaon (75), and Jhajjar (62). No dengue deaths have been reported this year. A door-to-door survey found dengue larvae in more than 141,000 homes. Under the Municipal By-laws (VBD Control) 2010, notices have been issued to 69,498 people (66,211 by the health department and 2,287 by urban local bodies). Ongoing measures include fogging and larvicidal spraying, with health officials urging the public to remove standing water and regularly clean coolers and pots to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州でデング熱の流行が拡大：800件以上の症例を確認、パンチクラとソニパトで最多、保健局が警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: インド・ハリヤナ州における季節性のデング熱流行であり、死亡例なし・地域の防疫体制（燻蒸、幼虫駆除、通知発行）で対応が進んでいる。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、ルーティンな公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: インドでは毎年季節的にデング熱が流行しており、本記事も例年の地域的流行報告の一環と考えられる。死亡者なし、地域保健当局による対応（燻蒸・幼虫駆除・通知）が実施されており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Vĩnh Long: 9 người bị chó dại cắn, địa phương triển khai biện pháp ứng phó
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vĩnh Long: Nine people bitten by rabid dogs, local authorities implement response measures.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak confirmed in Giao Long commune, Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam. A stray dog identified with rabies attacked and bit 9 people and 1 dog between 30 October and 2 November 2026. The dog died on 2 November; samples tested positive for Rabies virus at the Central Veterinary Diagnostics and Testing Center II on 4 November. Eight of the nine bite victims sought medical care and received rabies post-exposure prophylaxis and, where indicated, rabies immunoglobulin; one case remains awaiting treatment guidance. Local authorities have ordered euthanasia of the infected dog and initiated heightened surveillance of dogs and cats, with ongoing monitoring in Giao Long. The provincial veterinary department and the provincial CDC are coordinating surveillance, pet population census, and public outreach to prevent further spread of rabies; no mention of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィンロン省：狂犬病の犬に9人が噛まれ、地元当局が対応策を実施
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はベトナムで風土病的に発生しており国際的な異常性は低いが、曝露者への対応状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地方レベルでの狂犬病発生事例。当局による曝露後予防や監視対応が実施されており、現時点で国際的拡大の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Un Français de 23 ans meurt au Vietnam après avoir contracté la dengue : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 23-year-old Frenchman dies in Vietnam after contracting dengue fever: News
article.articleSummary: French 23-year-old Mathis B. died in Vietnam on October 27 from dengue fever, a viral infection transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, after an Asia-wide journey that included Indonesia (Bali) before Vietnam. The death was announced by his rugby club on November 6. Dengue is caused by a viral infection spread by Aedes mosquitoes, according to Institut Pasteur. Mathis B. was from Quimper and played scrum-half for RC Quimper; he had begun a gap year traveling across Asia and was set to pursue Master's studies in Lyon upon return. A memorial calling for a minute of reflection and applause was scheduled for Sunday, November 8 at 15:00 ahead of a Federale 3 match. The report highlights dengue's ongoing risk to travelers in Southeast Asia.

triage.headline_ja: 23歳のフランス人男性、デング熱に感染しベトナムで死亡
triage.triage_reason: 渡航者個人の死亡例であり、ベトナムにおけるデング熱流行拡大やアウトブレイクを示す情報はなく、公衆衛生上の異常事態や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアの風土病であり、本記事は個別の渡航者死亡事例を報じたもの。ベトナムやインドネシアでの感染拡大・異常増加を示すデータはない。フランス・インドネシアは対象国または主題国でないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Esvaziar vasos de plantas não basta para eliminar ovos da dengue, aponta estudo da CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emptying plant pots is not enough to eliminate dengue-carrying mosquito eggs, according to a CNN Brasil study.
article.articleSummary: Eggs of Aedes aegypti persist on container walls above the waterline and survive after plant pots are emptied. A CNN Brasil study warns that merely removing standing water does not eliminate dengue risk. To interrupt the mosquito lifecycle, thoroughly wash and scrub interior container surfaces to mechanically remove eggs. Rain and irrigation water can travel through unseen routes, with gutters and drains retaining moisture. Breeding sites can be hidden inside homes: appliance trays in refrigerators, portable air conditioners, dehumidifiers, and water dispensers that collect water due to leaks. Outdoors, small items such as buckets, bottles, toys, boxes, lids, bags, and pet water bowls require cleaning and regular liquid replacement. Daily inspections and prevention routines—keeping vessels covered, cleaning appliance trays, clearing gutters, and sanitizing pet dishes—reduce arbovirus transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 植木鉢の水を捨てるだけではデング熱を媒介する蚊の卵を除去できない、CNNブラジルの研究で判明
triage.triage_reason: 蚊の繁殖予防に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、具体的な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱予防に関する一般的な啓発・教育コンテンツであり、特定の発生事例や感染者数の増加を報告するものではないため、対象国としての発生報告には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya anunță că șase pacienți cu Ebola s-au vindecat, iar unul primește în continuare tratament
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announces that six Ebola patients have recovered, and one is still receiving treatment.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports six Ebola patients have recovered with negative virus tests, while one remains in treatment, keeping confirmed cases at nine with two fatalities. No new Ebola cases or community transmission have been detected for 18 days since Oct 19. Kenya’s Health Ministry continues vigilance, testing travelers at 26 entry points, with over 760,000 travelers screened to date. The Bundibugyo strain’s first case in the country was confirmed Oct 6 in a person who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years and later died in Nairobi. A 21-day monitoring period completed by 66 contacts, with 52 more nearing completion next week. After the last patient leaves treatment with no detectable virus, a 42-day follow-up (twice the incubation) will begin before declaring the outbreak over; emergency operation centers and rapid-response teams remain activated nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ患者6人が回復、1人は引き続き治療中と発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)のヒト感染確認例であり、致死率・国際伝播リスクの観点から重大な公衆衛生事象に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 初発症例はケニア・ナイロビで確認されたもので、感染者はDRCに7年居住歴があったが発症・感染拡大はケニア国内で発生している事例。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCは背景情報としての言及に留まりverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Des militants incendient un centre de santé contre l'Ebola au Congo, tuant au moins 44 personnes.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Militants set fire to a health center in Congo in the fight against Ebola, killing at least 44 people.
article.articleSummary: On the night of 5 November 2026 in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, militants from the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), an ISIS-aligned group, set fire to a health center treating Ebola patients near Cantine-Aloya, about 45 km west of Beni. The attack, reported by the New York Times, forced patients to flee; at least 44 people were killed and many homes burned as residents evacuated. The broader Ebola outbreak in the region continues, with case numbers fluctuating—declining in some areas but rising where armed groups block health workers. More than 100 armed groups operate in eastern Congo, and some control zones that have become Ebola hotspots, hindering containment. The ADF has been affiliated with ISIS since 2019 and is known for brutal violence, including decapitations, sexual violence, and child abductions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ対策の保健センターが武装勢力により放火され、少なくとも44人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ治療施設への攻撃により封じ込め活動が妨げられ、感染拡大リスクが高まっているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 武装勢力ADFによる保健センター攻撃がエボラ封じ込め活動を阻害しており、感染拡大の継続的リスクが高い。渡航・貿易制限に関する具体的言及はないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: OMS da luz verde a ensayos de dos nuevas vacunas contra el Ébola ante grave brote en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO gives the green light to trials of two new Ebola vaccines amid a severe outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization endorses adding two experimental Ebola vaccines, ChAdOx1 BDBV and mRNA-1469, to the Tumaini trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to combat Bundibugyo virus amid a severe Ebola outbreak across Africa. The decision, announced November 4, 2026, follows review of preclinical data and early clinical results. ChAdOx1 BDBV (Oxford University and Serum Institute of India) uses a viral-vector platform; mRNA-1469 (Moderna) uses messenger RNA technology. Both aim to induce immunity against Bundibugyo virus; neither is authorized for use or proven effective in humans yet and must obtain national approvals before inclusion. The ongoing Africa-wide balance reported by Africa CDC on November 4, 2026 cites over 10,400 confirmed cases and more than 5,300 deaths, with case fatality above 50%. Bundibugyo virus causes high-severity disease with fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, vomiting, diarrhea, coagulopathy, organ damage; transmission occurs via contact with blood and bodily fluids, not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカでの重大なエボラ流行を受け、2種類の新規エボラワクチンの試験にゴーサインを出す
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心としたエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）のアフリカ全土での大規模流行（確定症例10,400例超、死者5,300人超、致死率50%超）であり、国際機関（WHO）が新規ワクチン試験承認という異例の対応を取っていることから、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン開発元（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。致死率50%超、1万人超の感染者という極めて深刻な規模であり、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue pode causar complicações graves e levar à morte; conheça os sintomas de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue can cause severe complications and lead to death; learn the warning signs.
article.articleSummary: Brazil projects about 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027, announced during the Dengue Season Preparation webinar. While not signaling an epidemic at 2024 levels, the prognosis maintains warning about severe disease and death risk. Dengue is a viral illness transmitted by the female Aedes aegypti mosquito, ranging from mild to life-threatening forms with hemorrhages, organ impairment, and circulatory shock. Early recognition of initial symptoms and especially warning signs is essential. Common manifestations include sudden high fever (39–40°C), severe headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle and joint pains, fatigue, nausea/vomiting, and a red rash. Not all infections are symptomatic; symptomatic cases typically last 2–7 days, though full recovery may take longer. Alarm signs of severe dengue include intense abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, dizziness or fainting, marked drowsiness or irritability, and difficulty breathing; any warrant immediate medical evaluation. Severe cases involve plasma leakage, hypotension, and organ failure, increasing mortality risk.

triage.headline_ja: デングは重篤な合併症を引き起こし死に至ることも；警戒すべき症状を知る
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する一般的な健康啓発・症状解説記事であり、特定の異常な集団発生や急激な増加を示す情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 2027年の予測症例数860,000件に言及しているが、2024年水準のエピデミックではないとされており、記事は啓発目的の一般情報記事。

article.articleHeadline: Após confirmar dois casos, Acre reforça vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After confirming two cases, Acre reinforces measles vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed measles cases in Acre prompt reinforced vaccination. An 11‑month‑old child and a 30‑year‑old woman, both residents of Puerto Maldonado, Peru, were diagnosed with measles by Fiocruz in early October. Acre’s health secretary announced a vaccine blockade in Rio Branco and Brasileia targeting contacts and those indicated for vaccination; measures planned at Rio Branco’s Huerb and Into, with Brasileia surveillance teams. The patients travelled through Assis Brasil and Brasileia before care in Rio Branco; infection source under epidemiological investigation, with importation pending final classification. A cross‑border vaccination mobilization on 7 November involves Brazil, Peru, and Colombia, in Tabatinga, Benjamin Constant, São Paulo de Olivença, Atalaia do Norte (Amazonas) and across ports, markets, schools, and indigenous communities (DSEIs Alto Rio Solimões and Vale do Javari; Casai). Brazil reports 65 imported measles cases in 2026 (21 in Amazonas, 2 in Rio Branco); Peru >2,000; Colombia 17; Brazil supplied 500,000 vaccine doses to Peru; surveillance maintained after 2024 elimination status.

triage.headline_ja: 2例確認後、アクレ州は麻疹ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州で麻疹輸入例が確認され、ペルー・コロンビアとの越境ワクチン接種対応が行われており、2024年の排除認定後の再興事例として国際的拡大リスクと異常性が認められるため。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアも関与するが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めず。ブラジルは2024年に麻疹排除認定を受けており、今回の輸入例再興は公衆衛生上重要な動向。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Ghana introduces mandatory health declaration for travellers
article.articleSummary: Ebola, amid heightened outbreaks in parts of Africa, drives Ghana Health Service to impose a mandatory Health Declaration Form for all travellers arriving in Ghana. Effective 12 November 2026, passengers must complete the online form before departure at https://ehds.ghs.gov.gh/declaration. The measure aims to strengthen public health surveillance, improve monitoring of potential health risks, and support early detection and prompt reporting of suspected infectious diseases. Airlines, travel agencies, and other stakeholders are urged to inform passengers and ensure form completion prior to travel. Dr Samuel Kaba Akoriyea, Director-General of the Ghana Health Service, stated the directive safeguards the health and well-being of residents and visitors. The move forms part of broader efforts to bolster cross-border surveillance amid ongoing Ebola concerns in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ガーナが渡航者に健康申告書の提出を義務化
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ各地でのエボラ出血熱の流行拡大を受け、ガーナが渡航者に健康申告を義務化するなど越境サーベイランス強化策を導入しており、国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航制限の基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナ自体でのエボラ発生ではなく、アフリカ他地域（具体的な国名は記載なし、恐らくDRC等）での流行拡大を受けた予防的渡航対策について述べている。ガーナ国内での症例報告はないため、対象国リストに該当する確定的な発生国は特定できず verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Cinco estados concentram sinais de aumento dos casos de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five states show signs of an increase in COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: Five Brazilian states show signs of increasing SRAG due to SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19): Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina, per Fiocruz InfoGripe for 25–31 October 2026. In the latter four, COVID-19–related SRAG remains at very low levels; in Mato Grosso, the SRAG trend linked to SARS-CoV-2 is associated with a slight uptick in rhinovirus cases. Over the four most recent epidemiological weeks, SRAG positives were 50.1% rhinovirus, 10.1% RSV, 4.2% influenza A, 4.7% influenza B, and 8.5% SARS-CoV-2. Deaths among SRAG positives were 43% rhinovirus, 24.1% SARS-CoV-2, 12.7% influenza B, 3.8% RSV, 1.3% influenza A. Aracaju (SE) and João Pessoa (PB) show SRAG activity at alert/risk/high risk with a long-term growth signal over six weeks; Roraima, Sergipe and Santa Catarina remain at alert/risk/high risk but without long-term growth.

triage.headline_ja: 5つの州でCOVID-19症例増加の兆候が集中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の定期サーベイランス(InfoGripe)によるSRAG動向報告であり、COVID-19関連のSRAGはほとんどの州で低水準にとどまるが、一部地域で増加傾向が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（ライノウイルス、RSV、インフルエンザ、COVID-19）の通常のサーベイランスレポートであり、特段の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Rondônia entra entre os cinco estados com mais casos de mpox em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondônia ranks among the five states with the most mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rondônia, Brazil, confirmed 11 mpox cases in 2026, ranking fifth nationally behind Rio de Janeiro (269), São Paulo (268), Minas Gerais (33), and the Distrito Federal (23). Despite the higher case count, the state has not announced an official vaccination start or large-scale public-awareness campaigns. Mpox is caused by the mpox virus and transmits mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects from infected individuals. Early symptoms include fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, and swollen lymph nodes, followed by skin eruptions and lesions that can appear on the face, hands, feet, and in genital and anal regions, lasting two to four weeks. Health authorities highlight rapid identification of cases and immediate isolation as key measures to curb the virus’s spread.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドニア州、2026年のエムポックス感染者数で上位5州入り
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで既知のエムポックス感染が継続しているがワクチン接種開始の遅れが見られる程度で、重篤性や急激な拡大を示す新規情報はなく、ルーチン的な症例数報告にとどまる。
triage.notes: ロンドニア州はワクチン接種開始の公式発表や大規模な啓発活動を行っていない点が懸念材料だが、死亡者数や重症例の情報はなく、既知の感染症の継続的な状況報告にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Municípios da tríplice fronteira recebem mobilização contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tri-Border Municipalities Receive Mobilization Against Measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination mobilization in Brazil’s Tri-Border area with Peru and Colombia on 7 November 2026 targets Tabatinga, Benjamin Constant, São Paulo de Olivença, and Atalaia do Norte in Amazonas. The Ministry of Health, with local authorities, aims to boost immunity via health units, ports, markets, schools, and home visits, supported by Alto Rio Solimões and Vale do Javari Special Indigenous Districts and Casai. To strengthen regional response, 500,000 doses of the MMR vaccine were allocated to Peru, which reports over 2,000 measles cases in 2026; Colombia has 17 cases this year. In Amazonas, vaccination is offered to all residents from 6 months, with 6–11 month-olds receiving a zero-dose. From 12 months, vaccination follows age-appropriate schedules. Brazil has been measles-endemic-free since 2024; 65 imported cases in 2026, including 21 in Amazonas (Tabatinga 9; Benjamin Constant 6; São Paulo de Olivença 4; Atalaia do Norte 2). 2025 Amazonas first-dose 89.7%, second-dose 76%.

triage.headline_ja: 三国国境地帯の自治体、麻疹対策の予防接種活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルー・コロンビアの三国国境地域で麻疹の越境伝播が確認されており、ブラジルは麻疹排除状態であったにもかかわらず輸入症例・地域内感染が増加しているため、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大）を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: ペルー（2000例超）・コロンビア（17例）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルは2024年以降麻疹排除状態だったが、2026年に65例の輸入症例（うちアマゾナス州21例）が報告されており、国境地域での予防接種強化が行われている。重症度（死亡・入院）に関する情報は記事中に記載なし。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo, oltre 10mila casi e 5mila morti in Congo: l'allarme dell'Oms
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Bundibugyo: Over 10,000 cases and 5,000 deaths in Congo — WHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues, as of 3 November 2026 reported by WHO: 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths, yielding a case fatality around 49%. The virus has reached 67 health zones across 8 provinces, with active transmission in 51 areas; though some local declines, transmission remains grave and hard to contain. A worrying share of fatalities occurred before treatment: among 512 deaths since October 21, 335 occurred in communities and 177 in treatment centers. Outside DRC, Kenya has 9 cases and 2 deaths; Nigeria has one confirmed case; Switzerland and the United Kingdom have evacuated citizens who tested positive. WHO urges strengthening border controls, rapid case finding and coordinated public health actions; however, travel or trade restrictions are not recommended.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）：コンゴで1万人以上の感染、5000人以上の死亡 — WHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、67保健地域に拡大、国外への感染者流出（ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス・英国）が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイス・英国での症例は輸入例・退避例であり、対象国リストのうちDRCのみが実際の発生国として該当。ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará chega a 40 casos de mpox; Fortaleza concentra 87,5%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará reaches 40 mpox cases; Fortaleza accounts for 87.5%.
article.articleSummary: Ceará state, Brazil, reported 40 confirmed mpox (monkeypox) cases in 2026 as of Nov 6. Of these, 35 are in Fortaleza (87.5%). Two hospitalizations occurred; no deaths. All confirmed patients are men aged 24–51. Cases are concentrated in the last two months: 18 in October and 17 in November to date; nine months previously had five cases. Twelve investigations remain ongoing, and one probable case in a woman was classified clinically-epidemiologically. Symptoms include fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions; transmission occurs mainly via close contact with lesions or bodily secretions, sexual contact, contaminated objects, or prolonged respiratory exposure. Prevention emphasizes isolation, avoiding sexual contact until evaluated, covering lesions, hygiene, and not sharing personal items. Vaccination is used selectively for high-risk groups or post-exposure, with mpox vaccines linked to Orthopoxvirus; the article’s text on smallpox vaccination is incomplete.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州でmpox症例が40件に到達、フォルタレザが87.5%を占める
triage.triage_reason: 過去2か月で症例が急増（9か月で5件→直近2か月で35件）し、性的接触等によるヒト-ヒト感染リスクが継続している可能性があるため、経過を精査する必要がある。
triage.notes: mpoxはブラジルで既にエンデミック化しているが、セアラ州での直近2か月の急増とヒト-ヒト感染（性的接触含む）の可能性から注視対象とする。重症例・死亡は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Một trường hợp viêm cơ tim tối cấp do sốt xuất huyết hiếm gặp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A rare case of fulminant myocarditis due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: 27-month-old girl in Ho Chi Minh City with dengue fever developed fulminant myocarditis, cardiogenic shock and multi-organ failure. NS1 positive dengue. Within 12 hours of admission to Ho Chi Minh City Children's Hospital she required intubation, vasopressors and mechanical ventilation as respiratory failure and shock progressed. Cardiac enzymes were markedly elevated; echocardiography showed EF 28–30% (later 24–26%). Diagnosed with dengue-associated fulminant myocarditis and dengue shock syndrome with liver injury, she was transferred to ICU and started on VA-ECMO to support circulation and respiration. She developed multi-organ dysfunction, needing eight sessions of continuous renal replacement therapy and hepatic/renal support. After nearly five weeks on VA-ECMO and about two months of care, cardiac function recovered to EF 48–52%, blood pressure stabilized, and she was weaned from ECMO and ventilation; liver and kidney functions recovered. By November 2026, Ho Chi Minh City reported around 45,000 dengue cases and 11 deaths; preventive measures urged.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱による重症劇症型心筋炎の稀な症例
triage.triage_reason: 個別の稀少な重症デング症例報告だが、ホーチミン市での大規模流行（約45,000例・死亡11例）を伴っており、地域的な流行状況として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は個別重症症例の臨床詳細が中心だが、同市での大規模デング流行（45,000例、死亡11例）の文脈が含まれるため、流行状況の継続監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: В РСТ заявили о сезонном уровне заболеваемости гриппом во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST announced the seasonal level of influenza incidence in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Vietnam remains at seasonal levels, with no mass illnesses reported among organized Russian travelers. The Russian Union of Travel Industry (RST) cites tour operators saying there are no widespread complaints from Russian tourists, and insurers report no surge in influenza-related claims; morbidity is typical for the season. The RST has requested additional information from host companies to monitor the situation. Earlier, amid media reports of Russian tourists contracting influenza in Nha Trang, Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor sent a query to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia and prepared an official letter to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health, seeking official data on the epidemiological situation and preventive measures. The update is dated 7 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: RST、ベトナムでのインフルエンザ発生率は季節並みの水準と発表
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのインフルエンザ活動は季節通常レベルであり、異常な集団発生やロシア人観光客への大規模な健康被害は確認されていないため、シグナルとしての要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: ロシアの旅行業界団体・消防衛生当局がナチャンでの報道を受けて情報照会を行っているが、公式には季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内とされている。ロシア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: A virus found in one out of ten patients in China is carried by a tick species that is spreading across the US
article.articleSummary: ALTNV, an Asian longhorned tick-borne orthonairovirus, was identified in China among 3,163 febrile patients; 328 (10.4%) tested positive for ALTNV by PCR or IgM. ALTNV was detected in ticks from 15 Chinese provinces, with the Asian longhorned tick Haemaphysalis longicornis carrying it most often (1.75% of tested ticks; overall ALTNV in ticks 1.29%). Among ALTNV-alone infections (n=56), fatigue (84%), GI symptoms (80%), thrombocytopenia (38%), and elevated aminotransferases (36%) were common; all recovered without lasting effects. Coinfection with the SFTS-causing Dabie bandavirus (DBV) in 38 patients correlated with more severe disease: respiratory symptoms 61% vs 38% in DBV-only; kidney impairment 84% vs 66%; deaths 7 (18.4%). Recommendations: enhanced testing to distinguish ALTNV from DBV; expanded tick surveillance; note tick vector also spreading in the United States, with New Jersey reported 2017 and 21 states by Oct 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 中国で10人に1人の患者から検出されたウイルスは、米国で拡大中のマダニ種が媒介している
triage.triage_reason: 中国で新規のダニ媒介性オルソナイロウイルス(ALTNV)がSFTS起因ウイルス(DBV)との共感染で重症化・死亡例を伴って報告されており、ベクターとなるマダニの地理的拡大（米国含む）も示唆されるため、新興感染症としてフルリスク評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: 米国（ニュージャージー州等）はマダニベクターの地理的拡大に関する言及のみで、ヒト感染症例の発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。本記事は査読研究に基づくサーベイランス報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク速報ではない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Tríplice fronteira recebe mobilização de vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Triple Frontier Receives Measles Vaccination Campaign.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination campaign conducted across the tri-border area of Brazil, Peru, and Colombia. In Brazil, four Amazonas municipalities led a joint drive targeting ports, riverine communities, and indigenous areas, with health units and home visits. The Ministry of Health supplied MMR doses to Peru, which reports thousands of cases and leads Americas notifications; Colombia also reports confirmed cases. Brazil remains free of endemic measles circulation but records dozens of imported cases concentrated in Amazonas border cities. The campaign vaccinates babies from six months of age with dose zero, regardless of prior history. Authorities stress sustaining high vaccination coverage, active case finding, and rapid vaccination blocks to curb transmission, aided by cross-border cooperation. Response underscores border health measures as of 2026-11-07.

triage.headline_ja: トリプルボーダー地域で麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは麻疹の地域流行はなく国境都市での輸入症例にとどまるが、ペルー・コロンビアでの感染拡大を受けた国境を越えたワクチン対応が継続しており、今後の越境伝播の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルはアマゾナス州国境都市での輸入症例とワクチン接種キャンペーンの主体として記載されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 29 con trâu, bò chết bất thường trong rừng ở Nghệ An
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 29 buffaloes and cows died abnormally in a forest in Nghệ An.
article.articleSummary: 29 buffaloes and cattle died abnormally from 3–7 November 2026 in four hamlets of Hữu Kiệm commune, Nghệ An Province, Vietnam. A herd of 33 buffaloes owned by Ven Phò Thủy (49) in Khe Nạp hamlet saw 19 deaths; affected animals showed bloating and abdominal distension, foamy saliva, with some experiencing dyspnea and swollen limbs before death. Local authorities culled the carcasses to curb spread, advised disinfection and restricting grazing, and kept remaining cattle in pens for monitoring. On 7 November, veterinary staff collected samples and sent them to the Nghệ An Department of Livestock Production and Veterinary Medicine to determine the cause. Investigations are ongoing, with laboratory confirmation pending; authorities emphasize containment and monitoring across the four hamlets as results are awaited.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省の森林で水牛・牛29頭が異常死
triage.triage_reason: 動物の原因不明の集団死で炭疽等の人獣共通感染症の可能性が否定できないが、ヒトへの感染や原因病原体は未確定のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 症状（腹部膨満、流涎、呼吸困難、四肢腫脹）から炭疽や他の家畜感染症の可能性があるが、検査結果待ちでヒトへの感染報告はない。原因判明の続報を要監視。

article.articleHeadline: Nghệ An hàng loạt trâu, bò ở xã miền núi chết chưa rõ nguyên nhân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nghệ An: Mass die-off of buffalo and cattle in a mountainous commune, cause unknown.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 30 head of buffalo and cattle have died in the mountainous Hữu Kiệm commune, Nghệ An province, Vietnam, as of 7 November 2026. From 3–6 November, 25 animals died (Khe Nập village: 21; Bao Nam: 3; Na Lượng: 1). On 7 November, 4 more deaths were recorded, bringing the total to 29. Most deaths occurred among animals grazing in forested areas. Affected livestock exhibited rapid onset with swollen necks, foaming at the mouth, difficulty breathing, and abdominal distension; post-mortem exams showed darkened lungs. Local authorities conducted rapid reporting to the Nghệ An Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary and collected samples for laboratory testing to determine the cause. The incident is being treated as a suspected disease outbreak with undetermined etiology at present.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省：山岳地域の集落で水牛・牛が大量死、原因不明
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ゲアン省の山間部で原因不明の家畜（水牛・牛）大量死が発生しており、症状（頸部腫脹、口からの泡、呼吸困難、肺の黒変）から炭疽等の人獣共通感染症の可能性も否定できないが、現時点で人への感染報告はなく情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症状（頸部腫脹、口からの泡、呼吸困難、肺の黒変）は炭疽等の人獣共通感染症に類似する可能性があり、検査結果と人への健康影響の有無について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 voltam a subir no Brasil; especialistas reforçam importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise again in Brazil; experts stress the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising again in Brazil, but the national risk remains low. By early November 2026, Brazil recorded over 118,000 coronavirus-associated influenza-like illness notifications, with private labs reporting nine weeks of higher test positivity. In 19 states and the Federal District, infections increased across all regions: North (Rondônia, Roraima); Northeast (Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Maranhão, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí); Central-West (Distrito Federal, Goiás, Mato Grosso); Southeast (Espírito Santo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo); South (Paraná, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina). GISAID sequencing identified 127 lineages; the XFG variant and derivatives account for about 90%. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe notes rising coronavirus-related hospitalizations in the Distrito Federal, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina and São Paulo; Mato Grosso reports COVID-19 as the main cause of acute respiratory infections. By Oct 31, 2026, 3,479 hospitalizations and 437 deaths with the virus were recorded. Vaccination remains crucial, especially for high-risk groups: 60+ should get a dose every six months; pregnant women one dose per pregnancy; others follow specific schedules. Seek care if breathing difficulties occur.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19症例が再び増加、専門家がワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で季節的なCOVID-19の増加が報告されているが、当局は国家リスクを低いと評価しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていないため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 国家保健当局（Fiocruz/InfoGripe）がモニタリングしており、季節性の増加としてワクチン接種を推奨する通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Cidades da tríplice fronteira realizam mutirão de vacinação contra o sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tri-Border Area cities conduct a measles vaccination drive.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination drive across the Tri-border area (Brazil, Peru, Colombia) aims to curb transmission. In the Brazilian Amazon, teams operate in Tabatinga, Benjamin Constant, São Paulo de Olivença, and Atalaia do Norte, at basic health units, ports, schools, markets, and via house-to-house visits, supported by Indigenous health districts Alto Rio Solimões and Vale do Javari and Indigenous Health Houses. Vaccination rules: babies from 6 months can be vaccinated, with 6–11 months receiving dose zero as added protection (not replacing the routine calendar); from 12 months, the standard schedule applies. Brazil has been free of endemic measles since 2024 after a 2019 outbreak. In 2026, 65 imported measles cases were recorded in Brazil, 21 in Amazonas near Peru and Colombia. Brazil has supplied Peru with 500,000 doses of the MMR (measles-mumps-rubella) triple viral vaccine; Peru reports over 2,000 cases this year; Colombia has also reported notifications.

triage.headline_ja: 三国国境地域の都市で麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルー・コロンビアの三国国境地域で麻疹の越境伝播が確認されており（ブラジルで輸入65例、ペルーで2,000例超）、ワクチン未接種人口を抱える地域での感染拡大リスクがあるためフルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年に麻疹の地域流行排除を達成しているが、2026年にアマゾナス州を中心に輸入症例が増加。ペルー・コロンビアとの国境地域での先住民族コミュニティを対象としたワクチン接種活動が実施中。ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Exportação de frango brasileiro é liberada após foco de doença de Newcastle em SC, mas 11 países mantêm restrições ao Estado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian chicken exports are cleared after a Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, but 11 countries maintain restrictions on the state.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in western Santa Catarina, Brazil, at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba on Oct 18 triggered 19 days of national poultry export restrictions. By Nov 6, exports resumed to all international markets except Santa Catarina, where 11 markets still restrict imports of SC-origin poultry. Uruguay lifted restrictions, and China revised its bans within 24 hours of confirmation. Regionalization limits restrictions to the affected area, now Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim; products from these municipalities remain non-exportable. Estimated export impact is about 15,000 tonnes per month, roughly 3% of Brazil’s average monthly poultry exports (~500,000 tonnes). Brazilian authorities, with SDA, SCRI, MRE, and Cidasc, emphasize regionalization and the safety of officially inspected poultry.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル産鶏肉輸出、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後に解禁されるも、11カ国は同州への制限を継続
triage.triage_reason: 家禽(七面鳥)でのニューカッスル病発生による貿易制限事例だが、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は無く、動物衛生・貿易分野の事案としてIHR基準の該当は限定的。経済・貿易への影響があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽(七面鳥)のニューカッスル病であり、動物衛生・貿易影響が主眼でヒト感染症のリスク評価対象ではない。中国は記事中で言及されているが、発生国ではなく輸入規制を緩和した国であるため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: ആശങ്കയായി ഉത്തർപ്രദേശിലെ എയ്ഡ്സ് ബാധിതരുടെ കണക്ക്; 1.74 ലക്ഷം രോഗബാധിതരിൽ 587 പേർ തടവുകാർ | Uttar Pradesh HIV cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming AIDS figures in Uttar Pradesh; among 174,000 infected, 587 are prisoners | Uttar Pradesh HIV cases
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Uttar Pradesh has about 174,000 people living with HIV, with 587 prisoners among them. The HIV burden drives intensified testing and treatment under the UP State AIDS Control Society, including access to antiretroviral therapy (ART). Jail populations show regional concentrations: Mathura Jail (48 inmates), Saharanpur (42), Moradabad (41), Gautam Buddha Nagar (41), Ghaziabad (36), and Lucknow (32). Infected inmates are placed in dedicated wards, with periodic medical visits to monitor health and ensure ART continuation. A 2023 integrated screening campaign targeted HIV, tuberculosis, hepatitis B and C, and sexually transmitted infections, conducted by the AIDS Control Society in partnership with the jail department and health department, aiming to detect illnesses early and provide treatment and counseling.

triage.headline_ja: 懸念されるウッタル・プラデーシュ州のエイズ感染者数；174,000人の感染者中587人が受刑者
triage.triage_reason: 既知の慢性的HIV流行状況の統計報告であり、急性の公衆衛生危機や異常事態を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: HIV/AIDSは既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事はウッタル・プラデーシュ州の受刑者を含む感染者統計と既存の対策プログラム（ART提供、統合スクリーニング）についての定例的な報告。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: В РСТ высказались о заболеваемости гриппом среди россиян во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST commented on the incidence of influenza among Russians in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Vietnam is at seasonal levels, per the Russian Union of Tourism Industry (RST) citing TASS, with no mass flu complaints from organized Russian tourists. Separately, SHOT Telegram channel reported an unknown virus affecting Russians in Vietnam, including several cases in Nha Trang. A child was hospitalized after fever and runny nose; another, a 39-year-old Moscow woman, has a three-week cough, with CT unable to yield a diagnosis, yet antivirals and antibiotics were prescribed. Tourists suspect the virus may spread via microbes in air conditioning. Rospotrebnadzor has shown interest and contacted the Vietnamese Ministry of Health. No confirmed influenza outbreak is reported; authorities are monitoring the situation as seasonal influenza activity continues in Vietnam. Published 2026-11-07.

triage.headline_ja: RST、ベトナムにおけるロシア人のインフルエンザ罹患について言及
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのインフルエンザは季節性の範囲内とされているが、原因不明のウイルスに関する報告もあり、当局が状況を注視しているため情報不足の段階として経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの範囲内との公式見解だが、原因不明ウイルスの報告があり、ロシア消費者保護監督庁（Rospotrebnadzor）がベトナム保健省に接触している。続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : le gouverneur militaire appelle à une mobilisation générale contre l'épidémie - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the military governor calls for a general mobilization against the epidemic - LePotentiel
article.articleSummary: On November 6, 2026, the military governor of Ituri Province, General-Major Kasongo Mulumba Batoka Gaby, called for a collective mobilization against the Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Ituri, DR Congo. He urged residents to observe health measures, report suspected cases, and cooperate with response teams. The provincial government has strengthened coordination and surveillance, with regular follow-up meetings and guidance to authorities to monitor epidemiology, identify and track contacts, raise community awareness, and mobilize resources to interrupt transmission. He lauded the response teams and urged continued professionalism. Six preventive measures were recommended: report suspected cases or unusual deaths; avoid contact with bodily fluids; follow hygiene and health directives; allow safe patient transport and secure burial practices; cooperate with response teams and monitor contacts for 21 days; reject rumors and rely on official communications. He condemned hostility toward responders and urged solidarity to end the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イツリでのエボラ出血熱：軍政知事が流行に対する全面的動員を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、政府が全面的動員を呼びかけるなど公衆衛生上深刻な懸念があり、国際的拡大リスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: エボラはIHR Annex2の既知の常時通報対象疾患であり、DRCでの継続流行として引き続き監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: РСТ: Заболеваемость гриппом во Вьетнаме остается на сезонном уровне
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RST: Influenza incidence in Vietnam remains at the seasonal level.
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Vietnam remains at the usual seasonal level, according to the Russian Union of Tour Operators (RST). Russians vacationing in Nha Trang reported flu-like symptoms, but local doctors have not given definitive diagnoses. Based on interviews with tour operators, there are currently no widespread complaints among organized Russian tourists in Vietnam; insurance companies report no surge in cases. Overall influenza activity in Vietnam stays within normal seasonal levels. RST has requested additional information from Vietnamese host companies to clarify the situation. The statements were reported by TASS, citing an RST interlocutor. No details on imported or exported cases were provided.

triage.headline_ja: RST：ベトナムのインフルエンザ罹患率は季節レベルを維持
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザ流行は季節性レベル内であり、異常性や重症化、国際的拡大の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: ロシア人観光客の体調不良報告はあるが確定診断なし。季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内とされ、特段のシグナルなし。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 crescem há seis semanas no Brasil e acendem alerta para aumento de quadros graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases have been rising for six weeks in Brazil, raising alarms about an increase in severe cases.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases have risen for six consecutive weeks in Brazil, with increases across regions and all age groups. Data through the Oct 25–31 week show growth in 19 federative units, but disease activity remains classified as low risk in all states. Since 2026 began, Brazil has logged 118,851 notifications of COVID-19–related influenza-like illness through Nov 4, though not all infections are diagnosed or reported. The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin (Nov 5) reports signs of growing Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) associated with COVID-19 in Mato Grosso, the Distrito Federal, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Santa Catarina; Mato Grosso is the main driver of severe cases, while others stay at low levels. Overall SRAG cases trend downward over the last 3– and 6-week analyses. Private-lab test positivity has risen for nine consecutive weeks. Vaccination remains the primary prevention strategy; groups at highest risk should stay up to date, as new variants and susceptible populations may fuel waves.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19症例が6週連続で増加、重症化増加への警戒強まる
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例の増加傾向が見られるが、疾病活動は全州で低リスクに分類されており、重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)全体は減少傾向にあるため、現時点では緊急性は低いが推移の注視が必要。
triage.notes: COVID-19の季節的増加であり既知の病原体によるもの。全体のSRAGは減少傾向で、一部地域（マトグロッソ州）のみ重症例増加が見られる。ワクチン接種で対応可能とされており、国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: Uruguai retoma importações do Brasil - 07/11/2026 - Agro - C-Level
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Uruguay resumes imports from Brazil - Nov 7, 2026 - Agro - C-Level.
article.articleSummary: New Newcastle disease outbreaks in Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggered regional export restrictions. On Nov 7, 2026 Uruguay resumed imports of Brazilian poultry, but embargoes are limited to Santa Catarina, where the first Newcastle disease case was recorded Oct 18 in Nova Itaberaba, with additional foci in Coronel Freitas and Nova Erechim and a sanitary area including Águas Frias. Mexico and Malaysia briefly suspended Brazilian poultry imports but reversed; Saudi Arabia, China, and Chile had regional bans on shipments from Santa Catarina. Brazil emphasizes regionalization, noting nationwide embargoes reversed in 19 days after the initial restriction (versus 74 days in 2024 Rio Grande do Sul). The impact on exports is about 15,000 tonnes/month (≈3% of the 500,000 t avg). The government plans to revert restrictions to a regional scope, while assuring consumers that officially inspected poultry remains safe.【2026-11-07】

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：ウルグアイがブラジルからの輸入を再開 - 2026年11月7日 - Agro - C-Level
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州における家禽のニューカッスル病流行で、内容は貿易・輸出規制に関するものであり、人の公衆衛生への直接的影響は確認されていない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり、人への感染リスクは極めて低い。記事内容は家禽輸出の貿易制限・解除に関するもので、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Paraguay reporta 10 semanas sin dengue, pero con incremento del 29 % en notificaciones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Paraguay reports 10 weeks without dengue, but with a 29% increase in notifications.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay reports 10 weeks without dengue, but a 29% rise in notifications in recent days, mainly in Central, Asunción, Caaguazú, Cordillera, San Pedro and Amambay. The Ministry of Health notes Aedes aegypti remains the dengue transmitter (also linked to chikungunya and other arboviruses) and urges elimination of breeding sites to curb spread. The current epidemiological picture is interepidemic and stable, with no dengue virus circulation and an average of 235 weekly notifications. Year-to-date dengue cases reach 293. Rainy conditions may raise arbovirus risk; recommended actions include draining, covering, and discarding standing water; removing unused items that collect water; chlorinating pools; keeping tanks and containers sealed; changing water in animal bowls daily after cleaning; discarding water in plant dishes; cleaning gutters regularly. Seek medical care for fever, body aches, headaches, or malaise; avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ナシオン紙／パラグアイ、デング熱なしの10週間を報告も、報告件数は29%増加
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイでは現在デングウイルスの流行はなく、流行間期で安定した状況と報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当なし。社会的関心も通常の公衆衛生広報の範囲内。
triage.notes: 記事はパラグアイ（対象国リスト外）におけるデング熱の状況に関する通常の公衆衛生モニタリング報告。発生地域にフィリピンが含まれているが、記事本文はパラグアイの状況のみを扱っており、フィリピンでの発生は記載されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 teve aumento de casos em cinco estados do Brasil, alerta Fiocruz - Ser Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 saw an increase in cases in five Brazilian states, Fiocruz warns - Ser Saúde.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rose in Brazil over the past six weeks, with the last week of October (25–31 Oct 2026) showing increases in Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina, per Health Ministry data and Fiocruz analysis. From Jan 1 to Nov 4, 2026, 118,851 influenza-like illness cases attributed to SARS-CoV-2 were reported, though undercounted due to diagnostic gaps. Hospitalizations for SRAG with SARS-CoV-2: 3,479; deaths among severe cases with the virus: 437. In the last four weeks, Fiocruz reports SARS-CoV-2 detected in 8.5% of severe respiratory illness and in 24.1% of fatalities within this group. The ministry also tracks circulating lineages. Metapneumovirus rose in Southeast, South and Northeast states—São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, Paraná, Bahia, Alagoas, Pernambuco, Paraíba, Sergipe. Rhinovirus contributes to deaths in children two years old or younger; elderly deaths mainly SRAG.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル5州でCOVID-19症例増加、フィオクルスが警告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19症例の季節的増加であり、重症化率・死亡率も報告されているが、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限等の深刻な懸念は確認されない。呼吸器系ウイルス（メタニューモウイルス等）の同時流行動向を継続観察する必要がある。
triage.notes: フィオクルス（ブラジル国立公衆衛生研究機関）が複数州でのCOVID-19症例増加とメタニューモウイルスの流行を報告。季節性呼吸器感染症の通常範囲内の動向とみられるが、死亡者数・重症化データの推移を継続監視する必要がある。対象国以外の地域（ペルー等）は言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Health Update | Two Ebola Vaccine Candidates Recommended for DRC Trial; Nigeria and Kenya Monitor Contacts
article.articleSummary: DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak: WHO accelerates vaccine research; two candidates, ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469, may join the Tumaini trial in Bunia, Ituri; outbreak >10,500 cases and >5,100 deaths as of Nov 1; Ervebo evaluated against Bundibugyo; PARTNERS trial with remdesivir and monoclonal antibodies. Nigeria: 1 confirmed imported Ebola case; 62 contacts (6 completed 21-day monitoring; 56 under surveillance); >630,000 health screenings at entry points since Oct 28; two suspected cases negative. Kenya: 5 discharged; 46 contacts completed quarantine; no new infections for two weeks; first imported case Oct 6; 20 contacts completed 21 days by Oct 26. Ghana: four yellow fever cases contained; vaccination campaigns ongoing. Liberia: WHO assesses preparedness in Lofa, Bong, Margibi; gaps in screening, PPE, trained staff, isolation capacity; priority equipment and training. EMTs Global Meeting in Addis Ababa calls for sustained funding; goal for an operational team in every African country by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: 週刊保健アップデート | DRCでの臨床試験に向け2種類のエボラワクチン候補を推奨、ナイジェリアとケニアは接触者を監視
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ種）アウトブレイクが10,500例・5,100人以上の死亡に達し、既に複数国へ拡散しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラアウトブレイク（致死率約50%）とナイジェリア・ケニアでの輸入症例対応、ガーナの黄熱病症例の封じ込めを含む週次まとめ。ナイジェリア・ケニア・リベリア・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор проверяет информацию о возможной вспышке неизвестного вируса у российских туристов во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor checks information about a possible outbreak of an unknown virus among Russian tourists in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor is examining information about a possible outbreak of an unknown virus among Russian tourists in Vietnam. The agency has contacted Vietnam's Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia to obtain official details on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how travelers to Vietnam should be informed. A Telegram channel, SHOT, previously claimed that Russian tourists in Vietnam were reporting an unknown virus. Reported symptoms include high fever, cough, and headache. Rospotrebnadzor emphasized that it is seeking verified data from authorities. The Russian Union of Travel Industry rejected the reports, stating there have been no mass complaints from organized Russian tourists in Vietnam, and insurers also reported no mass claims. No confirmed outbreak has been announced as of 7 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ベトナムのロシア人観光客の間で未知のウイルスが発生した可能性についての情報を確認中
triage.triage_reason: 未確認情報であり、ロシア旅行業界団体は集団的な苦情を否定しているが、公的機関が確認作業中であるため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 情報源はTelegramチャンネルの未確認情報であり、ロシア旅行業界団体や保険会社は集団的な健康被害の報告を否定している。確認された発生は現時点でない。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الإبلاغ عن 10668 إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا و5198 حالة وفاة بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports 10,668 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,198 deaths in Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports 10,668 confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases and 5,198 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 3 November 2026, transmission remains widespread across 67 health zones in 8 provinces, with active transmission in 51 zones. Crude case fatality rate is 48.7%. Since 21 October, 512 deaths occurred, comprising 335 community deaths and 177 deaths in treatment centers. No new cases have been reported in Kenya or Nigeria. The outbreak requires ongoing regional preparedness, including cross-border surveillance, entry screening, early case detection, and coordinated response. No new countries reported cases; Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and Northern Ireland evacuated citizens with confirmed infections for medical reasons. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions with affected or responding countries, based on current information.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ確定症例10,668件、死者5,198人を報告
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.7%の大規模エボラ流行が8州67保健地域に拡大し、スイス・英国等への感染者越境搬送も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアでは新規症例なし。スイス・英国・北アイルランドは感染確定者の医療搬送であり現地発生ではないため対象国リストに非該当。WHOは渡航・貿易制限を推奨していないが、既に感染者が国境を越えて搬送されている事実から国際拡大リスクはYesと判断。

article.articleHeadline: "مكافحة الأمراض": أكثر من 5 آلاف حالة وفاة بفيروس الإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Disease Control": More than 5,000 deaths from the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the National Center for Disease Control reports Ebola virus disease (EVD) developments as of November 1, 2026: 10,532 laboratory-confirmed cases, 5,126 deaths, and 2,834 recoveries. The outbreak spans 67 health zones, with 45 zones showing active transmission; 36,126 contacts are being followed. The agency emphasizes ongoing surveillance and response, and has issued new guidelines as risk rises. Internationally, Kenya reports 9 EVD cases (2 deaths) linked to the outbreak; Nigeria records 1 case; Uganda reports 20 cases (2 deaths); and France reports 1 case. Overall, confirmed cases increased by 10% and deaths by 14.8% compared with the previous period. The update highlights expanded spread and intensified monitoring across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 「疾病対策」：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスによる死者が5,000人超
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行が国際的に拡大（ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、フランスに波及）しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、フランスでの症例は対象国リスト外（ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・フランスは対象国に含まれない）のため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な発生国はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Violencia continúa afectando centros de tratamiento de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Violence Continues to Affect Ebola Treatment Centers in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Violence continues to disrupt Ebola control efforts in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with attacks in Beni and Cantine, North Kivu. After an assault by the Allied Democratic Forces on Cantine, several suspected Ebola patients and high-risk contacts fled the Kelele hospital, with the incident occurring Thursday night to Friday dawn and at least 30 civilians killed. Fleeing patients included those in isolation or exposed to the virus, raising transmission concerns. A separate attack targeted an MSF-run Ebola treatment center in Beni Friday night–Saturday, thwarted by security forces; attackers allegedly aimed to burn the facility, echoing burnings in Ituri. Such acts threaten the outbreak response declared on May 15, worsen infection risk, endanger health workers, and weaken care structures for patients.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターへの暴力が続く
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ流行下で武装勢力による攻撃により隔離患者が逃走し、感染拡大リスクが高まっている。公衆衛生上重大かつ対応体制を脅かす異常事態であり、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたエボラ流行への対応が、ADF等武装勢力による攻撃で妨害されており、隔離患者や濃厚接触者の逃走が報告されている。国際的拡散リスクの明示的記載はないが、過去の同地域での越境伝播歴を踏まえ注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Warung Remang-Remang di Gresik Jadi Sasaran Razia, 2 Orang Positif Penyakit Menular Seksual
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dimly Lit Warung in Gresik Targeted by Raids, Two People Test Positive for Sexually Transmitted Infections
article.articleSummary: Two people in Gresik Regency, Indonesia, tested positive for sexually transmitted infections after raids on dimly lit coffee shops. During Friday night operations across multiple areas—Desa Karang Kiring (Kebomas), Kelurahan Sidorukun (Gresik), Jalan Siti Fatimah Binti Maimun Telaga Ngipik (Duduksampeyan), and Dusun Betiring, Desa Banjarsari (Cerme)—29 others were detained for screening by the District Health Office and BNNK Gresik. Laboratory-confirmed positives: 1 HIV and 1 syphilis. The two individuals will receive treatment and counseling per health procedures. The operation, conducted under Local Regulations on alcohol control and public order, aims to maintain tranquil public conditions in Gresik Regency. No information on infection source or travel-related cases provided.

triage.headline_ja: グレシクの薄暗い飲食店で摘発、2人が性感染症陽性
triage.triage_reason: 地域の風俗店摘発における散発的なHIV・梅毒の個別検査結果であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や国際的拡大リスクはなく、通常の保健行政活動の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 単発の性風俗摘発に伴う個別検査結果の報道であり、アウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinamani Reports 46,500 Chicken Deaths in Cuddalore as Farmers Seek Compensation | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Dinamani reports 46,500 chicken deaths in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district from Oct 30 to Nov 5, prompting nine farm owners to petition for compensation on Nov 6; the district revenue officer will refer the request to the state government. Earlier counts diverge: ~5,600 deaths across six farms (Times of India) and ~26,000 (administration) with farmers estimating 40,000–50,000. The Animal Husbandry Department ordered a three-month ban on bird sales and chick intake in the affected area, potentially extending losses beyond Diwali-related demand. A Namakkal-based Poultry Disease Diagnostic Laboratory ruled out low-pathogenic avian influenza on Nov 2; toxin tests are pending and weather/high humidity are considered possible factors, cause unconfirmed. Farmer Mohan invested ₹40–50 lakh; chicks sold at ₹47–₹48 each and 50-kg feed sacks at ₹2,500–₹2,600. No compensation decision has been announced.

triage.headline_ja: ディナマニ紙、クダロールで鶏46,500羽が死亡と報道、農家が補償を要求
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で大規模な鶏の死亡が報告されているが、低病原性鳥インフルエンザは否定されており原因未確定（毒素検査待ち）。人への感染報告はなく、国際的拡大リスクも低いが、原因不明のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 低病原性鳥インフルエンザは否定されたが、高病原性の検査結果や毒素検査結果が明らかでなく、原因未確定のため続報を要確認。人への感染報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid avançam em diferentes estados do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases rise in different states across Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rise in Brazil, driven by accelerated transmission in 19 states over the past six weeks. Ministry of Health data show increases across all age groups, from children to the elderly. A Fiocruz bulletin released Nov 5 reports early upticks in hospitalizations for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) across multiple regions. Despite the rise, authorities describe the epidemiological scenario as controlled, with the Ministry maintaining a low-risk classification for the disease in all states, and Fiocruz noting severe-case incidence remains at reduced levels. From the start of 2026 through November 4, Brazil logged 118,851 influenza-like illness notifications attributed to COVID-19, though true infection counts are likely higher due to under-diagnosis and under-reporting. São Paulo monitoring data indicate the most frequent symptoms as cough, fever, sore throat, and loss of taste or smell, with attention to other common infection signs.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル各州でCOVID-19感染者が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル19州でCOVID-19感染が増加し重症呼吸器症候群の入院もやや増加しているが、当局は低リスク・管理下と評価しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省・Fiocruzともに既知の季節的COVID-19流行として低リスク評価を維持。続報で重症化率や入院動向の推移を注視する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Shin Tae-yong Ungkap Badai Flu Landa Persija Jelang Lawan Persebaya |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shin Tae-yong Reveals a Flu Outbreak Has Struck Persija Ahead of the Match Against Persebaya
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, a flu outbreak struck Persija Jakarta ahead of their Super League 2026/2027 clash with Persebaya Surabaya at Jakarta International Stadium (JIS). Coach Shin Tae-yong disclosed three to four key players were down with flu, limiting their performance in a 1-0 win over Persebaya. Players named include Radovan Pankov and Victor Dethan; striker Alexander Jeremejeff remained unable to train or play due to flu. Foreign forward Ivan Mamut, not fully fit, played the full match and delivered the decisive 90th-minute goal. Shin Tae-yong himself had recently recovered from flu requiring hospital treatment before the game. STY lamented the poor quality of JIS turf, saying it hindered players’ performance and asked for pitch improvements for upcoming home matches. The report centers on illness and its impact; no laboratory confirmation or transmission details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: シン・タエヨン監督、ペルシジャ対ペルセバヤ戦を前にインフルエンザ流行がチームを直撃と明かす
triage.triage_reason: サッカーチーム内での個別のインフルエンザ罹患に関するスポーツ記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や拡大リスクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はプロサッカークラブ（ペルシジャ・ジャカルタ）の選手数名が季節性インフルエンザに罹患したというスポーツニュースであり、検査確認や感染拡大の情報は一切なく公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Équateur : plus de 700 personnes vaccinées contre le choléra à Mbandaka - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Équateur: More than 700 people vaccinated against cholera in Mbandaka - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Cholera vaccination campaign in Mbandaka, Equateur, DRC: On 7 November 2026, over 700 people were vaccinated at a multi-avenue site in Wangata's Mbandaka 3, the capital's northwestern province. The officially launched oral cholera vaccination campaign began on 6 November 2026 as part of the outbreak response. The site covers Mpaku, Elinga, Ikoko, Bango, Buya, Bokongo and Bwalanga avenues. Vaccination is free and conducted door-to-door, vaccinating all eligible residents except infants under one year or those severely intoxicated; pregnant women are included. For absentees, a follow-up operation will mark households on walls to guide a second pass. Pitchou Poka, a vaccinator, called on residents to participate, noting that cholera is present in the city and commune. The campaign complements hygiene and sanitation measures in Wangata.

triage.headline_ja: エクアトゥール州：ムバンダカで700人以上がコレラワクチン接種を受ける - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ムバンダカで進行中のコレラアウトブレイクに対するワクチン接種キャンペーンの報告であり、既知の対応活動のため新規シグナルとしての緊急性は低いが、アウトブレイクの継続状況として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域に『Republic of Ecuador』が含まれるが、これはDRC国内の『Équateur州（Equatorプロヴィンス）』の地名誤認と判断し除外した。記事はDRC・ムバンダカ市での既存コレラアウトブレイクへのワクチン接種対応を報じるもの。
