article.articleHeadline: WHO approves trials for two new Ebola vaccines
article.articleSummary: WHO approves clinical trials for two Ebola vaccines tailored to Bundibugyo (BDBV) strain in the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, which has killed more than 5,300 people. Trials led by the DRC's National Institute for Biomedical Research and sponsored by WHO and partners will test ChAdOx1 BDBV (Oxford University with Serum Institute of India) and Moderna's mRNA-1469. Until now no Bundibugyo-specific vaccine; the only trial last month used Ervebo for the Zaire strain. Results are expected in early 2027. Africa CDC reports 10,444 confirmed Bundibugyo cases, mostly in DRC; Kenya has 9 cases including 2 deaths, Nigeria 1 case. Amid this, a British healthcare worker infected with Ebola is being evacuated from the DRC to the United Kingdom for specialist treatment.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、新規エボラワクチン2種の臨床試験を承認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行は5,300人超の死者を出し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大や英国人医療従事者の国外搬送も発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案。
triage.notes: インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）としての言及であり、発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ケニア・ナイジェリア・英国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bijnor reports 4,500 Hepatitis C cases, twice last year's count
article.articleSummary: Bijnor district in Uttar Pradesh reports over 4,500 Hepatitis C cases this year, more than double the nearly 2,000 tallied in 2025. About 55,000 samples have been tested to date, with nearly 16 patients presenting daily at three government treatment centers, mainly from rural areas. Health officials say increased testing and ongoing awareness programs partly explain the rise. Hepatitis C is a viral liver infection spread via infected blood, including unsafe blood transfusions, poorly sterilised surgical equipment, reuse of syringes by unqualified practitioners, and unprotected sex. Of the patients registered this year, roughly 4,000 have completed treatment while about 500 remain in care. Treatment centers are located at the government medical college, Nehtaur, and Dhampur, offering free tests and medicines to affected residents.

triage.headline_ja: ビジュノール県でC型肝炎感染者4,500人を報告、昨年の2倍に
triage.triage_reason: C型肝炎（血液媒介の慢性疾患）の報告数増加は、検査拡大と啓発活動によるものと説明されており、急性アウトブレイクや国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 報告数増加は検査体制強化と啓発活動の成果とされ、既に地元政府の医療機関（無料検査・治療）で対応済み。急性感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、慢性疾患のサーベイランス結果報告。

article.articleHeadline: EUA superam 5 mil casos de sarampo em 2026 e registram pior surto em 35 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States surpasses 5,000 measles cases in 2026 and records the worst outbreak in 35 years.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in the United States reached 5,182 in 2026, the highest annual total since 1991. Pennsylvania leads with 1,487 confirmed cases and 287 hospitalizations through Friday, November 6. The outbreak has resulted in at least four official deaths, with state tallies suggesting eight or more linked to infection, including a Wisconsin baby (Nov 5) and New York’s first measles death in over three decades. Public health experts attribute the surge to declining vaccination coverage and anti-vaccine sentiment; about 96% of those infected were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Age distribution shows 20+ years (2,132), 5–19 (2,104), and under-5 (908). PAHO will meet next week to assess whether the U.S. loses its measles-free status. Measles is airborne; prevention relies on two-dose MMR vaccination. In Brazil, 65 cases (São Paulo 41, Amazonas 21; Acre 2; Rio de Janeiro 1) are reported, all imported.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、2026年の麻疹症例が5000人を超え、35年間で最悪の流行を記録
triage.triage_reason: 米国で35年ぶりの大規模な麻疹流行が発生し、複数の死亡例・入院例が報告されているほか、ブラジルへの輸入例も確認されており、地域全体への感染拡大リスクとPAHOによる麻疹排除ステータス見直しの検討など国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 主な発生地は米国（対象国リスト外）だが、ブラジルでも65例（全て輸入例）が確認されており、対象国として記載。PAHOが米国の麻疹排除ステータス見直しを検討中であり、地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO collaborating center inaugurated in south China to aid global sexually transmitted infection control
article.articleSummary: WHO collaborating Center for STI Prevention and Innovations inaugurated in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, to aid global sexually transmitted infection control. Hosted by the Dermatology Hospital of Southern Medical University and SMU Institute for Global Health, the center will advance capacity building for venereal disease prevention in low- and middle-income countries. Led by Yang Bin, it will pursue standardized training, targeting the creation by 2030 of 100 senior STI professionals across 15 LMICs, prioritizing Africa and Southeast Asia. It will develop simple, standardized data collection tools for STI surveillance, pilot verification in African countries, and build an operational data integration and sharing platform aligned with international systems. Hannah Monica Dias of WHO emphasized guidelines development, evidence generation, and global public health governance support. China-WHO cooperation highlights include 2025 medical personnel deployments and malaria control support in Africa/SE Asia, and pilots of integrated health delivery; Cambodia/Laos schistosomiasis elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 中国南部でWHO協力センター設立、世界の性感染症対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: これはWHO協力センターの設立に関する行政・組織的なニュースであり、具体的な感染症のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はSTI対策のための国際協力センター開設に関する内容で、具体的な疾患発生事例の報告ではない。マラリアや住血吸虫症への言及はあるが、既存の対策活動の紹介に留まり新規アウトブレイク情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Il incarnait la gentillesse" : Mathis, 23 ans, rugbyman en année de césure au Viêtnam, meurt de la dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "He embodied kindness": Mathis, 23, a rugby player on a gap year in Vietnam, dies of dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old Mathis Blondeau, on a gap year in Southeast Asia (Indonesia, Bali, Vietnam), died in Vietnam from dengue fever, a single fatality. Rugby Club Quimpérois (RC Quimpérois) paid tribute, noting his generosity and the joy of life; he progressed from the club's youth sections to the senior team and studied at INSEEC, with plans to begin Master 2 upon return. A minute of silence was held on Sunday in the presence of his family. Dengue is a mosquito-borne infection circulating in tropical and subtropical regions, causing high fever, headaches, vomiting, and bleeding, and can be fatal. The article situates his death as a consequence of dengue acquired during travel in Southeast Asia.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼は優しさの象徴だった」:ベトナムでギャップイヤーを過ごしていたラグビー選手マティス（23歳）がデング熱で死去
triage.triage_reason: 個人旅行者1名のデング熱死亡事例であり、公衆衛生上の異常な拡大や新たな脅威を示す情報はなく、既知の流行地域での個別症例に過ぎない。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス人青年の個人的な死亡事例を報じるもので、デング熱の地域的流行状況やアウトブレイクに関する新規情報は含まれていない。バリ(インドネシア)は旅行経路として言及されているが、感染・死亡はベトナムで発生したため主たる該当国はベトナムのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo passa de 5.000 casos nos EUA e tem mortes em 2 estados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles surpasses 5,000 cases in the U.S., with deaths in two states.
article.articleSummary: Measles in the United States reaches 5,182 cases in 2026, the highest total in 35 years, per the CDC. Pennsylvania leads with 1,487 cases and 287 hospitalizations; South Carolina and Utah also report high totals. Wisconsin confirmed a baby's death on Nov 5; New York reported its first measles death in more than 30 years earlier this week. The CDC lists four deaths nationwide, while state authorities report at least eight. About 96% of cases occur in unvaccinated individuals or those with unknown vaccination status, underscoring outbreak links to declining vaccination coverage amid anti-vaccine movements. Age distribution: 20+ years 2,132; 5–19 years 2,104; under 5 years 908. PAHO will assess after the week of Nov 7 whether the U.S. still meets criteria to maintain measles elimination. In Brazil, 65 cases in 2026: São Paulo 41; Amazonas 21; Acre 2; Rio de Janeiro 1; imported or linked to imported infections.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で麻疹が5,000例を超え、2州で死亡例が発生
triage.triage_reason: 過去35年で最多規模の麻疹流行であり、複数州での死亡・入院例、ブラジルへの輸入関連症例の広がりが確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国の麻疹流行（対象国リスト外）だが、ブラジルでも輸入関連症例65例が報告されており、ブラジルのみを検証済み発生地域として記載した。PAHOによる米国の麻疹排除status再評価も言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes largest in country's history - WHO
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak—the largest in the country’s history—driven by Bundibugyo virus, with 10,668 confirmed cases, 5,198 deaths and 2,881 recoveries as of 3 November 2026. The epidemic spans 67 health zones in eight provinces, with active transmission in 51 zones; Ituri (7,485/3,532) and North Kivu (2,593/1,422) bear the bulk of cases and deaths. In the 21 days to 3 November, 1,463 new confirmed cases were recorded, including 964 since 23 October (511 deaths). Five countries have reported Bundibugyo virus disease: DRC, France, Kenya, Nigeria, and Uganda; France and Uganda outbreaks controlled since August; Kenya and Nigeria still responding, with no new cases in those countries since 23 October. Nigeria reports one imported laboratory-confirmed case in Abuja on 20 October, evacuated to Switzerland; 62 contacts identified, six completed 21-day follow-up. No vaccines or specific treatments exist; control relies on early detection, isolation, contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、同国史上最大規模に - WHO
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最大のエボラ流行（確定10,668例、死亡5,198例）で、ブンディブギョウイルスが複数国（フランス、ケニア、ナイジェリア、ウガンダ）に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（輸入症例1例、アブジャ）、ケニア、ウガンダ、フランス、スイスでも関連症例が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに非該当（ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていない）。主たる流行地はDRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор направил запросы по сообщениям о заболевании российских туристов в Нячанге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor sent inquiries regarding reports of illness among Russian tourists in Nha Trang.
article.articleSummary: Influenza reports among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam prompted Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor to query Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) for official information on the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and traveler communications. Tourists reportedly experienced runny nose, severe cough, high fever, and intense headache. Rospotrebnadzor advises standard flu precautions: regular handwashing, avoiding close contact with those who are ill, minimizing time in crowds, and practicing respiratory etiquette. Individuals with high fever, body aches, cough, runny nose, or sore throat should seek medical care; if symptoms arise during travel or after returning, inform the physician of recent travel. The agency states the situation is under control. The inquiry underscores concerns about imported infections affecting Russian travelers to Vietnam and the need for timely public health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア消費者権利保護・福祉監督庁、ニャチャンでのロシア人観光客の疾病報告について問い合わせを実施
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様症状が報告され当局が照会したが、現時点で季節性インフルエンザの範囲内か異常事態かは不明であり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人観光客の帰国後対応に焦点があり、ベトナム国内での感染拡大状況の詳細（症例数、病原体の特定、重症度など）は記載されていない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil refuerza vacunación contra sarampión en triple frontera
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil strengthens measles vaccination at the tri-border area.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination drive launched in four Brazilian Amazon border municipalities — Tabatinga, Benjamin Constant, Sao Paulo de Olivenca, and Atalaia do Norte — near Peru and Colombia to counter rising measles cases in the Americas. Coordinated by Brazil’s Health Ministry with local governments, vaccination sites span ports, riverine communities, Indigenous territories, markets, schools, and workplaces, plus home visits, aided by Indigenous Special Health Districts Alto Rio Solimoes and Valle do Javari and Indigenous Health Houses to reach hard‑to‑access populations. From six months of age, all individuals are eligible; six‑ to 11‑month‑olds receive a zero‑dose (not substituting the routine schedule), and from one year onward the standard age schedule applies. Brazil also provided Peru with 500,000 doses of MMR vaccine, shipments planned soon. In 2026 Peru reports >2,000 measles cases; Colombia 17; Brazil 65 imported cases (21 in Amazonas). Endemic transmission hasn’t recurred since 2024; active case finding, surveillance, and a vaccination blockade in prioritized zones remain. Amazonas 2025: first dose 89.7%, second dose 76% (national 93.15%/78.61%).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、三国国境地帯で麻疹ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ペルーで2000例超、コロンビア17例、ブラジル65例（輸入例）の麻疹が国境を越えて拡大しており、ブラジルがペルーへワクチン提供するなど国際的対応が行われているためフルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ブラジルは輸入症例（65例、うちアマゾナス州21例）として国内で対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Rabies, Tubaba Gelar Vaksinasi Massal: 350 Dosis untuk Hewan Peliharaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Rabies, Tubaba Holds Mass Vaccination: 350 Doses for Pets.
article.articleSummary: Rabies Mass Vaccination held in Tulangbawang Barat (Tubaba) Regency, Lampung Province, at Puskeswan Pulung Kencana, Tulangbawang Tengah, on 16 September 2026. The campaign offered 350 vaccine doses (100 from the Lampung Province Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Health and 250 from Tubaba) to vaccinate pets. Officials aim to expand coverage from three to six districts. Rabies is described as deadly; without rapid treatment after a bite, it can be fatal, making vaccination the primary preventive measure. Vaccination is free while supplies last; due to limited doses relative to the pet population, residents are urged to vaccinate at Puskeswan, provincial or district services, or private veterinarians. The activity aligns with Lampung Province’s 2026 Animal Husbandry Month and Rabies Month (Aug 27–Sep 27, 2026) and was attended by provincial and Tubaba health leadership.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病予防のため、トゥババ地区がペットへの大規模ワクチン接種（350回分）を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの報道であり、異常な発生や症例急増の情報はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は狂犬病月間に合わせた通常の予防的ワクチン接種活動の報道であり、具体的な感染事例や死亡例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, i ribelli legati all'Isis bruciano un centro Ebola: 33 morti e 180 pazienti in fuga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, ISIS-linked rebels burn an Ebola treatment center: 33 dead and 180 patients have fled.
article.articleSummary: ISIS-linked rebels attacked Cantine in North Kivu, Congo, burning the local health center and homes; at least 33 civilians killed and 180 patients fled, including one confirmed Ebola case, prompting suspension of contact tracing. Cantine lies about 50 km from Beni. The Ebola outbreak—the worst in Congo—has surpassed 10,600 confirmed cases and about 5,200 deaths since May, with Bundibugyo as the circulating strain; North Kivu now accounts for roughly half of new infections across 67 health zones in eight provinces. Of 512 deaths recorded since Oct 21, 335 occurred in communities outside treatment centers. UN OCHA warns response operations have paused and calls for civilian protection and aid access. Internationally, a British doctor working with the response was evacuated to London; the UK reports a first imported Ebola case and Europe a third imported case. Congo’s North Kivu hosts multiple armed groups, including ADF allied to IS.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ISIS系武装勢力がエボラ治療センターを放火：33人死亡、180人の患者が逃走
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（1万人超感染・5千人超死亡）が武装勢力の攻撃で対応中断、さらに英国・欧州への輸入例が報告されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的拡大が確認される。
triage.notes: 英国・欧州での輸入症例は発生地域として記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。武装勢力による攻撃で接触者追跡が中断されており、感染拡大リスクが高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Penyebaran Virus Influenza A di Bali, Wamenkes Temukan 9 Kasus Positif: Wajib Pakai Masker
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant about the spread of Influenza A virus in Bali; Deputy Health Minister finds 9 positive cases: Mask-wearing is mandatory.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Bali reports 9 laboratory-confirmed Influenza A cases among 113 total influenza cases on the island, signaling ongoing spread amid the seasonal transition to the rainy period. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus warns of rising transmission ahead of Christmas 2026 and New Year 2027 (Nataru). Mask-wearing is mandatory, and individuals with flu symptoms should rest at home to prevent further spread. Influenza is described as a virus that frequently changes its form, which can erode immunity from prior seasons. Transmission risk increases during seasonal changes and wet periods. There is no antiviral cure for influenza, so maintaining good physical condition and immune health is emphasized. The public health message centers on mandatory masks and precautions during Bali’s current influenza activity.

triage.headline_ja: バリ島でインフルエンザA型ウイルスの拡散に警戒、保健副大臣が陽性9例を確認：マスク着用義務化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常範囲内の流行であり国際的拡大や重症化の報告はないが、年末年始に向けた感染拡大への注意喚起があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行報告であり、重症度や死亡者数に関する情報は記事に含まれていない。年末年始の人の移動増加に伴う感染拡大への注意喚起が主目的。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela and Brazil agree on a binational plan against endemic disease
article.articleSummary: Venezuela and Brazil advance binational plan against onchocerciasis (river blindness) in the Amazon border region. At the Inter-American meeting in Manaus (Nov 3–6), Venezuelan delegates from the Simón Bolívar Amazonian Center for Research and Control of Tropical Diseases, attached to the Ministry of Health, joined the Coordinating Committee of the Program and the Inter-American Conference on Onchocerciasis to coordinate border interventions aimed at eradicating the disease. For over 30 years, the center has led Venezuela’s National Program for the Elimination of Onchocerciasis in the Southern Focus, conducting research, diagnosis, and epidemiological containment in local communities. The central goal is binational coordination across administrative boundaries to address a shared transmission hotspot in the Amazon. Onchocerciasis is transmitted by black flies breeding in rivers and causes eye and skin disease.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラとブラジル、風土病対策で二国間計画に合意
triage.triage_reason: オンコセルカ症の既存の排除プログラムに関する二国間協力の発表であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。本記事は長年続く既存の排除プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela y Brasil acuerdan plan binacional contra enfermedad endémica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela and Brazil agree on a bilateral plan to combat an endemic disease.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela and Brazil advance a bilateral plan against Onchocerciasis (river blindness) in the Amazon frontier. A Venezuelan delegation participated in November 3–6, 2026, in Manaus, Brazil, at the Coordinating Committee of the Program and Inter-American Conference on Onchocerciasis, to coordinate border-area interventions and push toward eradication. Delegates hail from the Amazonian Center for Research and Control of Tropical Diseases 'Simón Bolívar', under Venezuela’s Ministry of Health, which has led the National Program for the Elimination of Onchocerciasis of the Southern Focus for over 30 years through research, diagnosis, and epidemiological containment. The meeting's core objective is binational alignment to address the shared transmission focus across the Amazon, transcending administrative borders. Onchocerciasis is transmitted by repeated bites of blackflies (Simulium) in riverine environments, affecting eyes and skin and known as river blindness.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラとブラジル、風土病対策で二国間計画に合意
triage.triage_reason: 長年の既知の風土病（オンコセルカ症）に対する既存の排除プログラムの会議・協力に関する報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態は見られない。
triage.notes: ベネズエラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既存の排除プログラムに関する二国間会議の報告であり、新規発生や急性のリスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: Загадочный вирус из Нячанга: россияне массово жалуются на симптомы гриппа после отпуска
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious virus from Nha Trang: Russians report widespread flu-like symptoms after vacation.
article.articleSummary: Russian tourists returning from Nha Trang, Vietnam, report flu-like symptoms. Rospotrebnadzor has requested epidemiological information from the Association of Tour Operators of Russia on the situation, preventive measures, and traveler communications. Reported symptoms include runny nose, severe cough, high fever, and headache. Authorities stress routine hygiene, avoiding close contact with the sick, and, if possible, avoiding crowded places. The agency says the situation is under control. Medical guidance: seek care for high fever, body pains, cough, runny nose, or sore throat; if symptoms arise during travel or after returning, inform the doctor about recent travel. No specific virus has been confirmed in the report, and no case counts or imported/exported case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 謎のウイルス、ニャチャンから:ロシア人が休暇後にインフルエンザ様症状を大量に訴える
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンから帰国したロシア人旅行者にインフルエンザ様症状が多発しているが、病原体は未特定で症例数や重症度の詳細も不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ロシア当局(Rospotrebnadzor)が旅行会社に疫学情報を要請している段階で、病原体特定や症例数などの詳細情報が不足している。ベトナム・ニャチャンが発生地と推定されるが、ロシア側での集団発生の可能性もあり、続報待ちが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил у Вьетнама информацию о "неизвестном вирусе" у россиян // Новости НТВ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested information from Vietnam about an 'unknown virus' among Russians // NTV News
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Rospotrebnadzor is examining reports of an unknown illness among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam. Media accounts describe high fever, severe cough, headache and other flu-like symptoms, with clinicians reportedly prescribing antivirals and antibiotics rather than a clear diagnosis. A formal inquiry has been issued to Vietnam’s Ministry of Health to determine whether a distinct pathogen or outbreak exists. The Russian Union of Tour Operators says there are no indications of mass illness among travelers, and notes that influenza activity in Vietnam remains within seasonal levels. No confirmed cases, laboratory confirmation, or specific infection source are reported. Officials emphasize ongoing monitoring of travel-associated health concerns pending official confirmation from Vietnamese authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、ベトナムに'未知のウイルス'に関するロシア人感染情報を要請 // NTVニュース
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明の疾患（インフルエンザ様症状）が報告され、ロシア当局がベトナム保健省に正式照会を行ったが、確定診断・検査結果・集団発生の証拠はなく情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ロシアのツアー業界団体は集団発生の兆候なしとし、ベトナムのインフルエンザ活動は季節的範囲内と説明。検査確定例や感染源の特定情報はなく、続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis E found in a third of suspected yellow fever cases in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis E virus (HEV) seroprevalence is substantial among patients suspected of yellow fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). A nationwide retrospective cross-sectional study of 2,007 serum samples from suspected yellow fever cases (2019–2021) found HEV total antibodies in 30.8% (95% CI 28.8–32.8). IgM positivity occurred in 3.6% (n=72); among IgM-positive samples, viral RNA was detected in one (1.4%). Multivariable analysis linked male sex with higher HEV seropositivity (aOR 1.2; 95% CI 1.0–1.5; p=0.028) but lower IgM positivity (aOR 0.6; 95% CI 0.4–1.1; p=0.088). Age 20–29 years showed increased seropositivity (aOR 1.3; 95% CI 1.0–1.8; p=0.046). The study indicates HEV circulation among suspected febrile jaundice patients tested under yellow fever surveillance; less than 5% tested positive for yellow fever, suggesting dual-use screening for other causes. Limitations include retrospective design and population limited to febrile jaundice cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における黄熱疑い症例の3分の1でE型肝炎が検出
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2019〜2021年の過去データに基づく血清疫学研究の報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生事象を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は後ろ向き横断研究の結果報告であり、黄熱疑い例の中でのHEV血清陽性率について述べているが、活動的な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急対応を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Terra Yanomami não registra óbitos por malária no primeiro semestre de 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yanomami Territory records no malaria deaths in the first half of 2026
article.articleSummary: Malaria deaths in the Yanomami Indigenous Territory (spanning Roraima and Amazonas, Brazil) were zero in the first half of 2026, while malaria cases fell 50.8% to 6,891 from 14,018 in H1 2023. Diagnostic/testing capacity expanded to 145,715 exams (+85%), aided by expanded testing, active case finding, timely treatment, tafenoquine, and pediatric single-dose vivax therapy. Across all causes, total deaths declined 27.2% to 158 in H1 2026, and malnutrition deaths dropped 73.5% versus H1 2023. IRAs deaths decreased 40.8% despite attendances rising to 14,491 from 3,100; CFR dropped from 1.58% to 0.20%. Vaccination reached 34,817 doses; under-1 complete schedules rose to 56.2%, and under-5 to 78.4%. Child nutrition monitoring reached 85.1%; severe underweight fell to 17.4%. Health capacity expanded to 2,107 workers; Surucucu Center (Sept 2025) conducted 6,128 ambulatory visits and 2,536 lab tests by mid-2026, with 82.9% of regional transfers directed there.

triage.headline_ja: ヤノマミ領域、2026年上半期のマラリア死亡者ゼロを記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例・死亡数とも改善を示す肯定的な内容であり、公衆衛生上の異常な脅威や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア対策の成功事例を報告する内容であり、新規の公衆衛生リスクやアウトブレイクを示すものではないため対象国リストへの計上は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: pelo menos 5 estados registram aumento de casos graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: At least five states report an increase in severe cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Brazil reports a rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, including severe COVID-19 infections, according to Fiocruz via the InfoGripe bulletin. At least five states show increasing SRAG–COVID-19 activity: Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina, though incidence remains very low in the four later states. Roraima, Sergipe and Santa Catarina are at alert/risk/high-risk levels for SRAG without a clear long-term upward trend. Aracaju and João Pessoa, capitals, report SRAG activity at alert/risk with growth. Over the four most recent weeks, SRAG positives are: rhinovirus 50.1%, COVID-19 8.5%, RSV 10.1%, influenza A 4.2%, influenza B 4.7%; deaths among positives: rhinovirus 43%, COVID-19 24.1%, influenza B 12.7%, RSV 3.8%, influenza A 1.3%. In 2026, 171,369 SRAG cases; 91,420 (53.3%) lab-positive for some respiratory virus; 62,823 (36.7%) lab-negative; 7,457 (4.4%) awaiting results. Incidence is higher in children ≤2 years; mortality higher in adults ≥65 years.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19:少なくとも5州で重症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で複数州にわたりSARIおよびCOVID-19等の呼吸器感染症の増加が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の要素は確認されず、既存サーベイランス体制内の季節的動向とみられる。
triage.notes: FiocruzのInfoGripe速報による国内サーベイランスデータであり、複数の呼吸器病原体（ライノウイルス、COVID-19、RSV、インフルエンザA/B）が混在。COVID-19単独での異常性は確認されず、季節性呼吸器感染症の通常の監視報告と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : au moins 180 patients dont des cas suspects Ebola en fuite après une attaque ADF à Cantine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: at least 180 patients, including suspected Ebola cases, on the run after an ADF attack in Cantine
article.articleSummary: In Cantine, Beni, at least 180 patients hospitalized at Kelekele Hospital Center fled during an attack attributed to ADF fighters in the night of November 6–7, 2026. Medical director Kakule Vulembera Christian reports that among the escapees were several cases suspected of Ebola Virus Disease. The departure followed multiple gunshots, with some patients abandoning the facility before settling medical bills. The mass escape jeopardizes ongoing care for the sick and complicates monitoring and containment of suspected Ebola cases. The incident highlights security risks in the Beni area and the potential public health consequences if suspected Ebola patients are not promptly traced and managed.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：ADFによるカンティーヌ襲撃後、エボラ疑い例を含む少なくとも180人の患者が逃走
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニでADF武装勢力による襲撃後、エボラ疑い患者を含む180人以上が医療施設から逃走し、追跡・封じ込めが困難になっているため、公衆衛生上重大かつ異常な事態としてフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ確定例ではなく疑い例である点に留意。治安悪化により患者追跡が困難であり、感染拡大・封じ込め失敗のリスクが高い。続報で確定例の有無と追跡状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперт Капустина: Причиной болезни россиян во Вьетнаме может быть легионеллез
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Expert Kapustina: Legionellosis may be the cause of Russians' illness in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Russians vacationing in Nha Trang, Vietnam, report fever, cough, and marked weakness; symptoms resemble influenza. While circulating pathogens include influenza A/B, dengue fever, rhinoviruses, adenoviruses, and respiratory syncytial virus, Legionellosis cannot be ruled out, linked to poorly maintained air-conditioning systems. Expert Kapustina recommends early diagnostics: complete blood count to assess inflammation; PCR for influenza and respiratory viruses; serology for dengue and chikungunya; urine antigen for Legionella if suspected. In the early days of illness, tests have the highest diagnostic yield. Prevention emphasizes repellents, sleeping under mosquito nets, and avoiding prolonged exposure in poorly ventilated rooms with constantly running air conditioning; also request hotel information on AC system cleaning. Seek medical care at first signs of illness rather than self-treatment. Rospotrebnadzor has requested Vietnam’s Ministry of Health provide epidemiological data on Russian patients and measures for tourists.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家カプースチナ氏:ベトナムでのロシア人の病気の原因はレジオネラ症の可能性
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客に原因不明の発熱・呼吸器症状の集団発生が報告され、レジオネラ症の可能性が指摘されロシア当局がベトナム保健省に公式照会している。病原体未確定で情報不足だが、社会的・行政的関心が高くWPRO基準にも複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ロシアはイベント発生国ではなく患者の出身国であるため対象国リストに含まれない。原因病原体（レジオネラ、インフルエンザ、デング等）は未確定で、集団発生の規模・重症度も不明。Rospotrebnadzorがベトナム保健省に疫学データ提供を要請しており、続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: One in 12 HIV patients in Andhra Pradesh develop tuberculosis again within two years of treatment: Study
article.articleSummary: Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh—A study of 3,357 people living with HIV who completed TB treatment (2017–2021) across East Godavari, Krishna and Guntur found 270 (8%) developed recurrent TB within two years, and 510 (15.2%) died by Dec 31, 2023. Median times: seven months to recurrent TB and eight months to death; 43.7% of recurrences occurred within six months, 67% within 12 months. Unsuppressed HIV viral load (≥1,000 copies/ml) increased adjusted hazards: 3.36 for recurrent TB and 3.71 for death. Not on dolutegravir-based ART yielded 2.62-fold higher hazard of recurrent TB and 2.77-fold higher hazard of death. TB preventive therapy uptake was limited: 43% started within nine months, 35.7% did not receive it. National guidelines call for follow-up at six, 12, 18 and 24 months post-treatment. Findings published in Open Forum Infectious Diseases; limitations include district scope and inability to distinguish relapse vs reinfection.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラ・プラデーシュ州のHIV患者の12人に1人が、治療後2年以内に結核を再発
triage.triage_reason: 過去コホート研究の結果報告であり、急性の公衆衛生リスクや新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、トリアージ対象としない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2017-2021年のコホートデータに基づく学術研究の報告であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kebabnīcā strādājošajam tuberkulozes pacientam identificētas 13 kontaktpersonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thirteen contacts identified for the tuberculosis patient working at a kebab shop.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis diagnosed in a kebab-shop worker in Latvia triggers contact tracing: 13 contacts identified who spent at least 40 hours with the patient in the past month. Eight study peers and five coworkers/neighbors are under two-year monitoring. The young man was found on the street in serious condition and is hospitalized in Stopiņi and at the Tuberculosis and Lung Diseases Center in Riga. Authorities will follow up with contacts; if symptoms appear, treatment will be provided promptly. The patient has lived in Riga since spring last year; whether the infection was imported remains difficult to determine within a two-year window. Latvia reports 219 TB cases this year, 16 among foreigners; Ukrainians (30), Indians (9), Vietnamese (6) are the largest foreign groups, with others from Lithuania, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Pakistan. TB is airborne; cooking cannot spread it. The Food and Veterinary Service will perform planned kebab-shop inspections twice yearly; no unscheduled checks.

triage.headline_ja: ケバブ店勤務の結核患者、接触者13人を特定
triage.triage_reason: ラトビアにおける個別の結核症例と通常の接触者追跡事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。対象国での発生でもない。
triage.notes: 発生国はラトビアであり対象国リストに含まれない。記事中にインド・ベトナム等の国名が言及されているが、これは外国人結核患者の出身国統計であり、当該国での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pooled Indian data show pneumococcal serotypes and resistance patterns
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype distribution and antimicrobial resistance in India were assessed through a meta-analysis of 26 studies (2007–2024; 4,253 isolates), largely reflecting the pre‑UIP era. Data were stratified into invasive pneumococcal disease (IPD), carriage, and CAP. Pediatric IPD most frequent serotypes: 14 (14.15%), 19F (11.39%), 6B (10.17%); exploratory single‑study data suggested higher estimates for serogroups 6 (25%), 18 (12.5%), 19 (10%). In adult IPD, serotype 1 (11.69%), 23F (6.84%), 19F (6.71%); adult CAP serotypes: 19A (14%), 8 (10%). Cotrimoxazole resistance was highest across contexts: pediatric IPD 86.16%, adult IPD 85.24%, adult CAP 74%. Penicillin non‑susceptibility in pediatric IPD estimated at 14.33% (CI 5.22–33.72) with high heterogeneity (I2 97.15%). PCV20 had the highest serotype coverage; PCV13 remains highly protective though non‑vaccine serotypes are rising. Limitations include pre‑UIP dominance, reliance on small single studies, and substantial heterogeneity, underscoring the need for broad, ongoing surveillance to guide vaccination policy in India.

triage.headline_ja: インドの統合データが肺炎球菌血清型と薬剤耐性パターンを示す
triage.triage_reason: メタ分析による疫学的レビュー記事であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントではないため、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去の研究データを統合したメタ分析であり、新規の感染症発生イベントではないため、対象国としての発生地域確認は不要と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 registra aumento de casos graves em cinco estados brasileiros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 reports an increase in severe cases in five Brazilian states.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 shows an uptick in severe cases across five Brazilian states: Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina, with September–October SRAG indicators rising in connection with COVID-19 and other respiratory infections. Fiocruz surveillance notes that, despite the uptick, overall incidence remains relatively low compared with prior peak periods. Vigilance extends to other regions with alert or risk classifications, including Roraima and Sergipe, while capitals Aracaju and João Pessoa register warning signals due to high SRAG demand and longer-term growth. Laboratory data describe the viral mix among hospitalized SRAG patients: rhinovirus leads positive tests, followed by RSV, influenza, and COVID-19. Mortality from severe disease is more frequently associated with older adults, while hospitalizations concentrate in early childhood. Public health monitoring emphasizes seasonal fluctuations and virus behavior across Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19、ブラジルの5州で重症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）指標の上昇が報告されているが、Fiocruzの監視では全体の発生率は過去のピーク期と比べて依然低く、季節的変動の範囲内とみられるため緊急性は低いが経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器病原体（ライノウイルス、RSV、インフルエンザ、COVID-19）が混在して検出されており、単一疾患の異常発生ではなく季節性呼吸器感染症の通常の変動パターンと考えられる。Fiocruzによる国内サーベイランス体制が機能しており、現時点で外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Pelo menos 5 Estados registram aumento de casos graves de covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 5 states report an increase in severe COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe reports a rise in severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases in Brazil during September–October 2026, including COVID-19–related SRAG. Signs of increased severe COVID-19 SRAG were found in at least five states: Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina; however, SRAG incidence from COVID-19 remains very low in the latter four. Three states—Roraima, Sergipe, and Santa Catarina—show SRAG incidence at alert, risk, or high risk but no long-term upward trend. Two capitals, Aracaju and João Pessoa, have SRAG activity at alert/risk/high risk with a rising long-term trend. For the last four weeks of SRAG positives, etiologies were 4.2% influenza A, 4.7% influenza B, 10.1% RSV, 50.1% rhinovirus, and 8.5% COVID-19; deaths among positives were 1.3% influenza A, 12.7% influenza B, 3.8% RSV, 43% rhinovirus, and 24.1% COVID-19. Through 2026, 171,369 SRAG cases, 91,420 (53.3%) lab-confirmed, 62,823 negative, 7,457 awaiting. Eight-week trends show higher impact at age extremes: incidence higher in children ≤2 years; mortality higher in those ≥65 years.

triage.headline_ja: 少なくとも5州で新型コロナウイルスの重症例増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の増加が報告されているが、COVID関連の発生率は依然低く、長期的な上昇傾向も限定的であり、現時点では通常の季節性呼吸器疾患サーベイランスの範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: FiocruzのInfoGripeによる定例サーベイランス報告であり、複数の呼吸器病原体（COVID-19、インフルエンザA/B、RSV、ライノウイルス）の状況をまとめたもの。一部州・都市でSRAG活動が警戒/リスクレベルにあるが、全体として急性の公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Masacre de grupo ligado a ISIS deja 33 muertos; pacientes con ébola huye de hospital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Massacre by an ISIS-linked group leaves 33 dead; Ebola patients flee from the hospital.
article.articleSummary: 33 people were killed in Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, DR Congo, on the night of November 5 by suspected ISIS-linked Allied Democratic Forces (ADF). The attackers burned more than 50 homes and looted property, causing around 180 patients to flee Kelekele Hospital, including at least one confirmed Ebola patient and five suspected cases, raising concerns about further transmission amid ongoing containment efforts. The World Health Organization reports an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths as of November 3. Cantine-Aloya lies roughly 50 km west of Beni. The violence compounds a broader security crisis in eastern DR Congo, with ISIS-linked ADF and the Rwanda-backed M23 rebel movements affecting access to care and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: ISIS関連組織による虐殺で33人死亡；エボラ患者が病院から逃走
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクが継続中（確定10,668例、死亡5,198例）であり、武装勢力の襲撃により患者約180人が病院から逃走、うち確定・疑い例が複数含まれるため感染拡大リスクが極めて高い。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: ルワンダはM23反乱軍への支援国として言及されているのみで、ルワンダ国内でのエボラ発生は記載されていないため verified_locations から除外した。武装勢力の攻撃により感染拡大防止策（接触者追跡・隔離）が困難化している点が重大な懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: "Микробы из кондиционера". Россияне пожаловались на неизвестный вирус во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germs from the Air Conditioner
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam report infection with an unknown virus presenting influenza-like illness (fever, runny nose) after arrival. Doctors have not issued a specific diagnosis, prescribing antivirals and antibiotics. Roskomnadzor has requested official information from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) to clarify the epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and traveler communications. ATOR told TASS that no reports of an 'unknown virus' have been received; in partner clinics travelers are diagnosed with tonsillitis, bronchitis, laryngotracheobronchitis, pneumonia, and other common conditions, with no confirmed unknown-virus cases. A 39-year-old Moscow resident reports a three-week cough with inconclusive CT. Tourists speculate microbes from air conditioning; experts doubt a new virus. Some suggest water exposure or local pathogens. Officials reiterate flu-prevention measures and advise seeking medical care for fever, body aches, cough, or sore throat, and reporting travel history if symptoms appear after returning home.

triage.headline_ja: 「エアコンからの細菌」ロシア人観光客がベトナムで未知のウイルスに感染と訴え
triage.triage_reason: 未診断のインフルエンザ様症状の報告だが、専門家や旅行代理店は既知の一般的疾患（扁桃炎、気管支炎等）と説明しており、新規病原体や異常事態を示す根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: ロシア当局（Roskomnadzor）がベトナム保健省に照会したが、旅行業界団体は未知ウイルスの報告なしと否定。既知の呼吸器疾患との診断が優勢であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Misteriozni virus u Hrvatskoj ubija dobermane, oči postaju plave i ugibaju u mukama...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious virus in Croatia kills Dobermans, their eyes turn blue and they die in agony....
article.articleSummary: RFAV (raccoon dog amdoparvovirus), a parvovirus-related infection first identified in wild animals on fur farms in China, has been detected in domestic dogs across Europe, including Croatia, Slovenia, and Bulgaria, with Serbia reporting initial Doberman cases at a facility near Novi Sad. In Croatia, a four-year-old female Doberman Pinscher admitted July 22 to the Zagreb Veterinary Faculty with severe emaciation, purulent ocular discharge, nasal crusting, skin/mucosal jaundice, hepatic damage, and progressive deterioration leading to euthanasia after three days. Laboratory analyses confirmed RFAV infection, with multi-system involvement (eyes, liver, kidneys, nervous system) and blue-eye changes. Serbia’s outbreak traces to late 2025 at a dog-training facility near Novi Sad, where two Russian-imported Dobermans arrived in November 2025; among eight dogs, four Dobermans became ill. Metagenomic sequencing identified the pathogen; transmission route remains unclear, and questions persist about dog-to-dog spread and early diagnosis/treatment.

triage.headline_ja: クロアチアで謎のウイルスがドーベルマンを死に至らしめる、目が青くなり苦しみながら死亡…

triage.notes: 中国は病原体が最初に確認された野生動物（アライグマ）由来の起源として言及されているのみで、現在の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。現時点ではヒトへの感染報告はなく、動物衛生当局の監視対象と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra 665 casos de mpox em 2026; infectologista orienta sobre sintomas e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records 665 Mpox cases in 2026; infectious disease specialist explains symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Brazil: 665 cases in 2026, 94% below 2022's 10,821. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, mucous membranes, and secretions, with higher risk in intimate contact; contaminated objects and, in some cases, prolonged close respiratory secretions can spread the virus. Common symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, and skin or mucosal lesions; presentations vary, with genital/anal lesions possible. Diagnosis is confirmed by laboratory PCR testing on lesion material. No specific antiviral is approved; management is supportive, with most cases mild to moderate and recovery in 2–4 weeks. Isolation is advised from symptom onset until crusts heal and new skin forms, including hygiene and avoiding close contact. Vaccination via Brazil's SUS targets priority groups (e.g., people living with HIV/AIDS, immunosuppressed, exposed lab personnel) after evaluation. Seek medical care for suspected cases and follow guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年にMpox症例665件を記録；感染症専門医が症状と予防について説明
triage.triage_reason: 2026年のブラジルにおけるMpox症例数は2022年比94%減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められず、既知の感染経路・管理体制が機能している通常の疾病報告記事である。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発目的の一般情報提供であり、症例数は大幅減少傾向。ワクチン接種体制（SUS）も既存の優先グループ向けに運用中で、新規の公衆衛生上の懸念は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉:英国医生刚果(金)确诊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: British doctor diagnosed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: A British doctor diagnosed with Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo was repatriated to London on 5 November for treatment at the Royal Free Hospital, where an isolation ward is caring for the patient, who is clinically stable. The Bundibugyo strain outbreak in eastern DRC has killed more than 5,300 people since it began in May 2026, with transmission centered in North Kivu's Beni and Ituri's Bunia. There is currently no specific vaccine for Bundibugyo; two candidate vaccines will enter clinical trials in the DRC in coming weeks—one from the University of Oxford with an Indian partner, and another from Moderna. The WHO notes no targeted vaccine yet for Bundibugyo, while Ervebo (Ebola Zaire vaccine) is already approved and will be offered to volunteers for trials alongside the new candidates, with initial results expected early next year.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: British doctor diagnosed with Ebola in Congo (Kinshasa).

Diagnosed in Congo (Kinshasa) on 5 November, he is now in isolation at London’s Royal Free Hospital with stable condition. Since May 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC has claimed over 5,300 lives, with Bunia (Ituri Province) among affected areas. There is currently no targeted vaccine for Bundibugyo, but two candidate vaccines are set to enter clinical trials in the DRC: one developed by the University of Oxford in collaboration with an Indian pharmaceutical group, and another by Moderna. The WHO notes that, alongside the Ervebo vaccine for Ebola Zaire already approved, these candidates will be offered to local volunteers for trials in coming weeks, with initial results expected early next year.

article.articleHeadline: Covid e outros vírus respiratórios avançam na Bahia; Fiocruz aponta aumento de casos graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 and other respiratory viruses are spreading in Bahia; Fiocruz reports an increase in severe cases.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz InfoGripe Week 43 (Oct 25–31, 2026) reports rising Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) in Bahia linked to metapneumovirus, with Bahia, Alagoas, Pernambuco, Paraíba and Sergipe affected. Nationally, increases in SRAG due to COVID-19 and rhinovirus are noted, with heightened risk for children under 2 years and older adults. COVID-19–related SRAG is rising in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina, though overall COVID SRAG remains low in these states except Mato Grosso; in Mato Grosso do Sul, SRAG rises are tied to rhinovirus. Rhinovirus is the leading cause of SRAG in young children and a major contributor to mortality in this group, while deaths among SRAG patients are notable in older adults. Vaccination against COVID-19 is urged for priority groups. By 2026, Brazil had 171,369 SRAG cases, with 91,420 positive for a respiratory virus (RSV 38.7%, rhinovirus 33.5%, influenza A 15.5%, influenza B 5.5%, SARS-CoV-2 3.9%); Aracaju and João Pessoa show SRAG activity, with alert levels also in Roraima, Sergipe and Santa Catarina.

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 e casos graves de SRAG registram alta em cinco estados brasileiros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 and severe acute respiratory syndrome cases surge in five Brazilian states.
article.articleSummary: Five Brazilian states report rising severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) cases linked to COVID-19, per Fiocruz InfoGripe. Mato Grosso, the Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina show increases in September–October; however, in four of these states the absolute SRAG incidence attributed to coronavirus remains low. Rhinovirus dominates SRAG detections (50.1%), followed by Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) (10.1%), Influenza A (4.2%), Influenza B (4.7%), and COVID-19 (8.5%) among positives in the latest four epidemiological weeks. For deaths in the same period, coronavirus accounts for 24.1% of fatalities while rhinovirus accounts for 43% of deaths. Across the year, the surveillance system logged 171,369 SRAG notifications, 91,420 laboratory-confirmed infections, 62,823 negatives, and 7,457 pending results. Incidence is highest in children ≤2 years; mortality concentrates in adults ≥65 years. Continuous monitoring is essential to prevent health-system overload.

article.articleHeadline: Cinco estados registram aumento de casos graves de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five states report an increase in severe COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin shows rising severe COVID-19 cases in five Brazilian states—Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina—for Oct 25–31. Concurrently, SRAG cases associated with metapneumovirus, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) increased, with the burden highest among young children. In three states (Roraima, Sergipe, Santa Catarina), SRAG is at alert, risk, or high-risk levels but without a clear long-term upward trend; among capitals, Aracaju and João Pessoa report SRAG activity at alert/risk/high risk with a growing long-term trend. The report underscores vaccination as the main prevention against severe COVID-19 and related deaths, especially for older adults and immunocompromised individuals. For 2026, 171,369 SRAG cases were recorded nationwide; 91,420 (53.3%) lab-positive for a respiratory virus, 62,823 (36.7%) negative, 7,457 (4.4%) awaiting results. Among positives: RSV 38.7%, rhinovirus 33.5%, influenza A 15.5%, influenza B 5.5%, SARS-CoV-2 3.9%.

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo registra quase 70 novos casos de mpox desde outubro; Bahia descarta surto - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo records nearly 70 new mpox cases since October; Bahia rules out an outbreak - Metro 1.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo reports 67 mpox cases since October 4, bringing 2026 total to 300 with 197 in the capital; Bahia records five diagnoses in 2026 and its Sesab says there is no outbreak, noting 31 suspected and 189 discarded. Rio de Janeiro reports 74 cases in the last two months. Brazil-wide mpox cases reach 665 in 2026. The Ministry of Health authorized purchase of up to 20,000 mpox vaccine doses to bolster SUS stocks, prioritizing people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm³. Mpox spreads mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, secretions, and contaminated objects; symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions progressing from macules to vesicles and crusts, typically lasting 2–4 weeks. Severe disease possible in children, pregnant individuals, and the immunocompromised.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 aumentam há seis semanas no Brasil; Minas está entre os estados em alta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases have been rising for six weeks in Brazil; Minas Gerais is among the states with rising cases.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases have risen in Brazil for six weeks, with 19 states showing an upward trend; Minas Gerais is among them, though overall activity remains low. Hospitalizations are rising in several states and the Federal District, notably in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, and Mato Grosso do Sul. From Jan 1 to Nov 4, 2026, Brazil logged 118,851 notified COVID-19–related influenza-like illness cases, though many infections go undiagnosed. Private laboratories report nine consecutive weeks of higher SARS-CoV-2 test positivity. Up to Oct 31, 3,479 SRAG hospitalizations with coronavirus detected and 437 deaths in which the virus was identified. Despite more cases, total respiratory hospitalizations trend downward; about 8.5% of SRAG cases and 24.1% of SRAG-related deaths involve the virus. Genomic surveillance found 2,199 sequences, 127 lineages, with ~90% belonging to XFG or descendants. Vaccination remains the principal prevention, with schedules for elderly, pregnant, children, and immunocompromised.

article.articleHeadline: 呼吸道传染病高发期来了！今年湖南省流感疫苗接种工作，三项重要变化需留意
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The peak season for respiratory infectious diseases has arrived! This year, three important changes to watch for in Hunan Province's influenza vaccination program.
article.articleSummary: Influenza persists in Hunan Province during autumn–winter, with dominant A/H3N2 and B Victoria lineage; A/H1N1 detected in small numbers; infection rates highest among 5–14-year-olds. Rhinovirus infections are rising, posing a severe risk to infants; other circulating pathogens include Streptococcus pneumoniae, Respiratory Syncytial Virus, and Haemophilus influenzae type b at typical levels. Three vaccination changes for winter/spring: 1) free influenza vaccination for rural elderly (65+) and rural primary/secondary school students; urban residents can pay via medical insurance accounts for themselves or relatives. 2) priority groups: those at risk of severe disease (60+, chronic disease, under 5, pregnant) and those likely to transmit (healthcare workers, students, childcare workers, elderly-care facility staff, household caregivers). 3) vaccine is trivalent rather than quadrivalent, aligning with Yamagata lineage absence since 2020; WHO recommends this formulation, and protection remains appropriate.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器感染症の流行期到来！今年の湖南省インフルエンザワクチン接種事業、3つの重要な変更点に注意

article.articleHeadline: New PAHO plan aims to accelerate malaria elimination in the Americas over the next four years
article.articleSummary: PAHO unveils the Action Plan for Malaria Elimination in the Americas 2026–2030 to accelerate malaria elimination across the Americas and Caribbean. It targets a 50% reduction in incidence by 2030 versus 2024’s ~537,000 cases, and a 70% fall in Plasmodium falciparum. Despite progress, 2025 cases are ~458,000; 22 municipalities in six countries reported >4,000 cases, with eight municipalities making up 25% of all cases. Since 2018, five countries—Argentina, Paraguay, El Salvador, Belize, Suriname—have been malaria-free, and Suriname in 2025 became the first Amazon Basin country to eliminate malaria. The plan brings diagnosis and treatment closer to communities, expanding rapid diagnostic tests, community networks, and digital tools; plus reactive interventions, chemoprevention, radical cure for P. vivax, improved surveillance and vector control, and sustained domestic financing, focusing on Indigenous communities, mining areas, and remote regions.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいPAHO計画、今後4年間で米州のマラリア撲滅を加速へ
