article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 crescem em cinco estados do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise in five Brazilian states.
article.articleSummary: Week 43 of 2026 (Oct 25–31) Brazil: Severe COVID-19 cases rising in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina, though incidences in four of these are still very low. In addition, SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) due to human metapneumovirus shows increasing activity in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, Paraná, Bahia, Alagoas, Pernambuco, Paraíba and Sergipe; rhinovirus activity is slightly up in Mato Grosso. Ceará remains low-risk for SRAG; Rio Grande do Norte, Tocantins, Piauí and Roraima are also low risk. Six states—Maranhão, Roraima, Santa Catarina, Sergipe, Mato Grosso, and Mato Grosso do Sul—are at alert, risk or high risk for SRAG incidence, while Ceará and others stay at low risk. IntegraSUS (through Sep 24, 2026) reports Ceará with 4,407 COVID-19 cases in 2026 and no deaths. Fiocruz notes 7,679 Brazil SRAG deaths; 3,465 (45.1%) lab-positive for a respiratory virus, 3,452 (45%) negative, 122 (1.6%) pending.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの5州で新型コロナウイルスの重症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: 既知の病原体（COVID-19・ヒトメタニューモウイルス）による季節性の呼吸器疾患サーベイランスレポートであり、多くの州でリスクは低いとされ、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル国内の定期的な呼吸器疾患サーベイランス（SRAG監視）レポートであり、既知の季節性病原体（COVID-19、hMPV、ライノウイルス）の活動状況を報告する通常業務の一環と判断される。多くの州がlow riskとされており、特段の異常事態や新興感染症の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de covid-19 crescem em cinco estados - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise in five states
article.articleSummary: Five Brazilian states show signals of rising severe COVID-19 cases: Mato Grosso, the Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina, per Fiocruz InfoGripe. Despite the uptick, COVID-19–related SRAG incidence remains very low in four of these states, indicating a growing trend rather than high case counts. Other SRAG alerts include Roraima, Sergipe and Santa Catarina (alert/risk/high risk without long-term growth); Aracaju and João Pessoa (capitals) with growth. Over the last four epidemiological weeks, rhinovirus accounted for 50.1% of SRAG-positive cases, RSV 10.1%, COVID-19 8.5%, influenza B 4.7%, influenza A 4.2%; among identified viruses, rhinovirus 43% and COVID-19 24.1% of deaths, influenza B 12.7%, RSV 3.8%, influenza A 1.3%. In 2026, 171,369 SRAG cases; 91,420 (53.3%) positive, 62,823 negative, 7,457 pending. Metapneumovirus also rising in SE/South/NorthEast. Vaccination remains primary protection, especially for elderly and other priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: 5州で新型コロナウイルス重症症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で複数州のCOVID-19重症例増加傾向が報告されているが、発生率自体は低く、季節性呼吸器感染症のサーベイランス報告の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 国内定例サーベイランス報告（Fiocruz InfoGripe）に基づく記事であり、既存の季節性呼吸器感染症動向の一部。新規性や異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор начал проверку сообщений о заболевших туристах в Нячанге
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor has begun investigating reports of ill tourists in Nha Trang.
article.articleSummary: Russian health watchdog Rospotrebnadzor has begun investigating reports of influenza-like illness among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam. The agency sent inquiries to the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) and drafted a letter to Vietnam's Ministry of Health seeking details on the regional epidemiological situation, preventive measures, and how travelers should be informed. Reported symptoms include runny nose, severe cough, high fever, and pronounced headache; Vietnamese authorities have not yet released data on the scale of possible spread. Rospotrebnadzor advises standard influenza precautions: regular handwashing, avoiding close contact with the ill, and avoiding crowded places. If fever, body aches, cough, runny nose, or sore throat occur, seek medical care, and inform physicians about recent travel if symptoms arise during travel or after returning. A Moscow hospital official previously speculated the illness could resemble a coronavirus infection, noting the lack of diagnostic data.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾール、ニャチャンでの観光客の病気報告について調査を開始
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでロシア人観光客にインフルエンザ様症状が報告され、ロシア当局が調査を開始したが、確定診断やベトナム側の公式データが未公表であり、情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: モスクワの病院関係者がコロナウイルス感染の可能性を示唆しているが、診断データが不足しており確証はない。ベトナム保健省からの情報公開待ちの状態。

article.articleHeadline: Perú supera los 100 muertos por dengue: cifra va en aumento y casi duplica los registros de 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru surpasses 100 dengue-related deaths: the figure is on the rise and nearly doubles the 2025 figures.
article.articleSummary: By Oct 31, 2026, dengue caused 101 deaths in Peru, up 94% from the same period in 2025 (52). October accounts for 30% of 2026 fatalities. The north concentrates cases, led by Lambayeque with 25 deaths (Chiclayo province). San Martín and Piura have 17 each; Madre de Dios 9; La Libertad 7; Ucayali 7; Amazonas 5; Lima 4; Loreto and Pasco 3 each; Junín 2; Áncash and Cusco 1 each. Four-week trend (Weeks 40–43) shows 4, 9, 8, 10 deaths, totaling 31 in October, more than double September's 13. Transmission may rise with El Niño 2026's heavy rains. A free dengue vaccination campaign continues in prioritized zones, targeting ages 10–20 to reduce complications and hospitalizations. Access at DNI-required sites in Lima: Hospital San Juan de Lurigancho and centers Campoy, Ganimedes, San Fernando; Carabayllo centers San Pedro de Carabayllo, El Progreso, Raúl Porras Barrenechea.

triage.headline_ja: ペルー、デング熱による死者100人超：数は増加傾向にあり、2025年の記録をほぼ倍増
triage.triage_reason: ペルー国内でのデング熱流行であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国での発生ではないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はペルー国内のデング熱流行（101人死亡、前年比94%増）を報じている。発生地域リストにBrazilが含まれるが、記事本文・サマリーではブラジルへの言及は一切なく、主題国はペルーのみ。ペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とし、DISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 料本月仍大量流感個案 關日華：或合併冬季高峰 - 20261108
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This month is still expected to see a large number of influenza cases; Guan Rihua: may coincide with the winter peak - 20261108.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Hong Kong remains high as a cold front is forecast to sweep across the South China coast, bringing a sharp temperature drop. Experts warn that waning population immunity and persistent cross‑infection could push this month’s flu surge to coincide with the winter peak. The season has recorded 29 pediatric influenza cases with 2 deaths; severe illness can deteriorate rapidly, with hypotension and multi‑organ involvement potentially related to a cytokine storm, and abdominal pain with persistent vomiting may indicate myocarditis. Beyond influenza, SARS‑CoV‑2 remains circulating, with the XFG variant currently prevalent; individuals should consider updated COVID‑19 vaccination if more than six months have passed since last infection or vaccination to reduce infection risk and long‑COVID. RSV and other respiratory viruses are also active. Emphasized measures include hand hygiene; pregnant women may discuss vaccination to protect newborns, and infants may receive long‑acting antibodies based on clinical assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 今月も多数のインフルエンザ症例が予想、関日華氏：冬季流行のピークと重なる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 香港における季節性インフルエンザ流行で小児重症例・死亡例が報告されているが、例年の冬季流行パターンの範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は香港（中国特別行政区）における季節性インフルエンザおよびRSV・COVID-19（XFG株）の併存流行に関する公衆衛生広報的内容。小児29例・死亡2例の報告があるが、季節性の通常範囲とみられる。国際的な異常拡大の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Veterinary Officer appeals for support to curb rabies amid rising deaths in Bongo
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a major threat in Bongo District, Upper East Region, Ghana, with 5 deaths in Bongo and 36 rabies-related deaths region-wide from June 2025 to Sept 2026. Bongo District Veterinary Officer Hamidu Sadat appealed for District Assemblies Common Fund (DACF) support to enable free mass dog vaccination. He linked rising deaths to cross-border dog movements from Burkina Faso via the Yelwongo market, with dogs sold into Bolgatanga and Bongo Soe; many escaped and became strays. The district estimates 3,000–4,000 dogs, yet only 120 vaccine doses were available in the last vaccination exercise, far from sufficient. He noted fear of the GHS 1,000 cost for anti-rabies vaccines deters bite victims from seeking care; drone-delivered vaccines for bite victims have been halted due to stock shortages. He urged sustained dog vaccination, better border monitoring, and prompt bite treatment to reduce human exposure and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 獣医官、ボンゴ地区における狂犬病死者増加を受け支援を訴える
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ・ボンゴ地区で狂犬病による死者が継続的に発生（地域で36人死亡）し、ワクチン不足と国境を越えた犬の移動が要因とされ、行政支援が公式に要請されている。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナのボンゴ地区における狂犬病流行とワクチン不足、国境を越えた犬の移動（ブルキナファソからの犬の流入）を主題としている。タンザニアの地名が発生地域に含まれるが記事内容とは無関係であり除外した。ブルキナファソは犬の移動元として言及されるのみで、発生の主体はガーナであるため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Alertan en Brasil sobre aumento de casos graves de Covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings in Brazil about a rise in severe COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Brazil reports rising Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS)-associated COVID-19 cases across five states: Mato Grosso, the Federal District, Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina, per the latest InfoGripe bulletin from Fiocruz cited by Agencia Brasil. Two other states, Roraima and Sergipe, show alert to high-risk levels but no clear long-term growth. Across the four weeks analyzed, rhinovirus accounted for 50.1% of SRAG positives, followed by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) at 10.1%, SARS-CoV-2 at 8.5%, influenza B 4.7%, and influenza A 4.2%. Deaths among SRAG with viral identification showed coronavirus in 24.1%, behind rhinovirus at 43%. Since the start of 2026 Brazil has reported 171,369 SRAG cases, with 91,420 (53.3%) yielding a positive viral result. Highest severe-case incidence in children under two; mortality concentrates in adults 65+.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルスの重症例増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19関連の重症呼吸器感染症(SRAG)が増加傾向にあるが、既知の病原体による季節性動向の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の兆候は見られない。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器系病原体(ライノウイルス、RSV、COVID-19、インフルエンザA/B)が混在する季節性SRAG増加の報告。COVID-19は死亡例の24.1%を占めるが、主要因はライノウイルス(43%)。重症例は2歳未満児に多く、死亡は65歳以上に集中。新規性や異常性の明確な兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Acre entra na lista de estados com risco de surto de dengue em 2027, aponta estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre joins the list of states at risk of a dengue outbreak in 2027, according to a study.
article.articleSummary: Acre is among six Brazilian states projected to see dengue cases rise in 2027, alongside Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe and Minas Gerais. The forecast comes from a study prepared for the Health Ministry by 130 specialists across eight countries, presented on November 6 during a virtual meeting organized by Fiocruz, FGV, Mosqlimate and InfoDengue. Nationally, up to 860,000 probable dengue cases are anticipated in 2027. The projections also address chikungunya, with more than 90,000 probable cases expected, higher than 2025/2026 (76,000) but below 2024/2025 (127,000). The largest chikungunya increases are expected in the Northeast (Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Bahia, Paraíba, Sergipe and Piauí); Acre is forecast near the previous season for this disease. A possible super El Niño could influence climate and boost Aedes aegypti transmission, though model results vary.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州、2027年のデング熱流行リスク州リストに加わる：研究報告
triage.triage_reason: 2027年の将来予測に基づく研究発表であり、現時点での実際の発生・流行事象ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は2027年シーズンの予測研究発表であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。デング熱・チクングニア熱は例年ブラジルで流行しており、異常性は低い。続報（実際の症例数推移）があれば再評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Australia's 'whooping cough corridor' revealed
article.articleSummary: Eight coastal areas from New South Wales’ Richmond River Coast and Tweed Valley to Queensland’s Noosa Hinterland, plus Sydney’s Dural-Wisemans Ferry and the Gold Coast region, are among Australia’s bottom 10 for one-year-old pertussis vaccination, with coverage up to 35% lower than the best areas, according to the Immunisation Foundation of Australia’s 2026 Whooping Cough Report Card. Affected Queensland sites include Coolangatta, Gold Coast Hinterland, Nambour, Maroochy, Noosa and Noosa Hinterland; New South Wales sites include the Richmond River Coast and Tweed Valley; Sydney’s Dural-Wisemans Ferry; and Western Australia’s Gascoyne region. With warmer months and summer holidays approaching, whooping cough infections are expected to surge, and families travelling with babies are urged to check vaccination status. One-year-olds up to date with vaccination have fallen below 90% for the first time in over 25 years. Whooping cough is highly contagious and causes prolonged coughing fits, and can be life-threatening for young infants.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリアの『百日咳回廊』が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: オーストラリア国内のワクチン接種率に関する報告であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGhanaが含まれるが記事内容とは無関係。記事の主題はオーストラリアの予防接種率低下地域の報告であり、対象国に該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: 台南境外登革熱+1 返國4天發病 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan: Imported dengue fever case +1; onset four days after returning to Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Imported dengue fever case reported in Tainan, Taiwan: a domestic female in her 40s from Yongkang District contracted dengue after a Vietnam workers’ trip (Oct 28–Nov 1). Returnee developed fever, headache, and myalgia four days later (on Nov 4) and sought care on Nov 5 at Annan Hospital; dengue NS1 rapid test was positive, with PCR confirming infection. The Dengue Fever Control Center notified Kaohsiung City Health Bureau, and authorities implemented emergency vector control, including spraying around the residence, environmental cleanup, and vector-density surveillance, plus planned indoor/outdoor chemical measures to reduce transmission risk. This is Tainan City’s 17th imported dengue case this year. As of Nov 6, Taiwan totals 238 dengue cases for the year: 17 locally acquired, 221 imported, with Vietnam as the top source of imported infections, followed by the Philippines and Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: 台南で輸入性デング熱症例+1、帰国4日後に発症
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における単発の輸入性デング熱症例で、通常のサーベイランス報告の範囲内であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（対象国リスト外）で発生した輸入性デング熱の単発症例。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは感染経路（渡航先）として言及されているのみで、これらの国自体でのアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Covid-19 aumentam há seis semanas e avançam em 19 estados brasileiros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases have been rising for six weeks and are expanding in 19 Brazilian states.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases have risen in Brazil for six weeks, expanding to 19 states across all five regions as of early November. Since 2026 began, 118,851 COVID-19–related influenza-like syndrome cases have been notified, though this undercounts infections. Fiocruz's InfoGripe shows growth in severe cases across these states, with early signals in the North, Northeast, Central-West, Southeast and South. Despite higher circulation, overall risk remains low. Private laboratories report nine weeks of rising SARS-CoV-2 positivity. From 2026 through Oct 31, there were 3,479 SRAG hospitalizations with SARS-CoV-2 detected and 437 deaths in this group. In the last four weeks, SARS-CoV-2 was identified in 8.5% of severe cases and 24.1% of deaths among this cohort; sequencing identified 127 lineages, about 90% of which are XFG or descendants. Higher risk persists for older adults, immunocompromised, and certain chronic diseases; adults 60+ are advised semiannual COVID-19 vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでCOVID-19症例が6週連続で増加、19州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の季節的増加が報告されているが、当局はリスクを低いと評価しており、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。流行継続性はあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性COVID-19流行の国内サーベイランス報告であり、保健当局は全体的リスクを低いと評価している。新規変異株（XFG系統）の優勢が確認されているが、特段の異常性は指摘されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus PMK di Bantul Turun Drastis, 51 Sapi Terpapar pada 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Foot-and-mouth disease cases in Bantul drop drastically, 51 cattle exposed in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in Bantul Regency, Indonesia, shows a sharp decline in 2026. From January through October, 51 cattle were exposed to FMD, and all have recovered as of early November 2026; there were also deaths in prior waves but far fewer recently. In the December 2024 to January 2025 period, 283 cattle contracted FMD, with 32 dead, 2 culled, and 249 still sick. DKPP Bantul intensified vaccination, meeting a 27,500-dose target for 2026 (100% realized). Vaccination eligibility depends on animal health status and pregnancy; not all animals can be vaccinated. The program targets cattle, goats, sheep, and buffalo, delivered through 10 Puskeswan centers serving 17 kapanewon (districts). Vaccines are free from the Ministry of Agriculture, with vaccination offered at farm sites or at Puskeswan facilities to sustain the downward trend.

triage.headline_ja: バントゥルのFMD症例が劇的に減少、2026年は牛51頭が感染
triage.triage_reason: 動物のみが影響を受ける口蹄疫で、症例数も減少傾向にあり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の脅威や社会的関心の高まりを示す情報がないため見送りと判定した。
triage.notes: 動物（牛）の口蹄疫に関する記事であり、ヒトの感染症ではない。症例数は減少傾向にあり、ワクチン接種プログラムも順調に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор запросил данные о заболевших россиянах во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor requested data on Russians who fell ill in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s consumer health watchdog, has requested Vietnam’s Ministry of Health and the Association of Tour Operators of Russia (ATOR) to provide information about Russians who fell ill with influenza in Nha Trang, Vietnam. The inquiry follows reports of holidaymakers experiencing high fever, severe cough, runny nose, and headache at the popular resort. The agency seeks details on the local epidemiological situation, measures to prevent infection, and whether tourists are warned about infection risks. The request comes as the ministry reiterates preventive measures for respiratory infections—avoid close contact with the sick, wash hands regularly, and seek medical care if symptoms appear. Some patients, including children, reportedly received non-specific diagnoses or were prescribed medications without a clear confirmation. Some travelers suspect contaminated hotel air conditioners as a contributing factor. The Russian travel association notes influenza activity in Vietnam remains at seasonal levels, with no mass complaints among organized Russian tourists.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、ベトナムで病気になったロシア人に関する情報を要請
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ニャチャンでのインフルエンザは季節性レベルとされ、集団感染や重症例の報告はなく、ロシアの消費者保護機関による情報照会に留まるため、公衆衛生上の重大なシグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア人観光客の健康相談に関するロシア当局の照会が主題であり、ベトナム国内の疫学状況は『季節性レベル』と明言されている。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Apesar do El Niño, casos de dengue devem manter padrão semelhante ao de anos anteriores - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Despite El Niño, dengue cases are expected to maintain a pattern similar to that of previous years - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Brazil may report 866,000 dengue cases in 2027 (CI 560,000–1.6 million), similar to 2025–2026, per a 130-researcher, 22-team synthesis presented at the 'Dengue season 2027' webinar by Fiocruz, FGV, Mosqlimate, InfoDengue, Kwar-AI, and TGHN-LAC. El Niño effects are uncertain and regionally variable; only three models included climate variables. The peak is projected for April 2027 with about 40,000 weekly dengue cases. Regions likely to see higher activity include Rio de Janeiro, Paraná, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe, Acre, and Minas Gerais; other areas are expected to stay at or below 2025–2026 levels. Chikungunya projections estimate ~90,000 probable cases, with increases mainly in Northeast states (Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Bahia, Paraíba, Sergipe, Piauí) and also São Paulo, Mato Grosso, and Mato Grosso do Sul; Espírito Santo is excluded due to underreporting.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョにもかかわらず、デング熱の症例数は過去数年と同様の水準を維持する見込み - Jornal O Sul
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性予測・研究モデルに基づく将来予測記事であり、過去数年と同様の水準との内容で異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱は季節性流行病として毎年発生しており、本記事は2027年シーズンの予測モデル結果を報告する研究発表内容。過去と同水準と予測されており、異常事態や新規の公衆衛生上の脅威は示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de Covid-19 aumentam no Brasil; vacinação segue como principal proteção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise in Brazil; vaccination remains the primary protection.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Fiocruz bulletin shows rising COVID-19 severity across 19 states over six weeks, though national risk remains low. COVID-19-related Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) hospitalizations are increasing, with Mato Grosso a key driver, while metapneumovirus and rhinovirus rise in the Southeast, South, and Northeast. Rhinovirus accounts for about 50.1% of recent positive respiratory-virus tests; SARS-CoV-2 about 8.5%. Among virus-identified deaths, coronavirus represents 24.1%. Since early 2026, 171,369 SARI cases, with 53.3% testing positive for a respiratory virus, 36.7% negative, and 4.4% pending. Two capitals—Aracaju (Sergipe) and João Pessoa (Paraíba)—show SARI alert levels. In children ≤2 years, severe cases are higher, with rhinovirus, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and metapneumovirus most common; mortality is higher in ≥65. By week 42 of 2026, 2,199 SARS-CoV-2 sequences identified across 127 lineages, ~90% belonging to lineage XFG or descendants, with no variant showing increased transmissibility. Vaccination remains the primary protection.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルスの重症例が増加；ワクチン接種が主要な防御策であり続ける
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19重症例やSARI入院が増加しているが、国家としてのリスクは低いとされ、新規変異株の懸念も否定されており、フルRRAに進む緊急性は低いが経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: Fiocruzの定期サーベイランス報告に基づく記事で、国内の季節性呼吸器感染症動向の一環として報告されている。新規変異株による伝播性増加の証拠はなく、全国的リスクは低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Chagas: 1 pessoa morre e 6 casos estão ativos em Óbidos, no Pará;
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease: 1 person dies and 6 active cases in Óbidos, Pará.
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease outbreak in Óbidos, Pará, Brazil, reports 1 death and 6 active cases, with 24 more under epidemiological surveillance as of 7 November 2026. Six active cases include 2 hospitalized and 4 under outpatient follow-up; all are stable apart from the deceased patient. The fatality occurred at 13:00 at Hospital Regional Menino Jesus in Oriximiná; the patient’s name and age were not disclosed. Infections traced to consumption of artisanal patuá wine produced in the rural area of Óbidos. Municipal Health Secretariat (Semsa) and the state Health Surveillance Department (Sespa) coordinate containment and monitoring, with privacy protections under LGPD. Authorities remain mobilized and seek updates on the six patients and the 24 under monitoring; no further clinical details released.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病：パラ州オビドスで1人死亡、活動性症例6件
triage.triage_reason: 食品媒介性のシャーガス病集団発生で死亡例を含むが、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低く国際的拡大の懸念は小さい。地域限定的な事案として続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 経口感染（パトゥア・ワイン摂取）による急性シャーガス病の集団発生。地域の保健当局が対応中で、24名が経過観察下にある。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低いが、継続的な食品汚染源の可能性があり注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 发病致死率近100%！两男子接连确诊，医生提醒：以为小狗无毒是最危险的错觉
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies has a nearly 100% case-fatality rate once symptoms appear! Two men diagnosed in succession; doctors warn: thinking that puppies are harmless is the most dangerous illusion.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Wuhan, China: Two consecutive cases were diagnosed with rabies and admitted to ICU at Wuhan Jinyintan Hospital after exposure to unvaccinated newborn puppies. The dogs were less than one month old and had small or invisible wounds; each case involved a bite or lick months earlier (one in July, the other in October). Rabies symptoms then appeared, including hydrophobia, throat tightness, and dysphagia, necessitating ICU care; both were lab-confirmed. Experts stress that rabies is nearly 100% fatal after onset, but timely post-exposure prophylaxis can prevent infection. Key steps: immediately wash wounds with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes, disinfect with iodine, and seek prompt medical evaluation to assess exposure and vaccination needs. For higher-risk exposures, vaccinate plus rabies immunoglobulin. Vaccinate pets and avoid contact with unknown animals, especially for children.

triage.headline_ja: 発症後の致死率はほぼ100%！男性2人が相次いで確診、医師が警告：『子犬は無害』という思い込みが最も危険
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は中国で既知の風土病であり、散発的な個別症例報告でアウトブレイクや新規性を示す情報はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が高い疾患だが、本記事は個別症例2件の啓発的報道であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の新たな脅威を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Llaman a vacunarse ante repunte de Covid-19 grave en Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They call on people to get vaccinated amid severe COVID-19 resurgence in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurgence in Brazil with sustained rise in severe cases across five cities: Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina. The health bulletin flags Roraima, Sergipe, and Santa Catarina at alert/high-risk levels for severe acute respiratory syndrome; though long-term growth is not evident, hospital occupancy and viral circulation demand vigilance. Authorities may expand ICU beds and mobilize rapid-response teams. COVID-19 now affects 19 federative units across all ages, indicating wider community spread beyond major urban centers. Two capitals, Aracaju and João Pessoa, report growing severe cases, raising concern for healthcare capacity. Rhinovirus accounts for 50.1% of positive tests in severe respiratory illness, followed by RSV 10.1% and SARS-CoV-2 8.5%; influenza A/B also present. Deaths: rhinovirus ~43% of lab-identified viral deaths; COVID-19 ~24.1%. Children under 2 highest incidence of severe disease; adults 65+ highest mortality. Vaccination urged, booster for elderly/immunocompromised; coverage below targets. Masks indoors advised.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで重症COVID-19が再流行、ワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル19州でCOVID-19重症例が拡大し、ICU占有率上昇や高齢者死亡率の高さが報告されており、WPRO基準の複数該当とワクチン接種呼びかけなど当局の関心の高さが確認できる。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内の季節性呼吸器疾患サーベイランス報告であり、ライノウイルスが主要病原体（陽性率50.1%）だがCOVID-19重症例の再増加が焦点。19連邦州に拡大し、小児・高齢者への影響が強調されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Brasil registra quase 490 mil casos e especialistas alertam para avanço da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Brazil records nearly 490,000 cases and experts warn of the disease's progression.
article.articleSummary: As of 7 November 2026, Brazil has 489,100 probable dengue cases in 2026 and 368 deaths confirmed. Four states—Minas Gerais, Goiás, Tocantins, and São Paulo—account for more than half of notifications this year. Belo Horizonte intensified vector-control efforts, including home visits and resident guidance, with alert for Zika and chikungunya. A group of over 130 experts from eight countries submitted to the Ministry of Health projects up to 860,000 probable dengue cases in the coming year, despite a summer shaped by a super El Niño. Belo Horizonte's zoonoses directorate notes 83% of breeding sites are inside homes, underscoring need for public-government collaboration to eliminate breeding sites. Vaccination is a preventive tool; the SUS provides dengue vaccine for adolescents 10–14, also available in private networks.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ブラジルで約49万例を記録、専門家が疾病の拡大に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでデング熱49万例・368人死亡と規模が大きく、専門家が来年86万例への増加を警告するなど社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの風土病で季節性流行だが、今年は症例数・死亡者数ともに高水準かつ来年さらなる増加が専門家により予測されており、ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の併発警戒も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 夫妻俩双双确诊，提醒：早期症状似感冒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Couple Both Diagnosed; Reminder: Early Symptoms Resemble a Cold
article.articleSummary: In Ningbo's Fenghua District, Zhejiang Province, China, a husband and wife were diagnosed with psittacosis after buying a parrot for 800 yuan. The husband, after five–six days of keeping the bird, developed 39°C fever with headache, myalgia and dry cough; chest CT showed a pulmonary infiltrate, and laboratory tests confirmed Chlamydia psittaci infection. A week later, the wife developed similar illness and was likewise diagnosed; both recovered after treatment. Doctors explained there was no human-to-human transmission in this case; rather, the bird continued to shed the pathogen, releasing aerosolized particles at home, leading to inhalation exposure. Psittacosis is a zoonosis carried by parrots and other birds (pigeons, canaries, chickens, ducks) with respiratory secretions and droppings as sources. Prevention focuses on personal protection (mask, gloves), hand hygiene, cage sanitation, disinfection, food/water safeguards, and regular health monitoring for birds and owners.

triage.headline_ja: 夫妻俩双双确诊、注意喚起：初期症状は風邪に似ている
triage.triage_reason: 単一家庭内での鳥からヒトへの散発的なオウム病感染例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 家庭内で飼育したオウムからの感染で、二次感染（ヒト-ヒト感染）はないと医師が説明。散発例であり、公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 男子被小奶狗抓伤，另一男子被狗舔到伤口，2人都不当回事确诊狂犬病进ICU
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man was scratched by a puppy; another man had his wound licked by a dog, both didn't take it seriously, diagnosed with rabies and admitted to the ICU.
article.articleSummary: Two rabies patients were admitted to Wuhan's Jinyintan Hospital ICU as of November 8, 2026. A man scratched on the finger by an unvaccinated puppy; the wound was not washed and he developed hydrophobia before diagnosis. A second man had his hand wound licked by a puppy; he was only lightly disinfected and also progressed to rabies. Rabies is nearly 100% fatal once symptoms appear. The report warns that even small puppies can carry the virus; any skin break is at least a Category II exposure requiring immediate wound irrigation and vaccination. For high-risk head/neck exposures, passive immunization with rabies immunoglobulin (or monoclonal antibody) is given along with vaccines. Key steps: wash for 15 minutes with soap and running water, disinfect, seek prompt care, and vaccinate pets to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 男性が子犬に引っかかれ、別の男性が犬に傷口を舐められる、2人とも軽視して狂犬病と診断されICUへ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は既知の疾患で国内の散発的な個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。啓発目的の記事であり社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は中国で継続的に発生している風土病であり、本記事は個別症例2件の予防啓発記事。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、公衆衛生上の新規性・異常性はない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil reverte restrições nacionais à avicultura em 19 dias após foco da doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reverses national restrictions on poultry farming 19 days after Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompts rapid reversal of national poultry trade restrictions within 19 days. The outbreak was identified on 18 October 2026 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, SC. With Uruguay recognizing sanitary regionalization, international barriers are now limited to Santa Catarina, while four municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim—remain under restriction. China lifted its import bans in under 24 hours, and Uruguay resumed imports from other states. In 2024, an outbreak in Rio Grande do Sul took 74 days to restore exports, underscoring the improvement. The external sales impact is about 15,000 tonnes per month (~3% of Brazil’s ~500,000 tonnes monthly export average). The response involved SDA, SCRI, MRE, and Cidasc, with real-time technical data shared with trading partners. Public messaging confirms that inspected poultry products remain safe for consumption; regional measures are prioritized to four municipalities only.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生から19日で家禽養殖に対する国内制限を解除
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響の記載はない。貿易制限は既に大部分解除されており、公衆衛生上の懸念よりも経済・貿易対応の進展を伝える内容。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（家禽）に関する事案であり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクの記載なし。中国・ウルグアイは貿易相手国として言及されているが、発生国はブラジルのみ。中国(1814991)は発生地域ではなく貿易関係国として記載されているため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Đập chết muỗi có đủ để phòng sốt xuất huyết?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is killing mosquitoes enough to prevent dengue fever?
article.articleSummary: Killing mosquitoes alone is insufficient to prevent dengue fever in Vietnam, because after an infected person is bitten, Aedes aegypti or Aedes albopictus can lay eggs in water containers; eggs hatch within about 3 days into larvae that quickly become adults, allowing ongoing transmission even during insecticide campaigns. Eliminating larval habitats is essential—turn over water containers and remove standing water to prevent mosquitoes from laying eggs. Dengue remains a year-round burden in Vietnam: 2025 saw 184,903 cases—the highest in the Asia-Pacific region; in the first 10 months of 2026, 170,684 suspected cases and 21 deaths. Transmission involves an 8–12 day extrinsic incubation in mosquitoes. Symptoms begin with high fever; defervescence can trigger severe complications, including shock. Early medical care is vital, with warning signs such as persistent fever, fatigue, abdominal pain, and vomiting; high-risk groups include pregnant women, children, the elderly, and those with underlying conditions. Public advice: no-larvae, no dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊を駆除するだけでデング熱予防に十分か？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるデング熱予防に関する一般啓発記事であり、新規の異常発生や緊急対応を示す情報はない。既知の季節性・流行性疾患の背景説明にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介感染症対策（幼虫駆除）の啓発内容が中心で、中国への言及はなく発生地域データの中国は除外した。2025年の症例数が過去最高との記述はあるが、本記事自体は新規イベント報告ではなく予防啓発記事。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de covid aumentam no DF e em quatro estados, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases are rising in the Federal District and in four states, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 severe cases are rising in the Federal District and in Mato Grosso, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Santa Catarina, with Mato Grosso at an alert level. From January to October, COVID-19 accounted for 3.9% of Brazil’s respiratory-disease records, increasing to 8.5% in the last four weeks. In the latest four weeks, COVID-19 fatalities reached 1,850, about 800 more than the preceding period. From January through October, 1,067 deaths were attributed to COVID-19 nationwide. São Paulo leads annual COVID-19 deaths with 124, followed by Minas Gerais (52) and Rio Grande do Sul (33). Over six weeks, the Ministry of Health reported a rising trend in COVID-19 across 19 states and all age groups. Infectologist Renato Kfouri notes no evidence of major mutations or greater virulence, stressing vaccination for vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区および4州で新型コロナウイルスの重症例が増加、フィオクルスが指摘
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19重症例・死亡者数が複数州で急増しており、保健省・フィオクルスが監視対象としている点でWPRO基準（重症度・曝露継続）を満たし、社会的・行政的関心も確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 新変異株や病原性増強の証拠はなく、季節的な感染拡大とみられる。ブラジル国内19州で増加傾向が報告されており、ワクチン接種呼びかけが強調されている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur among areas that have recovered from ASF
article.articleSummary: ASF in the Philippines’ hog sector shows progress as Ilocos Norte and Ilocos Sur have shifted from red (infected) zones to pink (buffer) or yellow (surveillance) zones per DA-BAI’s National ASF Prevention and Control Program, in Bulletin No. 2026-19 as of October 2026. Red zones denote confirmed outbreaks; pink zones are surrounding buffer areas; yellow zones are adjacent high-risk surveillance areas. The improved classifications indicate recovery from previously ASF-affected status in these provinces, though continued monitoring and strict biosecurity remain essential. Officials urge hog raisers and local authorities to maintain farm biosecurity, regulate movement of live pigs and pork products, and promptly report suspected ASF cases. Past ASF outbreaks severely impacted the hog industry with losses and pork-supply disruptions; ongoing surveillance and biosecurity are intended to sustain recovery. Article published 2026-11-08.

triage.headline_ja: イロコス・ノルテ、イロコス・スールがASFから回復した地域に
triage.triage_reason: 動物の疾病（豚のASF）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響はなく、内容は状況改善（回復）を示す続報であるためIHR・WPRO基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（養豚業）に関する話題であり、ヒト感染症のEBS対象としての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Keralam measles outbreaks call for a relook at disease epidemiology
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks in Keralam state, across Kozhikode, Malappuram and Palakkad, with 824 confirmed and 1,681 probable cases as of 6 November 2026; five measles-related deaths (one confirmed). The disease now affects broader age groups, including fully vaccinated individuals and infants under nine months. UIP vaccination history: introduced 1985, first dose at nine months, second dose at 18 months since 2010; first-dose MR ~95% coverage, second-dose ~85–88%; outbreaks persist amid incomplete immunisation. Experts call for updated epidemiology, possible additional UIP dose in adolescence or before marriage, and serological studies in adolescents and young women. Mumbai 2023 data show infants affected and maternal antibody gaps; RGCB/JAMA Network Open (Aug 2025) found 8.5% of children lacked protective antibodies, 13% IgM+, 63.6% with a third dose, suggesting breakthrough infections and waning immunity; larger epidemiological investigations are needed to identify drivers.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州の麻疹（はしか）流行、疾病疫学の見直しを迫る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響（824例確定・1681例疑い、5名死亡）と異常性（ワクチン接種済み者・9か月未満乳児への感染拡大）の2基準に該当するため、フルリスク評価へ進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ケーララ州（コジコード、マラップラム、パラッカド）での麻疹流行。ワクチン接種歴のある者や乳児にも感染が及び、ブレークスルー感染や免疫減弱が疑われている。専門家はUIPへの追加接種や血清疫学調査を提言。ムンバイの先行事例やJAMA Network Open論文（2025年8月）のデータも引用されており、インド国内の公衆衛生上の重要課題として扱われている。
